title: 一张普通手掌照片，也能被 AI 做成一份“高端命理咨询报告”。
prompt:
最近这个玩法很适合社交媒体传播：

上传一张手掌自拍，AI 自动生成一张手相分析信息图。
生命线、感情线、智慧线、命运线、太阳线全部标注出来，旁边配上性格、事业、感情、财运的解读。

黑金配色、金色线条、信息图排版，
看起来不像随便玩玩，反而像一份高级神秘学报告。

当然，这类内容更适合作为娱乐和社交互动，别把它当成真实命运判断。

🎯 核心提示词

可以直接这样写：

请基于上传的手掌照片，生成一张专业手相分析信息图。整体风格干净、现代、高级，使用深色背景和金色暖光强调色。请在手掌上清晰标注主要掌纹，包括生命线、感情线、智慧线、命运线、太阳线，并在每条线旁边加入简短中文解读。底部加入四个总结卡片：优势、事业、爱情、财运。整体像一份高级命理咨询报告，排版清晰，视觉精致，适合社交媒体发布。

想更稳，可以补一句：

内容仅作娱乐解读，风格要像神秘学信息图，不要生成医学诊断，不要夸大预测。

这类提示词的核心结构是：

手掌照片 + 掌纹标注 + 中文解读 + 黑金信息图 + 总结卡片 + 高级咨询报告感。

💡 核心逻辑

这个玩法能出圈，靠的不是“算得准”，而是三个社交传播点。

✋ 第一，每个人的手都不一样
手掌天然具有个性化特征，比普通模板图更像“专属于我”的内容。

🔮 第二，命运感自带好奇心
事业、爱情、财运、性格，这些词天然容易引发点击和评论。

🖤 第三，黑金风格很适合包装玄学内容
深色背景、金色线条、精致标注，一下就把娱乐图做出了“高级报告感”。

一句话理解：

AI看手相的重点，不是预测命运，而是把一张手掌照片包装成一份可分享的神秘学视觉报告。

title: 你花几千块拍的写真，可能还没一张“2003年Flash小游戏截图”有传播力。
prompt:
最近这种玩法特别有意思：
把一张自拍，塞进2000年代早期的换装小游戏界面里。
粉色渐变背景、像素风按钮、闪光星星贴纸、夸张气泡字体、低腰牛仔裤、厚底鞋、爱心墨镜、仿Flash加载条……
一眼看过去，像是放学回家打开4399或小游戏网站时，那个熟悉又土味的界面。
它不追求精致，
而是追求一种准确的粗糙感。

🎯 核心提示词：

将这张自拍照转换成一张2000年代早期的Flash换装游戏截图。照片中的人变成游戏中的换装玩偶角色，放置在界面中央。整个界面采用粉色渐变背景，叠加闪光星星贴纸和Y2K装饰元素。侧边显示像素风格的衣服选择面板，包含蝴蝶结露脐上衣、低腰牛仔裤、厚底鞋、粗项链、爱心墨镜等缩略图。顶部使用圆润气泡字体写“DRESS UP TIME!!!”，下方显示角色名字。加入镜头光晕、闪光GIF动图感元素、仿Flash播放器加载条、旧式播放按钮和“保存装扮”按钮。整体像一张压缩过度的2003年Flash小游戏截图，轻微像素化、过度饱和粉色、低清JPEG质感、复古网页游戏UI风格。

这类提示词的核心结构是：

自拍人物 + Flash游戏界面 + Y2K换装元素 + 粉色渐变UI + 像素按钮 + 低清压缩质感。

💡 核心逻辑

这个玩法的关键，不是把照片变好看，而是把人放进一段集体记忆里。

🎀 第一，怀旧感要准
不是泛泛的复古，而是非常具体的2000年代早期Flash小游戏美学：粉色、像素、按钮、闪光、加载条。

🕹️ 第二，粗糙感要对
低清、压缩、像素边缘、过曝色彩，都是它的味道。
太高清反而不像那个年代。

👤 第三，人要变成“游戏角色”
重点不是给自拍加边框，而是让你看起来像游戏界面里那个可以被换装的小人。

一句话理解：

它不是把自拍做旧，而是把自拍改造成一个2003年的可玩界面。

title: 2026世界杯开幕当天，梅西在Instagram发布了一条视频。
prompt:
他让ChatGPT把自己的头发P成阿根廷国旗的蓝白配色，然后问全网："我应该真的染吗？" 这条视频24小时内引爆全球。
X平台超160万观看，#MessiMode 话题冲上多国热搜，OpenAI官方直接把梅西的提示词加入了ChatGPT预设模板库。

最近 #MessiMode 火起来的核心玩法很简单：
上传一张自拍，让 AI 把你的头发变成国家队国旗配色。
不是夸张杀马特染发，而是尽量做成自然挑染、渐变高光、真实发色过渡。
一张照片，一条提示词，就能把普通自拍变成世界杯应援照。

🎯 核心提示词

原版（梅西同款）：
"Make my hair the colors of my country flag but keep it natural-looking. If no country or image is provided, ask."

想让效果更稳，可以用进阶版：

请保持我的发型、脸部、五官、表情和照片背景不变，只把头发颜色改成受【国家名】国旗启发的渐变配色。发色要自然、真实、有高光和柔和过渡，不要像假发，不要卡通化，整体保持照片级真实感。

这类提示词的核心结构是：

自拍人像 + 国家队配色 + 只改头发 + 自然渐变 + 保持本人特征。

💡 核心逻辑

这个玩法能传播，不是因为技术多复杂，而是因为门槛足够低。

🇦🇷 第一，国旗配色天然有身份感
阿根廷是蓝白，巴西是黄绿，法国是蓝白红，中国是红黄。
颜色一出来，立刻有应援氛围。

💇 第二，“自然感”是关键
如果只是整片染成国旗色，很容易变夸张。
加上“自然外观、渐变、高光、柔和过渡”，AI就会更像真实染发。

📲 第三，一张自拍适配所有人
不用设计能力，不用懂修图。
换一个国家名，就能生成一张自己的世界杯应援图。

一句话理解：

它不是染发滤镜，而是把世界杯身份感，变成每个人都能参与的自拍玩法。
#MessiMode 爆火的本质是：用世界杯这个全球最大IP + 一张自拍 + 一条极简提示词 = 零成本参与顶级热点的方式。
你的粉丝不需要任何设计技能，只需要一张照片，就能"假装"为世界杯染发了
球迷谁能不参与？
author: derek_wall90176

title: 一张“夸张到离谱”的自拍，为什么反而更容易被转发？
prompt:
因为它不追求精修，也不假装高级。
它直接把你的五官、表情、职业和性格放大，变成一张自带幽默感的漫画肖像。
这就是今天的关键词：Caricature 漫画肖像。
它的核心不是把人画美，
而是把一个人的特点放大到让人一眼记住。

🎯 核心提示词

可以直接这样写：

请将这张照片转换成复古游乐园漫画肖像风格。保留人物真实可识别的面部特征，但适度夸张五官、表情和人物气质，例如大眼睛、夸张笑容、明显的脸型特征。画面加入与人物职业或爱好相关的元素，使用鲜艳色彩、粗线条、手绘卡通质感和简洁背景，让人物成为视觉中心。整体适合社交媒体头像和个人品牌展示。

如果想指定职业，可以这样补充：

我是【你的职业】，请在画面中加入【职业相关道具】和【职业场景元素】，让漫画肖像更有故事感。

这类提示词的核心结构是：

自拍人像 + 夸张五官 + 职业元素 + 鲜艳色彩 + 粗线条漫画风 + 简洁背景。

💡 核心逻辑

Caricature 最关键的不是“变卡通”，而是抓住一个人最有记忆点的特征。

👀 第一，五官要夸张
大眼睛、大笑容、特别的脸型、明显的发型，都是漫画肖像的记忆点。

🎒 第二，身份要具体
如果只是画一个人，会有点普通。
但如果加入老师的黑板、设计师的画板、程序员的键盘、厨师的锅铲，人物马上有故事。

😂 第三，要允许一点自嘲感
它好玩就好玩在“不完美”。
比起精修自拍，夸张漫画更容易让人评论、转发和模仿。

一句话理解：

精修照让人看你，漫画肖像让人记住你。

⚙️ 参数技巧 / 关键控制点

想更像本人，可以加：

保留真实面部特征、保留发型、保留表情特征、人物可识别。

想更夸张搞笑，可以加：

夸张五官、大眼睛、大笑容、喜剧化表情、幽默漫画风。

想更有职业故事感，可以加：

职业道具、工作场景、身份元素、个人爱好符号。

想更适合头像，可以加：

正方形构图、简洁背景、人物居中、强识别度。

📌 一句话总结

Caricature 漫画肖像的魅力，不是把自拍变漂亮，而是用夸张、幽默和身份符号，把一个人变成更容易被记住的社交形象。
author: derek_wall90176

title: 如果你想测试 AI 到底有没有“默认审美”，浮世绘可能是最好的试纸。
prompt:
因为它刚好要求 AI 去做三件最不习惯的事：
不要立体感、不要西式光影、不要写实渐变。
浮世绘的核心，是平面色块、强轮廓线、非写实色彩和木版画质感。
但 AI 的本能，往往是偷偷把画面“画成立体”、把脸“修得更有阴影”、把颜色“过渡得更高级”。

所以这个风格最有意思的地方，不只是好看，
而是它能逼 AI 放下很多默认的视觉习惯。

🎯 核心提示词

可以直接这样写：

生成一张【主体】的浮世绘木版画风格作品。采用传统日本浮世绘版画美学，平面色块构图，粗而有力量的轮廓线，可见木版纹理，不对称构图，传统和纸质感，江户时代视觉气质，画面包含【场景描述】。不要三维纵深，不要真实光影，不要柔和渐变，不要西式明暗塑形，不要油画感，不要透视消失点，不要文艺复兴式空间感。

如果想做现代融合版，可以这样改：

生成一张赛博浮世绘风格作品，将【主体】用江户时代浮世绘版画方式重新演绎，加入霓虹元素、电子樱花、未来城市细节，但保留浮世绘的平面色块、黑色轮廓线、木版画质感和和纸肌理。不要西式阴影，不要立体渲染，不要真实皮肤质感。

这类提示词的核心结构是：

主体 + 浮世绘木版画风格 + 平面色块 + 强轮廓线 + 和纸 / 木纹质感 + NO约束词。

💡 核心逻辑

这个玩法最关键的，不是“加一个浮世绘滤镜”，而是不断阻止 AI 回到它熟悉的西式写实路径。

① 平面感要强

浮世绘不是靠透视制造空间，而是靠前后重叠和版面安排来表达层次。
所以一定要强调：

平面色块、不要纵深、不要透视。

② 轮廓线是主角

浮世绘的线条不是辅助，而是骨架。
人物、衣纹、浪、山、树，都要靠线条成立。

所以要强调：

粗轮廓线、手工刻版感、线条有力量。

③ 颜色要“像版画”，不是“像照片”

浮世绘的蓝、红、赭色，本来就带有一种非写实的人工感。
如果 AI 开始给你做柔和渐变、高级肤色过渡，那就偏了。

一句话理解：

做浮世绘，不是让 AI 多学一点，而是让 AI 少做一点。
author: derek_wall90176

title: 最近发现一种特别适合做海报、封面、品牌视觉的 AI 设计方向：
prompt:
复古弥散渐变。
它不是普通渐变背景，
不是 PPT 封面，
也不是廉价赛博霓虹图。
它更像一张独立杂志封面、艺术展海报、实验音乐海报，或者设计工作室作品集里的视觉稿。
核心气质是：
复古弥散 + 编辑排版 + 胶片颗粒 + 印刷噪点 + 抽象色彩 + 高级留白。

🎯 核心提示词：

请围绕【主题词】生成一张高级复古弥散渐变概念海报。整体风格参考独立杂志封面、艺术展海报、实验音乐海报和先锋品牌视觉。画面包含柔和扩散的色块、雾化边缘、胶片颗粒、印刷噪点、扫描质感、纸张纹理、抽象几何元素和高级编辑排版。主标题必须清晰可读，排版有秩序，有留白，有设计感。不要人物脸，不要电商感，不要廉价霓虹，不要PPT模板感。

这类提示词的核心结构是：

主题词 + 抽象色彩系统 + 弥散渐变 + 印刷颗粒 + 编辑排版 + 高级留白。

💡 核心逻辑

这个玩法的关键，不是“做一个好看的渐变背景”，而是建立一套完整的视觉系统。

第一，颜色要有主逻辑。
可以高饱和，也可以低饱和；可以单色系，也可以双色冲突。但不能变成廉价彩虹渐变。

第二，弥散要有方向。
颜色可以横向扫描、纵向雾化、边缘压入、中央留白，也可以像胶片显影一样慢慢浮出来。

第三，文字要站得住。
主标题必须清晰可读。设计感不是让字看不懂，而是让文字和画面形成秩序。

一句话理解：

让颜色会呼吸，让文字有位置，让留白有节奏。

🔁 延伸玩法

🎵 实验音乐海报
可以用强烈对比色、重颗粒、压迫式大标题，适合演出、派对、声音艺术主题。

🖼️ 艺术展海报
适合低饱和雾面色彩、大留白、细字体和抽象几何，整体更克制、更高级。

📚 知识卡片封面
可以用浅色底、清晰标题、柔和弥散背景，适合做“每日一词”“研究笔记”“专题观察”。

🛍️ 品牌视觉主图
用统一色彩系统和排版结构，可以延展成品牌活动海报、社媒封面、公众号头图。

🌐 X / 微博封面
横版可以强调标题识别度，竖版可以做成杂志封面感，适合个人IP栏目包装。

📌 一句话总结

复古弥散渐变海报的魅力，不在于渐变本身，而在于它能把抽象色彩、印刷质感和编辑排版，变成一张真正有设计语言的作品。
author: derek_wall90176

title: 今天这个词，特别适合想把一张普通照片，变成 有辨识度、有质感、有故事感 插画作品的人。
prompt:
它的重点不是“套滤镜”，
而是让 AI 像真正的插画师一样，重新画一遍。

先用墨线和铅笔线重建人物轮廓、五官、头发、衣服褶皱、手部动作和场景透视，
再用低饱和淡水彩轻轻铺色，
最后加上英文手写批注、箭头、圈注和草稿线。

出来的效果，不像照片做旧，
而像一张真正的 复古时尚插画手稿 / 电影分镜观察页 / 设计师速写稿。✨

📌 核心提示词可以这样写：

请基于上传的人物照片，创作一张真人可识别的手绘时尚漫画素描插画。不是照片滤镜，不是简单水彩化，而是像真正的插画师重新绘制：先用松弛但克制的墨线和铅笔速写线，重建人物轮廓、五官结构、头发走势、手部动作、服装褶皱和场景透视；再用低饱和淡水彩上色，保留旧纸质感、留白和晕染感。画面加入英文手写批注、箭头、圈注、设计草稿线和电影分镜式观察感。人物要保留原照片相似度，但必须明显是手绘重绘效果。整体风格像复古时尚插画、杂志人物速写、设计师观察页。

如果想更稳，可以再加：
✅ 保留人物真实相似度
✅ 保留原场景记忆点
✅ 只使用英文手写批注
✅ 画面像独立插画纸页，不要做成笔记本页面

💡 这个玩法为什么值得用？

1️⃣ 不是滤镜感，而是真正的重绘感
脸部线条、鼻梁、嘴唇、下颌线、衣服褶皱，都会像手稿一样被重新画出来。

2️⃣ 自带设计师草稿页氛围
批注、箭头、圈注、修正线一出来，创作感立刻有了。

3️⃣ 天然有电影感
它不是普通插画，更像复古杂志插图 + 电影分镜 + 美术观察稿的结合体。

🎨 适合这些场景：
🏔️ 山地 / 徒步 / 旅行
🏙️ 街头 / 店铺 / 建筑
🚗 车内 / 室内 / 日常
🏛️ 博物馆 / 古迹 / 历史空间

⚠️ 几个关键控制点：

人物一定要重绘：不要保留照片质感
线条是核心：脸、手、衣服褶皱要有明显线稿
颜色要轻：淡水彩、暖灰、浅赭色就够了
批注只用英文：更像设计师观察页
旧纸感要有，但不能太脏

🔁 延伸玩法也很多：
👗 时尚人物版
🧳 旅行观察版
💑 情侣 / 双人版
🛍️ 品牌视觉版
📷 个人纪念版

一句话总结：
这个玩法最迷人的地方，不是把照片“变成插画”，而是把照片 重新画成一张有态度、有观察感的手稿
author: derek_wall90176

title: 一张光线昏暗、背景杂乱、甚至有点邋遢的自拍，为什么能秒变杂志大片？
prompt:
最近很火的这个玩法，本质不是“修图”，而是 AI影棚重绘。
传统修图是在原照片上磨皮、调色、换背景；
AI影棚更像是根据你的面部特征，重新生成一张符合专业摄影标准的形象照。
它会理解：
什么是杂志大片的光影，什么是高级背景，什么是专业构图，什么是人物质感。
所以效果往往不是“变白变瘦”，而是整张图的气质被重新拉高。

📸 核心提示词：

请基于我上传的这张自拍照，生成一张高级时尚杂志风格的人像大片。保留人物真实五官特征、脸型、发型和个人气质，但重新塑造专业影棚光线、干净高级背景、浅景深、柔和皮肤质感和电影级色调。整体像专业摄影师拍摄的杂志封面形象照，光影精致，构图高级，人物自然自信，不要像过度磨皮修图。

🔁 可以怎么玩？

💼 职场形象照
适合简历头像、领英头像、商务介绍页。关键词可以加：专业、干净背景、商务肖像、高级灰。

🎨 艺术写真
可以尝试复古、黑白、胶片、科幻、电影感等不同方向，适合做头像系列。

💍 婚纱 / 情侣预演
先用AI试风格、试光影、试构图，再决定真实拍摄方案。

📱 社交媒体头像组图
同一张自拍生成不同风格：杂志风、电影风、职场风、街拍风，做一套个人IP视觉。

🛍️ 产品模特图
用人物自拍生成更干净的商品展示照，适合服装、配饰、生活方式品牌预览。

⚙️ 几个实用技巧

想更像杂志大片，可以加：
时尚杂志封面、专业影棚灯光、浅景深、高级商业摄影。

想更自然，可以加：
保留真实五官、自然皮肤纹理、不过度磨皮、真实人物气质。

想更高级，可以加：
高级灰背景、柔和轮廓光、电影级色调、极简构图。

尽量少用“美颜”“磨皮”“变好看”这类词。
这些词容易让画面变成普通修图感。

更推荐写：
重绘、专业摄影、杂志大片、影棚光线、保留真实特征。

📌 使用提醒

AI影棚的底层逻辑更接近“重绘”，不是在原图上精修。

所以多轮修改后，可能会出现一些细节变化：
比如痣变淡、眼型变精致、发际线变化、五官被轻微理想化。
想保留本人特征，一定要反复强调：
保留真实五官、保留脸型、保留发型、保留个人气质。

一句话总结

AI影棚的价值，不是把一张自拍修得更完美，而是让普通人也能拥有一次“杂志大片级”的虚拟拍摄。
一张自拍，就是你的随身影棚。
author: derek_wall90176

title: 【AI绘画每日一词】极致 Oversized 穿搭照
prompt:
一条提示词为什么让Instagram的用户疯狂?
发现一个在IG真正出圈的AI玩法：

不是换脸，不是美颜，也不是普通换装，
而是把你身上的衣服直接变成夸张到不可能存在的巨型 Oversized 穿搭。
简单说，就是：
脸、发型、姿势、背景都不变，只把衣服放大到 4 到 6 倍。
袖子宽到垂过手掌，裤腿大到像气球，布料堆在脚边，整个人像从未来时尚大片里走出来。
它最有意思的地方在于：
这不是把衣服“P大一点”，而是用 AI 生成一种现实里很难拍出来的极端廓形。

👕 核心提示词
可以这样写：

请将上传照片中人物身上的服装，自动转换成极致 Oversized、巨大、宽松、松垮的时尚造型。不需要参考图，只基于人物原本穿着的衣服进行改造。上衣放大到身体的4到6倍，袖子极宽、蓬松，并垂到手掌以下。裤子变成超宽松、气球感、堆叠在脚边的廓形。增加大量布料体积、夸张褶皱、自然垂坠感和厚重轮廓，让整套穿搭看起来夸张但真实。严格保留人物真实面部、发型、肤色、姿势、身体角度和背景不变，同时保持原服装的风格和颜色主题。

✨ 为什么这个玩法容易出圈？

因为它打破了大家对 AI 修图的旧印象。

以前 AI 换装，大多是在“变好看”“变精致”“变显瘦”。
但这个玩法反过来：
它不追求日常合理，而是追求视觉冲击力。

普通自拍，一眼划过。
极致 Oversized，一眼停住。

它很像高级时尚摄影、概念服装大片和后期合成的结合，但操作门槛非常低：
一张自拍，加一段提示词，就能生成一张“不可能穿搭照”。
🔁 可以怎么延伸？
🧥 品牌概念大片
让模特穿品牌基础款，一键生成未来廓形视觉，适合做新品预热、概念海报和社媒话题图。

📸 UGC互动活动
品牌可以让粉丝上传自拍，生成自己的 Oversized 版本，参与感强，也很容易带动转发。
🎤 MV / 歌手视觉
给歌手、演员、虚拟人生成夸张舞台造型，适合做音乐封面、视觉设定和短片概念图。

🧪 风格混搭实验
在提示词后面加入“赛博朋克风”“中式汉服元素”“未来街头风”“高定秀场风”，就能做出更强的视觉语言。
🛍️ 反向虚拟试衣
别人都在做“显瘦穿搭”，你可以反过来做“巨型穿搭”，更容易在信息流里被记住。

⚙️ 几个实用技巧

想更夸张，可以加：
巨大廓形、超宽袖子、气球裤、厚重布料、戏剧化比例。
想更真实，可以加：
自然垂坠、真实褶皱、布料重量感、服装与身体自然接触。

想保留本人特征，一定要加：
严格保留真实面部、发型、姿势、背景和身体角度。
想更像时尚大片，可以加：
高级街拍、时尚编辑大片、秀场造型、杂志封面质感。

📌 一句话总结
极致 Oversized 穿搭照的魅力，不是让你看起来更日常，而是让一张普通自拍瞬间变成一张“不可能存在的时尚大片”。

它真正厉害的地方在于：
用最简单的方式，实现最极端的创意。
author: derek_wall90176

title: 【AI绘画每日一词】Y2K DV摄像机
prompt:
现在最容易出片的复古风，不是把照片修得更清晰，而是让照片“变得更像旧机器拍的”。

不是简单加噪点，也不是故意变糊，
而是复刻 2003 年 Mini DV 摄像机的画面感：

冷色调室内光、闪光灯过曝、低分辨率颗粒、轻微画面失真、右下角时间戳。

这种“画质差”，反而有一种真实的年代感。

📹 核心提示词

可以直接这样写：

把这张照片修成用2003年的廉价DV摄像机拍出来的效果。添加时间戳叠加、过曝的闪光灯、低分辨率颗粒感、轻度VHS画面失真，以及冷色调室内光线。整体像一段从旧DV录像里截出来的画面，真实、粗糙、怀旧，有千禧年家庭录像质感。

💡 为什么这个风格容易出圈？

因为现在的 AI 图太完美了。

过度锐化、过度磨皮、过度干净，反而容易让人一眼看出“AI味”。
而 DV 摄像机风格刚好相反。

它有颗粒、有偏色、有闪光灯过曝，有一点点廉价设备的粗糙感。
这些“不完美”，反而让画面更像真实发生过。

它最打动人的地方，不是高清，而是记忆感。

📺 画面通常会出现什么效果？

冷色调的室内灯光
右下角的日期和时间戳
闪光灯打出来的白色光晕
轻微的VHS扫描线和画面失真
低分辨率颗粒感
像旧录像截图一样的随手感

⚙️ 几个实用技巧

想更旧，可以加：
90年代末DV画质、严重颗粒、轻微磁带损坏、画面抖动。

想更像家庭录像，可以加：
手持拍摄、室内闪光灯、时间戳、随手记录感。

想更有氛围，可以加：
冷色调室内光、低饱和、轻微失焦、旧录像截图。

想更适合社交媒体，可以加：
真实自拍感、朋友随手拍、低清但有情绪、怀旧生活记录。

📌 一句话总结

Y2K DV摄像机风格的魅力，不是把照片修得更精致，而是把照片修回“曾经真的发生过”的样子。
当所有人都在追求高清和完美时，粗糙、低清、过曝、时间戳，反而成了最有情绪的视觉语言。
author: derek_wall90176

title: 【AI绘画每日一词·高考特辑】把梦想大学装进你的剪影
prompt:
马上就要高考了。

朋友圈一定会被“高考加油”“金榜题名”刷屏。
但今年，我更想分享一种不一样的祝福方式：

把你的脸，和你的梦校，放进同一张海报里。
不是贴纸，不是普通拼图，而是很有氛围感的复古双重曝光。

学生的侧脸轮廓里，慢慢长出那座向往已久的校园：
图书馆、校门、湖边、林荫道、红墙绿树……

就像这所大学，其实早就住进了你的身体里。
你现在要做的，只是一步一步，朝它走过去。

🎓 核心提示词

可以直接这样写：

生成一张复古双重曝光风格海报。主体是一位高中生朝右侧的侧脸剪影，保留真实的面部轮廓与坚定神情。剪影内部融合【大学名称】的标志性校园景观，如【具体建筑 / 景观描述】。整体采用温暖的黄昏金色光线、柔和雾气、复古哑光色调和轻微胶片颗粒，画面有梦想感、鼓舞感与电影海报质感。底部加入简洁优雅的小字，可写校训或一句激励短句。

如果想要更高级一点，可以加这些关键词：

电影感、杂志大片质感、复古胶片、柔和光晕、空间层次、梦境氛围、鼓舞人心。

🔁 还能怎么延伸？

① 家长送考版
把父母和孩子做成并排侧脸剪影，里面融合同一所大学。
这类图特别适合送考当天发，情绪很强。

② 班级纪念版
做一排学生侧脸，每个人的剪影里装着不同的梦想大学。
很适合毕业季、班级海报、同学群头像。

③ 录取通知书版
等成绩出来之后，可以把背景换成“录取通知书质感”，更有仪式感。

④ 对比成长版
左边是高三阶段的书桌、试卷、台灯，右边是大学校园。
一张图就能把“从题海走向理想”讲清楚。

⚙️ 几个实用技巧

侧脸方向：建议朝右，更像“面向未来”。
表情描述：建议写“坚定、平静、克制”，比“开心”更适合高考主题。
光线选择：黄昏金色光最好，天然有希望感。
雾气浓度：写“柔和雾气”就够了，太浓会把建筑吞掉。
文字排版：底部留一句短句就好，比如“前路有光，终会抵达”。

📌 一句话总结

学生侧脸做壳，梦想校园做魂。

这类海报最动人的地方，不是喊口号，
而是让人一眼看到：

原来梦想，真的可以长在一个人的轮廓里。
author: derek_wall90176

title: 世界杯氛围一起来，朋友圈和社媒很容易被球星卡刷屏。
prompt:
但这次，卡面上的人不一定是职业球员，也可以是你自己。
今天这个玩法，就是把一张普通自拍，变成一张有收藏感的世界杯全息球星卡。
它的核心不是“把照片修帅”，而是给你加上一层身份感：

金色背景、全息镭射、体育场灯光、国家队球衣、传奇级卡面标题。
一眼看过去，就像你真的站上了赛场。

🎴 核心提示词：

生成一张世界杯全息球星收藏卡。画面采用金色背景，带有金属反光、星光和发光细节。主角穿着【国家队】球衣，做出进球庆祝动作。整体画面真实、有体育场灯光、金色边框和高级收藏卡质感。卡片底部醒目写着“LEGENDARIO”。竖版构图，高级球星卡设计，全息镭射效果，收藏级视觉风格。

这类提示词的关键结构是：

人物自拍 + 国家队球衣 + 庆祝动作 + 全息金卡 + 体育场灯光 + 传奇标题。

不是普通修图，而是把自己做成“限量收藏卡”。

✨ 为什么它容易出圈？

因为它解决的不是“好不好看”，而是“有没有分享欲”。
普通自拍大家看一眼就划走。
但如果是一张球星卡，别人会忍不住停下来：

“这也太像真的了吧？”
“你这是哪队的传奇卡？”
“能不能帮我也做一张？”

社交媒体最吃的，就是这种低门槛、高身份感、容易模仿的内容。

🔁 可以怎么变？

⚽ 国家队版本
把【国家队】换成你支持的球队，球衣、配色和氛围都会跟着变化。

🏆 俱乐部版本
把世界杯换成欧冠、英超、俱乐部收藏卡，适合球迷、运动品牌和赛事内容。

🎮 电竞选手版
把球衣换成战队队服，背景换成电竞舞台，底部文字从“LEGENDARIO”改成“MVP”，立刻变成电竞选手卡。

🎓 人生纪念卡
毕业照可以做成“毕业限定卡”，婚礼照可以做成“人生高光卡”，比普通精修照片更有仪式感。

👥 组合收藏卡
情侣、兄弟、闺蜜、团队合照，都可以做成“双人传奇卡”或“三人组合卡”，互动感更强。

⚙️ 几个实用技巧

想让卡面更高级，可以加：
彩虹全息镭射、棱镜折射、烫金压纹、金属边框。

想让人物更像球员，可以加：
进球庆祝动作、体育场聚光灯、观众席背景、运动员姿态。

📌 一句话总结

世界杯全息球星卡的魅力，不是把自拍变得更好看，而是把普通人包装成一张“值得收藏的传奇卡”。
把【国家队】换成你支持的队伍，生成属于你的传奇卡吧。
author: derek_wall90176

title: 【AI绘画每日一词】动态模糊都市电影感
prompt:
还在觉得 AI 生成的照片太“静”、太像摆拍吗？

今天这个词，专门解决一个问题：让画面动起来。
很多电影感照片之所以有冲击力，不只是因为光影好，而是因为它同时抓住了“清晰”和“模糊”。
主体是清楚的，背景是流动的。
人是定住的，城市是飞驰的。
这就是今天的关键词：
动态模糊都市电影感。

🎬 核心提示词
可以直接这样写：

保持主体完全清晰，但为城市灯光和背景加入强烈的动态模糊效果。加入光轨、轻微镜头抖动和快速移动的能量感，让画面像动作电影中的一幕。主体稳定突出，背景高速流动，整体具有都市夜景、电影感、速度感和强烈叙事氛围。

这句提示词最关键的地方，是它明确告诉 AI：
主体要清晰，背景要模糊。
这不是简单加滤镜，而是在控制画面里的“动”与“静”。

💡 为什么它有效？

动态模糊最适合制造电影感，因为它能让一张静态图看起来像某个动作瞬间。

主体清晰，是视觉锚点；
背景流动，是速度和情绪；
光轨和镜头抖动，是城市正在高速运转的证据。

比如一个穿风衣的人站在东京街头回头看镜头，人物面部和衣服是清楚的，但身后的车流、霓虹灯、广告牌全部拉成光带。

画面立刻就从普通街拍，变成了动作电影开场。

🔁 可以怎么变化？
🏃 夜跑者版本
主体换成夜跑运动员，背景是被拉成光带的城市天际线，适合运动品牌、跑步内容和城市生活方式。

🏍️ 机车骑士版本
骑手和机车保持清晰，两侧路灯、隧道、建筑高速模糊，适合做速度感、潮流感和机车大片。

☔ 雨中行人版本
人物撑伞静立，雨丝、车灯和湿润街面反光变成流动线条，氛围会更文艺、更像都市电影。

🌉 天桥情侣版本
两个人在天桥上清晰定格，桥下车流变成浪漫光河，适合情绪短片、爱情主题和夜景封面。

🌃 赛博朋克版本
加入霓虹灯、未来城市、电子屏、冷暖色撞色，光轨会更迷幻，适合科幻感视觉。

⚙️ 几个实用技巧

想让速度更强，可以加：
强烈动态模糊、高速光轨、飞驰感、背景快速掠过。
想让画面更稳，可以加：
主体完全清晰、面部锐利、人物边缘清楚。

想让电影感更强，可以加：
低机位、广角镜头、动作电影场景、夜晚都市、戏剧性光影。
想更有情绪，可以加：
雨夜、雾气、湿润街道、霓虹反光、轻微胶片颗粒。

想减少过度模糊，可以用：
轻微镜头抖动、适度动态模糊、背景模糊但主体清晰。

🧩 万能公式

以后想做这类图，可以直接套这个结构：
保持【主体】完全清晰，让【背景环境】产生动态模糊，加入【光轨 / 镜头抖动 / 雨夜反光 / 霓虹灯】，营造【速度感 / 电影感 / 都市叙事感】。

📌 一句话总结

动态模糊都市电影感的核心，不是让整张图都糊，而是精准控制：
主体是锚，背景是浪。

锚越稳，浪越强，画面就越有速度感和故事感。
author: derek_wall90176

title: 【AI绘画每日一词】定格动画风
prompt:
今天这个词，专门解决 AI 生图里一个很常见的问题：

太像 AI 了。

很多 AI 图很精致、很高清、很完美。
但也正因为太完美，反而少了一点真实的温度。

定格动画风刚好相反。

它有黏土材质、手捏痕迹、轻微不规则的边缘，还有一种像童年动画片一样的柔软感。

不是追求“完美 CG”，而是故意保留手工感。

这就是它容易出片的原因。

---

核心提示词可以直接这样写：

将这张人像转换成定格动画风格的黏土角色。人物保留原本的五官特征、表情和姿势，但整体看起来像由彩色黏土手工捏制而成。皮肤和服装有柔软圆润的黏土质感，能看到轻微的雕刻痕迹和手作纹理。使用温暖的摄影棚灯光，干净背景，画面可爱、治愈、有手工动画质感。

核心结构是：

原始人像
+ 保留相似度
+ 黏土材质
+ 手捏痕迹
+ 温暖灯光
+ 干净背景

---

为什么它容易降低 AI 味？

因为黏土本身就不是完美材质。

它不需要皮肤特别真实，也不需要边缘特别精准。
轻微的不规则、手作痕迹、材质瑕疵，反而会让画面更可信。

很多时候，AI 图的问题不是不够精致，而是太精致。

定格动画风的价值，就是把“完美”主动打碎一点。

---

可以怎么变？

定格全家福：
把一家人变成黏土角色，适合亲子、家庭、纪念照。

定格宠物：
猫狗不必追求真实毛发，重点是圆润、呆萌、有表情。

定格美食：
汉堡、蛋糕、披萨、冰淇淋都很适合黏土质感。

定格情侣：
两个人在微缩小屋里喝茶、看电影、做饭，温馨感会很强。

定格反派：
加暗色背景、低角度灯光、夸张表情，就能做出黏土动画反派起源感。

---

几个实用技巧：

想保留本人特征，加：

保留五官相似度、保留原本表情、保留人物姿势。

想更有手工感，加：

可见手捏痕迹、黏土雕刻纹理、轻微不规则边缘。

想更治愈，加：

温暖灯光、柔和色彩、圆润造型、干净背景。

想更电影感，加：

微缩场景、戏剧性灯光、定格动画电影质感、故事化构图。

---

万能公式：

把【主体】转换成定格动画风格的黏土角色，保留【关键特征】，加入【黏土材质】、【手作痕迹】、【温暖灯光】和【微缩场景】，整体可爱、治愈、有手工动画质感。

---

一句话总结：

定格动画风的魅力，不是让画面更真实，而是让画面更像“被人亲手做出来”。

当大家都在追求高清和完美时，有一点手工感，反而更容易让人停下来。

你觉得 AI 图最明显的“AI 味”是什么？
author: derek_wall90176

title: 【AIGC每日一词】星座海报
prompt:
一张普通自拍，为什么能变成让人忍不住转发的星座海报？

最近很火的一个 AI 玩法，就是把自拍做成 Yumi’s Cells 风格的星座海报：
主角还是你自己，但身边会出现一群迷你 3D 小人，像“情绪细胞”一样，把你的星座性格直接可视化。
它好玩的地方在于：

星座本身就是天然社交货币

抽象性格被变成了看得见的小人动作和表情
韩系软萌 3D 审美，天然适合传播
个性化很强，不是模板图，而是“你自己的星座画像”
核心提示词：

title: 极简女性
prompt:
Create an ultra-premium vertical advertising poster for Starbucks Cold Brew, preserving the same minimalist editorial skeleton while pushing the image into a more flagship, more sculptural, and more internationally fashion-magazine-level direction. Keep the composition built from a large field of clean negative space in the upper half and an extreme macro close-up of the cup rim, cold brew surface, and ice structure dominating the lower half. The final result should feel like a hybrid of a world-class Starbucks campaign, a luxury beverage poster, and a collectible international magazine cover: light, cold, precise, modern, and visually unforgettable.

The hero product is Starbucks Cold Brew shown in an extreme macro close-up focused on the very top rim of the cup. The lower half of the poster must be dominated by the cup edge, the liquid meniscus, and a dense frozen landscape of crystal-clear ice rising above the rim. The cup should emerge from the bottom edge of the frame so only the upper portion is visible, making the viewer feel intimately close to the drink. The rim must be hyper-realistic: thin transparent edge, subtle glass thickness, wet reflections, elegant refraction, tiny cold condensation beads, meltwater traces, and perfect surface tension. The cold brew inside must feel dark, deep, and luxurious, with black-brown density, amber undertones, chilled transparency, and beautiful depth beneath the ice.

Push the cold-drink identity to an even more extreme level. The interaction between coffee and ice should be astonishingly rich in detail: large angular ice cubes, fractured transparent planes, trapped air bubbles, melting edges, floating smaller ice fragments, cold condensation droplets clinging to the cup, micro-beads of water, faint cooling haze, and sharp liquid transitions where dark coffee meets thinner translucent zones. The lower macro area should feel like an icy coffee world or a cold-brew geological cutaway, highly tactile and physically believable.

Preserve the same poster logic, but boldly reconstruct the lower beverage zone into a more sculptural and iconic frozen landscape. Let the ice cluster at the rim feel less like ordinary drink styling and more like a monumental cold-brew horizon: cracked clear ice peaks, wet reflective ridges, dark liquid depth below, subtle meltwater channels, and refined tonal separation between transparent ice, amber light, and dense coffee shadow. The drink should feel monumental while remaining product-true and hyper-real.

Refine the upper text system completely so it feels lighter, colder, and more like the cover language of an international design or lifestyle magazine. Use a clean, airy, editorial English title such as "Cold Brew" or "COLD / BREW" with elegant spacing, taller vertical rhythm, and restrained sophistication. Pair it with a short handwritten-style line that feels cool, intelligent, and fresh, such as "deep chill", "slow and cold", "stay crisp", or "cool begins here". Add a very subtle Starbucks siren mark or official brand signature, plus a few tiny editorial fragments or fine-line supporting copy arranged with the intelligence of a collectible magazine cover. Typography must feel black or deep charcoal, crisp, modern, slightly fashion-oriented, and premium, with only the most restrained use of Starbucks green if needed.

The text composition must no longer feel warm or cafe-like. It should feel colder, more airy, more modern, and more internationally editorial. Let the title float with elegant asymmetry, the handwritten note arc gently or lean lightly through the negative space, and small copy fragments behave like magazine-cover coverlines without clutter. The typography should echo the line of the rim and the geometry of the ice below, creating a strong dialogue between graphic design and product form. The upper half should feel spacious, calm, and expensive.

Lighting must be extremely soft, crisp, and premium, with more coolness and brightness than a standard coffee ad. Use delicate highlights on ice edges, refined reflections on the cup rim, wet sparkle on condensation droplets, soft luminous gradients inside the coffee, and impeccable tonal control from deep cold-brew brown to translucent amber to icy clear highlights. Every ice fracture, droplet, and liquid shift must feel macro-photography-grade, razor-sharp yet elegant. The realism must be extreme, but the mood remains clean, quiet, cold, and premium.

Keep the palette tightly controlled: pale cool beige or soft stone background above, deep cold-brew brown, near-black coffee depth, translucent amber light, clear ice highlights, soft silver-gray chill reflections, and only minimal restrained Starbucks green for tiny brand cues. title: 电影感女性
prompt:
Create an ultra-premium vertical 4-panel viennoiserie campaign board, preserving the same refined 2x2 editorial grid and the same floating incomplete-pastry concept, but push both the main direction and the same-bone refinement into a more collectible, more sculptural, and more internationally premium result. The four pastries remain:
1. Butter Croissant
2. Pain au Chocolat
3. Almond Croissant
4. Pain aux Raisins

The whole composition must feel like a world-class luxury bakery campaign selected for an international design annual: hyper-real, minimal, high-speed, visually expensive, and irresistibly product-led. Each panel should show one real pastry frozen in mid-air at the most beautiful incomplete instant: partially broken, gently opened, subtly unraveled, or revealing its most delicious internal structure. The pastries must feel like suspended edible sculptures, caught in a refined moment of interruption rather than a messy explosion.

Preserve the same 2x2 grid structure and one-pastry-per-panel logic, but push the visual sophistication further. Each pastry should appear more monumental, more isolated, and more iconically framed within its own panel. Increase the elegance of the suspended fragments: flakes, crumbs, chocolate shards, almond slices, powdered sugar, raisins, and tiny pastry particles should float with clearer spacing, greater intentionality, and more beautiful high-speed rhythm. Every detail must feel art-directed and premium, not chaotic.

Panel 1, Butter Croissant:
Show a real Butter Croissant suspended in a partially opened state, with the laminated shell separating just enough to reveal its airy honeycomb interior. Tiny buttery flakes and crisp layered shards float around it with delicate spacing. The croissant should feel light, golden, and architectural in form, with deeply resolved layer detail and warm baked gloss. Refine the color world toward pale butter-gold, warm cream, toasted beige, and very soft apricot undertones, keeping the background clean and luxurious.

Panel 2, Pain au Chocolat:
Show a real Pain au Chocolat frozen in a dramatic partial split or torn-open moment, revealing rich dark chocolate batons or molten chocolate interior. Surround it with a restrained field of cocoa dust, pastry flakes, and tiny chocolate fragments floating in elegant suspension. The exterior should feel dense and laminated, with strong contrast between crisp pastry shell and dark glossy filling. Refine this panel into a deeper roasted palette of cocoa brown, dark truffle, muted burgundy, and warm taupe for stronger richness.

Panel 3, Almond Croissant:
Show a real Almond Croissant suspended in a partially broken reveal, where almond slices, powdered sugar, buttery layers, and creamy frangipane-like interior are all visible with refined clarity. Floating almond flakes, sugar dust, and micro pastry crumbs should orbit the pastry in a graceful, high-speed stillness. The croissant must feel indulgent, textured, and deeply layered. Refine the palette into creamy almond-beige, soft ivory, muted sand, and pale golden tones with a lighter, more elegant atmosphere than the other panels.

Panel 4, Pain aux Raisins:
Show a real Pain aux Raisins in a dynamic incomplete state, with the spiral partially opening or subtly unraveling to expose glossy glaze, raisin clusters, laminated pastry rings, and sticky crisp edges. Let a few raisins, sugar crystals, and fine crumbs float around it with sculptural elegance. The pastry should feel glossy, coiled, layered, and richly rhythmic. Refine the palette into deeper wine-raisin, warm caramel, muted plum, and pastry gold to give it a more luxurious jewel-like finish.

Push the same-bone refinement by making the four color systems more clearly separated and more intelligently contrasted:
Butter Croissant = light buttery gold world,
Pain au Chocolat = dark cocoa world,
Almond Croissant = pale creamy almond world,
Pain aux Raisins = rich raisin-wine world.
The contrast between the four panels must be stronger at first glance, while the full sheet still feels like one highly curated campaign family.

Typography must remain minimal, elegant, and English only, but quieter and more collectible than before. Use only a concise product title for each panel and perhaps one tiny handwritten-style or editorial micro-accent if necessary. The text should be light, airy, and secondary, with generous spacing and premium hierarchy. It must feel like a design-journal caption rather than advertising copy. Keep the brand system subtle and refined.

Lighting must be exceptionally delicate, soft, and premium, but also precise enough to reveal micro pastry detail. Use high-speed studio lighting with elegant directional control so the pastries, flakes, crumbs, sugar dust, chocolate, almonds, raisins, and glaze all feel hyper-real and tactile. Add subtle airborne dust, premium print grain, and razor-sharp detail while keeping the image clean and luxurious.

The final 4-panel board should feel like a set of four collectible pastry portraits: one family of viennoiserie, four distinct flavor worlds, one unified floating high-speed visual language, and a stronger premium contrast between the panels.

Avoid crowded props, avoid table scenes, avoid cartoon styling, avoid repeated visual logic within panels, avoid flat lighting, avoid chaotic explosion effects, avoid generic bakery-ad design, avoid heavy typography, avoid low-detail pastry structure.

左眼眼尾下方点着一颗极小的红痣，颜色像一滴未干的朱砂。它并不张扬，却恰好成为整张脸最鲜明的记忆点，让原本干净的气质里多出一点若有若无的艳色。很多人与他擦肩而过后，未必记得五官，却总会记得那颗红痣。

核心气质：风流感与帝王气的完美统一。他身上兼有江湖侠客的飘逸洒脱，与庙堂帝王的睥睨威严。能折扇轻摇、面带浅笑行走江湖，也能龙袍加身、眼神凌厉俯瞰众臣。

头型：头骨饱满，颅顶高。
眉眼间距适中，剑眉入鬓，眉骨高挺，眉毛浓密修长，斜飞向上。这赋予了他十足的英气，压住了偏秀美的脸型，达到刚柔并济的平衡。
眼型是标准的桃花眼，内眼角尖细下勾，眼波流转间神采飞扬。眼神“收放自如”，柔情时如春水含情，威严时如冷电破空，聪明、狡黠、深情、决绝都能从中读出。
山根极高，鼻梁挺直如悬胆，从眉心到鼻尖一气呵成，线条极其优美。鼻头精致微带鹰钩，这为他增添了帝王相的孤绝、城府与距离感。
上唇薄而清晰，下唇弧度优雅，嘴角天然微微上扬。这种唇形让他笑起来春风化雨，极具亲和力；紧闭时又显得刚毅果决。
耳朵贴面，耳垂厚大。传统相学中极具福气的耳相，也为清癯的面容增加了稳重感。
发色纯黑，发质柔顺有光泽，发量浓密。以露出额头的利落短发为主，突显成熟稳重。
四肢修长，手臂动作舒展大方。手指极其修长、白皙、骨节分明。
拥有一双令人羡慕的大长腿，小腿修长笔直。脚型瘦长。。
肤色偏白皙，肤质细腻。
嘴角含笑，眼神悠远，静立时也充满故事感，仿佛在欣赏远处风景，又像在思考千古迷局。
超精细，8K分辨率，使用105mm微距镜头拍摄以捕捉极致皮肤纹理，可见原生毛孔，自然动态细纹，电影级商业影棚布光，柔和主光，人物面部补光，浅景深，浅灰色背景。

title: 一张具有真实高端智能手机直拍质感的3:4竖幅办公室人像。一位…
prompt:
一张具有真实高端智能手机直拍质感的3:4竖幅办公室人像。一位明确成年的女性侧坐在现代开放式办公室的白色办公桌边缘，镜头位于桌面或腰部附近，从人物正前方略偏左的位置进行约15至25度的近距离低机位仰拍，使用约24至28毫米全画幅等效焦段。近距离广角透视自然放大了画面右下方靠近镜头的髋部和大腿，同时左侧一台大型黑色电脑显示器形成明显的前景遮挡，构图略有偏移，办公室垂直线带轻微透视倾斜，不要做成标准棚拍。

人物拥有深棕黑色长发，发根自然蓬松，中间略偏侧分，两侧长刘海贴着脸颊延伸，发尾形成松散、有重量感的大波浪。头发在冷白顶灯下呈现柔和棕色高光和轻微丝缎光泽，保留几缕自然分离的发丝，不要过度对称。她的脸型偏长椭圆，柔和下颌线，细窄鼻梁，饱满唇形和略微上扬的眼型。妆容参考东亚流行审美语境中的粉调明星妆：玫瑰粉眼影、精细眼线、纤长睫毛，眼下和鼻梁周围带粉色晕染，冷粉腮红横向覆盖双颊与鼻尖，嘴唇为水润的玫瑰豆沙色玻璃唇。她轻微眯眼并直视镜头，头部稍稍后仰，嘴唇柔软地轻启，像刚刚说完一句话，又像下一秒正准备开口。

她身穿黑色或深炭灰色细竖条纹双排扣西装式超短连衣裙，长袖、宽翻领、深V领口、略带结构感的肩部和明显收束的腰线。深V领内部露出灰白色蕾丝胸衣边缘以及上胸中央与乳沟，但保持原图的克制范围，不增加额外裸露。红色办公室挂绳从颈部垂落并经过领口，透明工作证卡套悬在左侧显示器附近；颈部还有一条极细银色项链和小型弧形吊坠。西装面料应有中等厚度和轻微硬挺感，在腰部、手臂内侧、坐姿髋部和超短下摆处形成自然褶皱、拉扯与不对称折叠，不要像乳胶紧身衣。

人物骨盆向画面右侧转动，上身扭回镜头方向，胸口朝向相机，身体略微前倾，一侧肩膀抬高。双手张开支撑在桌面上，手掌和手指具有真实受力感，双腿并拢，在膝部附近交叠。靠近镜头的大腿占据画面下半部的重要面积，呈裸肤或极薄肤色丝袜效果，保留大腿根、膝部、腿部交叠处的柔软组织挤压、细小肤色差异和自然弯曲。可见皮肤包括面部、耳侧、颈部、锁骨、上胸与乳沟、双手、手腕、臀部下缘附近、大腿根、大面积大腿和膝部。肤色为偏冷的白皙象牙色，脸颊与鼻部有粉红血色；皮肤经过轻度美颜和平滑处理，但仍保留细微毛孔、关节纹理、手指褶皱与柔软皮肤触感，避免蜡质塑料皮肤。

背景是明亮的现代开放式办公室：白色墙面与天花板、外露管道和横梁、多条平行延伸的冷白色线性LED灯、灰色办公隔断、白灰色网布办公椅、白色键盘、办公设备、远处白色门和少量墙面装饰。主要光源全部来自天花板冷白线性灯与白墙反射形成的环境光，额头、鼻梁、颧骨、锁骨、上胸和大腿表面出现宽而柔的高光，下颌、胸部下方、手臂内侧和双腿交叠处形成浅灰软阴影。不要添加夕阳暖光、电影式主光、霓虹色、独立柔光箱或明显轮廓光。

整体呈现东亚社交媒体美颜人像、粉调明星妆、细条纹office siren造型与近距离低机位手机摄影的结合。保留轻度HDR、适度锐化、美颜平滑、少量传感器噪点、压缩质感、广角边缘形变和背景仍可辨认的中等偏深景深。她刚刚靠在桌边，会议似乎已经结束，头顶的灯还亮着；现在她正看向镜头，而下一秒似乎就会起身、整理西装并离开。

负面提示词：未成年，幼态儿童脸，镜面自拍，手持手机，明确裸露，乳头暴露，私密部位暴露，额外肢体，多余手指，融合手指，断裂手腕，错误膝盖，失真解剖，过度丰胸，极端蜂腰，夸张充气臀部，蜡质皮肤，塑料皮肤，瓷娃娃脸，动漫脸，CG渲染，强烈背景虚化，金色夕阳，戏剧性轮廓光，豪华办公室，卧室背景，完美对称，过度锐化，文字乱码，水印。

title: 复古女性
prompt:
Vertical 3:4 aspect ratio. Medium shot framing from crown of head to mid-thigh.
A young East Asian woman in her early 20s sits slightly right of center on a low weathered stone ledge on a quiet rainy night. She holds a fully transparent vinyl umbrella that occupies the upper third of the frame, covered in distinct, sparkling raindrops that glisten in the light; her form remains clearly visible through the clear material with subtle light refraction.

Her skin is light ivory-beige with natural texture, faint rosy flush on cheeks and nose tip, soft highlights on shoulders and collarbones. Makeup in champagne beige and pink-brown tones, delicate long lashes, natural subtle under-eye definition, translucent pink-beige lips. She tilts her head slightly, gazing calmly and composedly at the camera with clear, bright catchlights in her eyes. Her medium-long hair is light milky tea ash brown, with thin see-through bangs, face-framing layers, and loose inward curls at the ends, lightly dampened at the edges.

She wears a light beige camisole top with lace and tiny floral patterns, a thin ribbon detail at the chest, near the deep cleavage, paired with a matching long skirt with a deep side drape and slit. A lightweight ribbed cardigan slips loosely off her shoulders, forming natural soft folds. Pose: right hand holds the umbrella handle gently near her chest, left hand rests lightly on the ledge behind her for support; right leg bends and extends forward, left leg hangs naturally down the side of the ledge, posture relaxed and stable.

Setting: small quiet garden terrace at night. Foreground: low rain-wet shrubs; midground: potted conifers, rough stone wall, a small glowing lantern on the lower left; background: softly blurred wet paved path, distant building entrance, all signage rendered completely illegible.

Lighting: soft, gentle frontal flash from slightly left, illuminating her face, shoulders and legs evenly without harsh glare; warm amber streetlight from upper right casts subtle rim light and creates golden reflections on wet stone, pavement, and raindrops. Background tones are deep muted greens and near-blacks, keeping the atmosphere dark and atmospheric.

Style: photorealistic nighttime fashion portrait, sharp focus on her face, hands, and raindrop details; shallow depth of field softly blurs the background. Natural perspective, no wide-angle distortion. Retain fine details: individual hair strands, wet surface reflections, umbrella transparency, realistic skin texture with subtle pores. Subtle nostalgic digital photo grain, warm-cold light balance. 2:3

Negative   unnatural face or gaze, over-smoothed plastic-like skin, excessive retouching, extra/missing/fused fingers, deformed limbs, awkward hand or leg positioning, clothing bunching or distortion, incorrect perspective, conflicting shadows, overexposure, legible text, logos, watermarks, unrealistic umbrella opacity.

title: 3D女性
prompt:
Create one vertical 9:16 photoreal phone-video still inside a modern Chinese high-speed train carriage, as if a seated passenger casually recorded the aisle from chest height. The camera is partly blocked by a dark seat-back edge and a blurred passenger shoulder in the foreground; mild rolling-shutter softness, phone compression, small autofocus miss, and fine sensor noise. Main subject: a clearly adult East Asian woman around 29, mature beautiful face and memorable eyes, tall natural elongated proportions, realistic skin and hands, caught naturally while lifting a compact silver carry-on bag into the overhead luggage rack above her seat. She is not posing; her expression is a quick concentrated half-smile toward the bag, face readable in three-quarter profile. Styling: cropped charcoal ribbed cardigan over a fitted ivory tank, high-waist dark plaid mini skirt with secure shorts underneath, sheer black tights, long black knee-high boots, slim earrings, simple watch, long dark hair clipped back with a few loose strands. The styling is public-safe but fashion-forward, with a clear waist line and leg line. Train geometry must be believable: paired seats with headrest covers, window strip, overhead rack depth, aisle perspective, luggage, small ceiling lights, a few ordinary passengers out of focus, no broken train layout. Natural daylight mixed with cool carriage LEDs. Keep the image like a compressed social phone clip, not an editorial ad. Avoid underage cues, school uniform reading, voyeuristic framing, isolated body-part crop, nudity, lingerie, explicit pose, fake cabin geometry, businesswear drift, long coat hiding silhouette, deformed hands, plastic AI skin, unreadable face, logos, readable text, watermark.

Portrait construction: clearly establish an adult subject, mature aura, and photographic mode. Express attractiveness through garment cut, tailoring, fabric texture, fine accessories, a fleeting expression or action, motivated light, camera behavior, depth separation, and negative space rather than blunt or isolated body descriptions. Keep the styling tasteful, fully clothed, restrained, and naturally proportioned. Prompt polish guardrail: mature natural facial features, not childlike; body proportions are realistic and coordinated; hands, fingers, limbs, posture, and clothing physics are anatomically believable. Keep the visual focus on face appeal, posture, clothing texture, lighting, atmosphere, and camera realism rather than isolated body parts. Style stability: preserve real phone-photo texture, mild noise/compression, imperfect crop, natural skin texture, believable autofocus, and non-studio lighting. Avoid plastic skin, over-polished fashion editorial lighting, fake HDR, and CG-like perfection. Overall safety/stability: high-end, tasteful, restrained visual expression; no nudity, no explicit sexual pose, no isolated chest/hip/body-part close-up, no underage cues, no readable real logos, no garbled text, no watermark. Avoid CGI-like rendering, plastic skin, doll-like faces, and exaggerated anatomy unless a stylized medium is explicitly requested. Use mature aesthetic language, realistic proportions, coherent scene logic, and believable camera artifacts.

title: 电影感女性
prompt:
Create a vertical portrait in an approximately 3:4 aspect ratio with the visual character of a late-2000s or early-2010s direct-flash digital photograph. An adult woman around 22 to 30 years old stands in a dim, ornate classical interior, positioned near the center but slightly toward image-left. Frame her from the top of the head to the lower calf or mid-lower skirt, leaving the feet outside the image. She has a tall, slender, narrow-framed silhouette with an elongated neck and shoulders. Her weight rests mainly on one leg, her hip shifts toward image-right, and her shoulders tilt in the opposite direction, forming a natural elongated S-curve.

Her arm on image-left is lifted and bent, with the hand lightly touching the back of her head or her hair. Her arm on image-right follows the hip line downward, with gently curved fingers. The pose should feel elegant but not standardized or perfectly rehearsed. Preserve the accidental tension of a movement that has just paused, as though she will lower the raised hand in the next moment. This is not a mirror selfie; no phone is visible, and the left-right composition must not be flipped.

Preserve a small oval face, soft jawline, slender nose bridge, and naturally full lips. Her eyes are slightly widened and calmly focused near the lens, while the lips remain naturally closed or barely parted. She is not smiling deliberately. Her expression is quiet, alert, and subtly tired, carrying the emotional distance of a formal evening that is almost over.

Use refined makeup informed by East Asian formal-dinner and red-carpet aesthetics: warm-neutral fair skin, a thin semi-matte complexion base with real skin texture still visible, naturally dark brows, muted taupe and dusty mauve-pink eyeshadow, fine eyeliner, light mascara, softly placed low-saturation pink blush, and glossy nude-pink or rose-beige lips. Her long black or black-brown hair is brushed back from the face, leaving the ears visible, with a few natural flyaway strands near the temples. Add long silver-toned rhinestone or crystal tassel earrings that catch the flash beside the neck.

Dress her in a coordinated champagne-blush evening gown. The upper section is a high-neck sleeveless or halter-style semi-sheer mesh bodice in muted champagne pink, nude apricot, pale rose, and warm beige. Fine sequins cover the mesh and produce scattered silver-white sparkles and occasional clipped highlights under direct flash. The chest remains visibly covered by the semi-sheer textile; do not render it as bare or completely transparent. Include a small asymmetrical side opening at the waist on image-right, revealing only a limited strip of skin from the side waist toward the upper hip.

The lower garment is a high-waisted floor-length satin mermaid or fitted column skirt in soft blush pink, dusty rose, or pearlescent rose-beige. Add diagonal draping and naturally gathered folds around the waist and hips. The fabric follows the hips and thighs before narrowing downward beyond the frame. The satin should look soft, cool, slippery, and slightly weighty, with irregular vertical highlights produced by the flash.

Clearly show the face, neck, collarbones, both shoulders, both arms, the area near the underarm beneath the raised arm, the fingers, and the small exposed section of side waist and upper hip on image-right. The skin is warm-neutral and fair, becoming slightly porcelain under the cool-white flash while retaining soft peach blood tone in the shadows. It should appear fine, soft, gently warm, and faintly dewy to the touch. Preserve pores, subtle tonal differences, light joint texture, and realistic oily highlights on the forehead, nose bridge, cheekbones, collarbones, and upper arms. Avoid waxy smoothing or plastic skin.

Use a hard frontal on-camera flash positioned very close to the lens axis as the dominant light. It directly illuminates the face, shoulders, arms, sequined bodice, and center of the satin skirt, then falls off rapidly along the sides of the body. Create hard shadows behind the subject, deep near-black areas in the dark wood, and abrupt white highlights across the sequins. The background is illuminated only by weak amber tungsten or warm ambient light, creating a clear cool-versus-warm separation between the flash-lit skin and the peach-orange room. Reflections from several warm lamps appear in the glass covering the artwork, while lacquered furniture catches scattered highlights. Do not introduce softboxes, rim lighting, balanced fill light, or cinematic three-point illumination.

Place her in an ornate interior resembling an old hotel, private dining room, members' club, or classically decorated residence. Use a warm peach-orange textured wall with a gilded carved border near the ceiling. Include a large area of nearly black wooden paneling or a dark column on image-left. Behind the subject on image-right, hang a glass-fronted East Asian landscape or garden-style artwork with several warm reflected light points. Add a dark glossy lacquered table or cabinet behind her waist, a dark wooden chair with patterned upholstery in the lower-right background, and dark wainscoting or a fireplace-like structure across the lower wall.

The photographic treatment should resemble a compact consumer digital camera or early smartphone with built-in flash, plausibly using a 35–45mm full-frame equivalent focal length, around f/2.8–f/4, and roughly 1/60–1/100 second. Position the camera around chest-to-waist height, nearly level but with a slight upward perspective. Keep the framing subtly offset and allow the architectural verticals to remain imperfectly corrected. Preserve mild high-ISO grain, JPEG compression, slightly soft detail, crushed dark areas, clipped sequin highlights, and uneven exposure. The background remains recognizable but softer than the subject; avoid extreme shallow depth of field.

The room had already gone dim when the flash fired. She is lifting one hand to adjust her hair just before leaving the dinner, caught for a fraction of a second; in the next moment, the pose will loosen. The finished image should feel like a private old digital photograph rediscovered years later—glamorous, quiet, slightly intoxicated, and emotionally unresolved, with human imperfections valued above commercial perfection.

自然で現実感のある女性。明るいブラウンの髪を低めのゆるいポニーテールにまとめ、薄い前髪と顔まわりの後れ毛が風で少し流れている。顔は少し下向きで、視線は足もとの水面へ。口元は控えめにゆるみ、夏の光の中で静かに集中している表情。

白いノースリーブインナーの上に、薄手で透け感のある白い半袖シャツを羽織る。ボトムスは生成り色のハイウエストショートパンツ、ウエストに細いドローコード。白いソックスと白いスニーカー。右足を画面下へ大きく踏み出し、左足は後ろに軽く曲げる。人物の左腕は画面左へ水平に伸ばし、右腕は画面右上へ高く伸ばす。両手の指は5本が自然に分かれ、力を抜いた柔らかい形。手首や関節に破綻がなく、バランスを取るための自然な動き。

浅く澄んだ青い水面が全面に広がり、細かな波と白い反射光が無数の粒のように輝く。真夏の強い太陽光が画面右上から差し、髪、肩、シャツの縁、腕に明るいハイライトを作る。人物の濃い影が画面左下の水面に長く落ち、反射光の中で少し揺れて見える。

title: 3D女性
prompt:
Create an ultra-premium horizontal 2x2 four-panel Western fine-dining campaign poster for a self-created luxury restaurant brand. The final artwork must feel like a world-class design-annual food advertisement: bold, minimal, product-dominant, collector-grade, and unmistakably high-end. Use a strict four-panel system with absolute visual unity, but make each panel feature a more distinctive signature Western dish with stronger personality, stronger plating identity, and more memorable premium ingredients.

Core composition:
Use a strict 2x2 grid. Each panel must follow the same hierarchy:
1. one massively oversized bold background word fragment or giant cropped letterform,
2. one hero Western dish placed prominently in the lower-middle to center area,
3. one refined English dish headline,
4. one short supporting descriptor beneath,
5. minimal lower information line or brand footer styling.
All four panels must feel structurally identical in rhythm and spacing, like one unified luxury campaign.

Brand direction:
Create a self-invented international fine-dining brand with a refined Western luxury identity, for example “MAISON FLAME”. Use elegant English-only branding with restrained premium logo treatment. The brand system must feel modern, exclusive, clean, and highly designed.

Signature dish lineup:
Create four highly characteristic premium Western dishes, each with a stronger fine-dining identity than ordinary steak-or-salmon menu items:
Panel 1: butter-poached blue lobster tail with saffron beurre monte and charred lemon
Panel 2: dry-aged wagyu rossini with foie gras, black truffle jus, and glazed shallot
Panel 3: herb-crusted Dover sole medallion with citrus beurre blanc and fennel pollen
Panel 4: parmesan-aged truffle risotto with wild porcini, roasted hazelnut, and shaved black truffle
Each dish must feel like a true signature plate from a world-class Western restaurant: highly recognizable, visually special, luxurious, and impossible to confuse with generic food photography.

Color worlds:
Give each panel its own refined color atmosphere while preserving campaign unity:
Panel 1: coral red, shell ivory, saffron gold
Panel 2: deep burgundy, charcoal brown, toasted bronze
Panel 3: pale silver-blue, citrus cream, muted herb green
Panel 4: olive cream, truffle brown, dark moss, hazelnut beige
Each panel must feel distinct yet perfectly synchronized inside one premium brand universe.

Food realism:
Render every dish with extreme realism and premium tactile detail: blue-lobster shell gloss, saffron butter sheen, rich wagyu marbling, foie gras caramelization, black truffle surface texture, Dover sole flesh layers, beurre blanc gloss, creamy risotto flow, porcini texture, shaved parmesan translucency, and refined plate-edge reflections. Every hero dish must feel jewel-like, luxurious, and immediately edible.

Milk Cloud Orbit food-light logic:
This is critical. Increase the purity of highlights on sauces, butter glaze, jus reflections, meat juices, fish moisture, creamy rice sheen, and plate-edge lighting. The food must feel brighter in the right places, richer, cleaner, and more expensive without becoming greasy. Let each dish glow like a luxury object under precision commercial lighting.

Cream Halo Transit ingredient logic:
Keep the same four-panel skeleton, but reduce each panel to only 2-3 essential supporting elements so the dish becomes more iconic and less busy:
Panel 1: charred lemon, saffron butter gloss, micro herb
Panel 2: foie gras, black truffle slice, glazed shallot
Panel 3: citrus segment, fennel pollen, beurre blanc reflection
Panel 4: shaved black truffle, porcini, roasted hazelnut
No clutter, no garnish overload, no buffet feeling. Supporting ingredients must amplify the hero dish, never compete with it.

Oversized typography logic:
Make the giant background typography much larger than before, so large that each word fragment fills most of the panel and gets cropped by the panel edges. The typography must feel monumental, graphic, and architectural.

Typography-background fusion:
The oversized letterforms must be deeply fused into the background color field through tonal blending, subtle texture continuity, soft depth layering, glow falloff, shadow overlap, and atmospheric integration. The letters should feel embedded into the panel rather than pasted on top. Let the food sit in front of the giant typography while the type melts into the background world behind it. Some steam haze, sauce shine, plate reflections, or ingredient highlights may lightly cross in front of the giant letters, strengthening the integration.

Headline system:
Each panel should include a refined smaller headline such as:
“SAFFRON TIDE”
“ROSSINI FIRE”
“CITRUS VEIL”
“TRUFFLE CROWN”
These smaller headlines remain elegant and readable, while the giant background type acts as the main graphic force.

Lighting:
Use extremely delicate, soft, high-end commercial lighting. Let the food surfaces glow with refined highlight rolloff, subtle shadow grounding, and elegant dimensional separation. The light must feel luxurious, velvety, and world-class, while also helping the giant typography fuse naturally into the background.

Background:
Use minimal, clean, saturated backgrounds with subtle premium smoothness. The background must feel spacious and controlled, but structurally bonded to the giant type. No restaurant interior, no scenery, no unnecessary props.

Surface and finish:
Let each dish sit on a clean reflective or semi-reflective base with controlled reflections. Keep the finish sharp, polished, and premium, like a collector-grade dining campaign printed for a design annual.

title: AI 生成图片
prompt:
إليك سيناريو تعليمي احترافي لتجربة التحريض الذاتي، مناسب لفيديو قصير يشرح الفكرة بصريًا وبأسلوب مبسط.

### سيناريو تجربة التحريض الذاتي

الموضوع: التحريض الذاتيالمدة: 3–5 دقائق

### المشهد 1: مقدمة مشوقة

الصورة: لقطة مقربة لملف نحاسي موصول بدائرة كهربائية تحتوي على بطارية ومفتاح وأميتر.

التعليق الصوتي:

ماذا يحدث داخل الملف الكهربائي عندما نغلق المفتاح؟ هل يمر التيار فورًا بكامل شدته؟ أم أن هناك قوة خفية تعارض تغيره؟ في هذه التجربة سنتعرف على ظاهرة التحريض الذاتي.

### المشهد 2: عرض الأدوات

الصورة: ظهور الأدوات مرتبة على الطاولة مع تسميات واضحة.

* ملف سلكي نحاسي (وشيعة).

* بطارية أو مصدر تيار مستمر.

* مفتاح كهربائي.

* أميتر لقياس شدة التيار.

* أسلاك توصيل.

التعليق الصوتي:

سنستخدم وشيعة موصولة ببطارية ومفتاح كهربائي وأميتر. الهدف هو ملاحظة كيف يتغير التيار داخل الملف عند غلق الدائرة وفتحها.

### المشهد 3: تركيب الدائرة

الصورة: رسم تخطيطي بسيط للدائرة يوضح اتجاه التيار من البطارية إلى الملف ثم الأميتر.

التعليق الصوتي:

يتم توصيل الملف في دائرة كهربائية بسيطة. قبل غلق المفتاح لا يمر أي تيار، لذلك لا يوجد مجال مغناطيسي حول الوشيعة.

### المشهد 4: غلق المفتاح

الصورة: يد تغلق المفتاح، ويظهر التيار على شكل أسهم متحركة داخل الملف.

التعليق الصوتي:

عند غلق المفتاح يبدأ التيار في المرور داخل الملف. ومع زيادة التيار يتولد حول الوشيعة مجال مغناطيسي يزداد تدريجيًا.

المؤثرات البصرية:

* ظهور خطوط مجال مغناطيسي حول الملف.

* تدرج شدة المجال من ضعيف إلى قوي.

* سهم بلون مختلف داخل الملف يوضح القوة الدافعة الكهربائية المستحثة المعاكسة.

### المشهد 5: تفسير الظاهرة

الصورة: تكبير للملف مع حركة خطوط المجال المغناطيسي داخل الوشيعة.

التعليق الصوتي:

بسبب تغير شدة التيار يتغير المجال المغناطيسي داخل الملف. هذا التغير في الفيض المغناطيسي يؤدي إلى تولد قوة دافعة كهربائية مستحثة داخل نفس الملف.

وتكون هذه القوة المستحثة في اتجاه يعارض تغير التيار المسبب لها، وفقًا لقانون لنز. لذلك لا يصل التيار إلى قيمته النهائية فورًا، بل يزداد تدريجيًا.

### المشهد 6: فتح المفتاح

الصورة: يد تفتح المفتاح، وتظهر خطوط المجال المغناطيسي وهي تنهار بسرعة.

التعليق الصوتي:

عند فتح المفتاح ينقطع التيار، فينهار المجال المغناطيسي بسرعة. نتيجة لذلك يتولد في الملف قوة دافعة كهربائية مستحثة تحاول الإبقاء على مرور التيار لفترة قصيرة جدًا.

المؤثرات البصرية:

* اختفاء تدريجي لخطوط المجال المغناطيسي.

* ظهور شرارة صغيرة عند المفتاح إذا كان ذلك مناسبًا للتوضيح.

* سهم مستحث في اتجاه معاكس لاتجاه التغير الجديد في التيار.

### المشهد 7: الخلاصة

الصورة: مخطط تلخيصي يوضح العلاقة بين التيار والمجال المغناطيسي والقوة الدافعة المستحثة.

التعليق الصوتي:

إذن، التحريض الذاتي هو تولد قوة دافعة كهربائية مستحثة في ملف نتيجة تغير شدة التيار المار فيه، وذلك بسبب تغير المجال المغناطيسي الناتج عن هذا التيار.

وتعمل هذه القوة المستحثة دائمًا على معارضة التغير في التيار، وهو ما يفسر تأخر زيادة التيار عند غلق الدائرة، ومحاولة استمراره لحظة قصيرة عند فتحها.

### النص الختامي على الشاشة

### التحريض الذاتي

تغير شدة التيار في الملف → تغير المجال المغناطيسي → تولد قوة دافعة كهربائية مستحثة تعارض تغير التيار.

title: 赛博朋克女性
prompt:
You are designing the master brand mark for a premium technology ecosystem named "Univer".

This is not a playful startup logo. This is a serious, long-term, world-class brand symbol meant to represent a platform for intelligence, context, memory, files, workflows, and trusted AI experiences.

Brand essence:
- universal
- intelligent
- structured
- calm
- powerful
- precise
- trustworthy
- modern
- enduring
- premium

The logo must feel like a symbol that could sit comfortably beside the branding of Apple, OpenAI, Stripe, Anthropic, Linear, Notion, or Arc, while remaining entirely original and unmistakably Univer.

Design objective:
Create a single iconic abstract mark with a subtle connection to the letter "U", but it must NOT be a literal U. The mark should feel like a gateway, aperture, frame, or portal into a larger intelligent system. It should imply entry, access, structure, and depth.

Core design principles:
- one unified symbol, not multiple shapes
- bold, stable silhouette
- strong negative space
- minimal geometry
- excellent optical balance
- architectural proportion
- premium restraint
- memorable from a distance
- clear and legible at tiny sizes
- capable of functioning as an app icon, favicon, embossed hardware mark, product badge, and brand stamp

Visual direction:
- geometric, not organic
- minimal, not decorative
- confident, not flashy
- timeless, not trendy
- futuristic, but not cliché futuristic
- elegant, but not luxurious in a fashion-brand way
- strong, but not aggressive
- simple, but not generic

The symbol should evoke:
- a doorway into knowledge
- a controlled opening
- a structured portal
- a contained universe
- a trusted environment
- a system that organizes complexity

Important constraints:
- do NOT create a literal uppercase U
- do NOT use obvious AI clichés: brain, circuit, neuron, atom, globe, star, sparkle, chatbot bubble, robot face, AI swirl, hexagon network, or generic tech mark
- do NOT make it look like a random abstract art piece
- do NOT make it too complex
- do NOT use thin lines or fragile details
- do NOT use gradients, shadows, bevels, 3D effects, or glossy rendering
- do NOT make it look like a temporary startup logo
- do NOT make it look like a gaming logo or a crypto logo
- do NOT use a lowercase or uppercase text logo as the main symbol

Form language:
- strong outer mass
- controlled inner cut or aperture
- high-quality negative space
- subtle internal symmetry
- possible hidden suggestion of U through shape or void, but only as a discovery, never as an obvious literal form

Brand behavior:
This symbol should look equally strong:
- in black on white
- in white on black
- as a standalone icon
- when embossed or engraved
- when reduced to 16x16 px
- when printed on product surfaces
- when used across the full family: Univer, Apex, Normal, Swift

Typography note:
The logo mark should be able to live independently. Wordmark is optional and secondary. The symbol must carry the identity on its own.

Design tone:
- premium enterprise
- calm authority
- deep intelligence
- highly refined simplicity
- emotionally restrained
- confident and enduring

Output expectations:
Provide a distinctive, polished, brand-ready master mark that feels inevitable, as if it has always belonged to Univer.

prompt: 透过镜子回望 主图主题： 肖像构图3:4。画面中一位年轻女性微微前倾，双手置于略偏右侧的木制梳妆台之上。拍摄范围从腰部以上至大腿上部，使她背部至腰部的流畅S形曲线成为视觉焦点。左侧的大镜子将她的面部和上半身从正面反射出来，形成真实影像与镜像影像的双重构图。 外貌与表情： 肤色为浅象牙米色，略带粉嫩光泽，肤质自然。镜中，她的头部微微倾斜，目光平静地凝视着自己。妆容包括淡粉色腮红、香槟色米色与粉棕色眼影，纤细长睫毛，自然的眼周脂肪粒，柔和的棕色眉毛，半透明的粉米色光泽双唇。眼中透出微小而清澈的虹彩。头发呈浅乳白色茶褐色，留有细薄的透明刘海，发丝在面部分层，长度适中，及肩下垂。后脑两侧头发向前蓬松，充分展现出从肩胛骨到腰部的线条。 服装与姿态： 露肩荷叶边上衣，外层叠搭米色细点薄纱。荷叶边分两至三层，从肩部下方沿上臂自然地微微展开。下身穿着黑色短裤，两侧配有丝带。双臂伸直，掌心自然置于梳妆台台面之上。肩膀略微向内收，胸部前倾，骨盆后挺，形成从背部到腰部的柔和弧线。臀部轻微向框架右侧扭转，自然连接左右肩胛骨、垂直脊柱线以及腰部凹陷处的阴影。手指不夸张张开，位置设计使重量集中于上表面。 背景与灯光： 一间温馨的小卧室兼梳妆台空间。前景左侧：褶皱遮光迷你灯、干花、透明玻璃瓶、黑色香水瓶。中景：木质台面和大型木框镜子。远右墙：柔和模糊的小照片、细边框烛台，以及低调排列的少量化妆品。主光源来自画框左下角的灯具，发出柔和的琥珀色光线，在肩部、脊椎、腰部和大腿轮廓处形成细密的高光。对面则有微弱的暖色调室内反射光，阴影投射至右下方向。镜子的色调比主体深一格，营造出自然对比，使面部轮廓显得柔和浮现。 构图与镜头： 采用垂直拍摄角度，视角略低，呈现自然的广角效果，相当于35mm镜头。画面左侧为镜像，右侧为真人，将镜像面部置于左上三分之一交点附近，真人腰部靠近右下三分之一交点。顶部留有轻微的墙边距，底部裁切至中腿位置。聚焦于真实人物背部和镜像面部，背景物体则被柔和地模糊处理。景深自然，准确呈现镜像与真人之间的空间关系。 质感与风格： 静谧的室内肖像，宛如暖色调的电影照片。肌肤未过度柔化，保留了肩背处细腻的纹理和柔和的高光。细致描绘出木纹、薄纱、发丝以及香水瓶的倒影。低对比度，精致的纹理，柔和的琥珀色与深棕色调。性感而优雅，如同杂志美容专题图片。 负面： 面部不自然、眼神异常、左右镜像不对称、多余手指、缺失手指、手腕变形、肩胛骨异常、关节损坏、重力失常、透视错误、阴影与光源矛盾、过度美化皮肤、塑料感皮肤、文字模糊、标志、水印。

Create a single-page vertical editorial poster exploring Plato's philosophical critique of democracy through the allegory of the Ship of State from The Republic.

The artwork should explain Plato's argument that governing requires knowledge, wisdom, and philosophical understanding rather than merely popularity, ambition, or the pursuit of immediate desires.

Use the supplied reference image only as inspiration for the artistic language. Do not copy its composition, figures, decorative motifs, or layout.

The finished artwork should resemble a museum-quality handmade Greek editorial screen print, blending classical philosophy, ancient mythology-inspired illustration, and contemporary editorial design.

It should feel like a page from an independent philosophy journal or a museum exhibition poster.

Not a political propaganda poster.

Not a modern infographic.

Not a cartoon.

Not photorealistic.

CORE CONCEPT — THE SHIP OF STATE

The entire poster revolves around Plato's famous allegory:

A ship represents the city-state.

The sailors represent competing political forces.

The captain represents wisdom and knowledge.

The true navigator represents the philosopher who understands the stars, winds, and course of the journey.

The composition should visually tell this philosophical story through a central Greek maritime allegory.

CENTRAL FIGURE — PLATO

A magnificent head-and-chest portrait of Plato occupies the exact center of the composition.

Show only his head and upper chest.

Do not show a full body.

He should appear as the intellectual anchor of the entire poster.

Depict Plato as:

mature Greek philosopher
thoughtful expression
deep-set observant eyes
thick curled beard
wavy classical hair
calm but serious demeanor
simple Greek himation draped across shoulders

He should not appear angry or authoritarian.

He represents philosophical reflection and the search for truth.

Behind Plato rises a monumental circular composition inspired by Greek architectural ornament:

marble rings
Ionic columns
Greek key patterns
celestial navigation circles
carved stone geometry
olive branches
ancient ship motifs

This structure replaces a religious halo.

CENTRAL SYMBOL — THE SHIP OF STATE

Behind and surrounding Plato's portrait, the largest symbolic element is an ancient Greek trireme sailing through a philosophical sea.

The ship should be depicted as an allegorical vessel, not a realistic historical reconstruction.

The ship contains:

many sailors arguing over direction
raised hands representing competing opinions
confused movement on deck
a powerful but untrained crowd attempting to control the vessel
a neglected steering wheel
a symbolic captain's position

Above the ship stands a quiet navigator observing:

stars
celestial patterns
winds
currents

The navigator represents philosophical knowledge.

The ship should curve around Plato's portrait, creating a circular philosophical composition.

STYLE DNA

Maintain the same visual language as the philosophy series:

handmade editorial illustration
contemporary Greek-inspired risograph print
museum-quality screen print
bold imperfect black contour lines
simplified classical anatomy
engraved manuscript feeling
flat ink colors
visible paper texture
dry-brush imperfections
expressive symbolic composition

Inspired by:

ancient Greek vase painting
marble relief sculpture
classical manuscripts
Hellenistic engraving
archaeological museum graphics
independent philosophy publications

Never:

Roman aesthetics
medieval aesthetics
modern political cartoons
clean vector graphics
photorealism
PRINT TEXTURE

Heavy risograph grain.

Visible paper fibers.

Slight ink misregistration.

Dry brush edges.

Uneven ink density.

Hand printed imperfections.

The artwork should feel physically produced on textured paper.

COLOR PALETTE

Use six flat inks:

warm ivory paper
deep black
Greek terracotta
muted ochre
olive green
charcoal gray

Optional subtle muted sea-green accents.

No:

neon
blue-heavy palette
gradients
glossy rendering
metallic effects

The atmosphere should feel like an ancient Greek vase transformed into a modern philosophy poster.

TYPOGRAPHY

Hand-lettered Greek editorial typography.

Bold uppercase title.

Integrated into the artwork.

Slightly imperfect printed alignment.

Classical but readable.

Never modern UI typography.

TITLE
PLATO
THE SHIP OF STATE
Subtitle

"Who should steer the city: the many, or the wise?"

INTERACTIVE FRAME I
THE SHIP WITHOUT KNOWLEDGE
Illustration

A large Greek ship drifting through unstable waters.

The sailors fight over the helm.

Some pull the wheel in different directions.

Others compete for control without understanding navigation.

The sea becomes chaotic.

Symbolism

Power without wisdom creates disorder.

Editorial Text

THE SHIP WITHOUT KNOWLEDGE

"A crowd may possess power, but power alone does not create wisdom."

Plato argued that governing requires knowledge of justice and truth, not simply the ability to persuade or gain popularity.

INTERACTIVE FRAME II
THE FALSE PILOTS
Illustration

Several sailors compete to command the ship.

They hold:

decorative crowns
empty scrolls
symbols of wealth
instruments they do not understand

They represent politicians seeking influence without philosophical understanding.

Editorial Text

THE FALSE PILOTS

"Those who desire control are not always those who know the way."

Plato compared ambitious politicians to sailors fighting for the helm while ignoring the true art of navigation.

INTERACTIVE FRAME III
THE TRUE NAVIGATOR
Illustration

The largest contemplative frame.

A philosopher-navigator stands quietly beside celestial instruments.

He studies:

stars
winds
ocean currents
mathematical patterns

He does not force the ship.

He understands the path.

Editorial Text

THE PHILOSOPHER NAVIGATOR

"The true ruler understands what the good actually is."

Plato believed philosophers were suited to govern because they pursued knowledge, wisdom, and the nature of justice rather than personal gain.

INTERACTIVE FRAME IV
THE CAVE AND THE SHADOWS
Illustration

A Greek cave opening.

Inside:

chained figures watch shadows projected on a wall
outside sunlight reveals the real world
a philosopher turns toward the light

Use symbolic geometry rather than literal horror.

Editorial Text

FROM SHADOW TO TRUTH

"Education is the turning of the soul toward reality."

Plato believed many people mistake appearances for truth until philosophy guides them toward deeper understanding.

INTERACTIVE FRAME V
THE IDEAL CITY
Illustration

A harmonious Greek city arranged with:

balanced architecture
geometric order
philosophers teaching
guardians protecting
citizens working together

The city appears as a carefully designed structure rather than a chaotic crowd.

Editorial Text

THE ORDERED CITY

"Justice is harmony between the parts."

Plato imagined an ideal society where each group fulfills its proper role according to ability and virtue.

BOTTOM SECTION

A Greek compass transforms into a ship's steering wheel.

Around it:

olive branches
stars
waves
geometric patterns
Greek inscriptions rendered as decorative texture

Closing statement:

WISDOM MUST GUIDE POWER

"A city without knowledge of justice is a ship without a navigator."

DECORATIVE MOTIFS

Integrate throughout:

Greek key borders
Ionic columns
marble carving patterns
olive branches
laurel leaves
Greek waves
trireme silhouettes
celestial navigation symbols
stars
compass circles
amphora patterns
ancient scrolls
geometric proportions
architectural arches
carved philosophical tablets
Hellenistic ornamental borders

Every element should guide attention back toward Plato and the Ship of State.

FINAL ART DIRECTION

The final artwork should feel like a museum-quality handmade editorial risograph poster about Hellenistic philosophy.

Plato's head-and-chest portrait remains the intellectual center while the surrounding interactive frames unfold as chapters of the Ship of State allegory.

The design should combine:

Greek classical art
philosophical storytelling
ancient maritime symbolism
editorial hierarchy
tactile printmaking

The result should feel timeless, intellectual, and visually powerful — a philosophical exhibition poster explaining why Plato questioned democracy through one of history's most famous political metaphors

人物身份： 生成一张图片，主体是一位年轻的东亚女性。她是赛道上一名专业的赛车宝贝，气质兼具复古优雅与摩登活力，表情时刻挂着灿烂、开朗的笑容，眼神中透露出自信与对速度的热情，给人阳光健康、积极向上的感觉。
服装细节： 身穿皮质复古赛车马甲与高腰白色阔腿裤，腰间随意系着一件红白格纹的野餐风衬衫。服装剪裁凸显运动曲线，上面印有做旧铜色复古车标和徽章，脚踩棕色粗跟马丁靴，整体造型充满张力与活力。
外观特征： 人物拥有精致立体的东亚五官，深邃明亮的黑色眼眸带着笑意，肤色白皙透亮，在光线下呈现健康的光泽感。腿部线条修长笔直，肌肉紧实，展现出运动女性的力量美感。
景别： 全身景（适配竖屏），脚下为草地，顶部为树冠与天空。
构图角度： 正面，直击开朗笑容，身体轴线垂直。

固定场景： 拍摄地点为英国古德伍德复古赛车节的草坪上，背景里可见古典庄园建筑和停在草地上的各式经典老爷车，地面是修剪整齐的绿草和野花。
固定光线： 使用上午十点的柔和暖色自然光，光线从人物左后方45度斜射下来，形成温暖的高光与柔和的过渡阴影，突显皮肤的白皙质感与服装材质的反光特性。

prompt:
Create a playful flat editorial vector illustration on a warm cream background. On the left side, place a surreal peach-toned human-like cartoon figure in an exaggerated impossible yoga stretch, with one very long leg lifted vertically behind the head. The body should feel soft, rounded, rubbery, and abstract, not anatomically realistic. Keep the face extremely simple: two small black dot eyes, a tiny red oval mouth, and a pale buttery yellow blob of hair across the forehead. The figure wears a muted pale teal-blue top and a deep cobalt blue shorts-like shape, both as clean matte color blocks with organic rounded edges.

In the upper center, add a hot pink rectangular poster with bold dark navy text reading exactly: “Do it for the plot.” Use a heavy geometric editorial type style. Inside the poster, include large red circular shapes, one cropped at the top and another red character-like blob at the lower left with round eyes, plus a small yellow sparkle. On the right side of the composition, add a red-orange speech bubble with pale pink hand-lettered text reading exactly: “NEWS, NEWS! NEWS!” Make the lettering irregular, thick, and playful.

Near the bottom center, include a small side-profile dog head with brown ears, tan face, round yellow glasses, and a yellow striped collar. Near the lower right-center, place three bright red tomatoes with green tops and small pale highlight dots. On the far lower right, add a cluster of dark navy and blue blueberries with simplified leaf-like shapes.

The image should look like a contemporary digital editorial collage or magazine illustration, not a photo. Use a straight-on orthographic view, no perspective depth, no cast shadows, no realistic lighting, and no depth of field. All elements should be equally sharp, matte, and flat, with slightly imperfect hand-drawn edges. Preserve the bold color identity: cream, hot pink, red-orange, navy, peach, muted teal, cobalt blue, yellow, tomato red, and dark blueberry blue.

The mood should be whimsical, cheeky, absurd, and slightly chaotic, as if the scene had already happened for the sake of the story. Keep the composition casually arranged rather than perfectly symmetrical. Avoid photorealism, realistic anatomy, 3D rendering, glossy textures, cinematic shadows, beauty portrait styling, generic corporate vector aesthetics, random replacement text, or any sexualized body emphasis.

title: 一位22—27岁的成年东方女性，原创现代女忍者角色，真实成年…
prompt:
一位22—27岁的成年东方女性，原创现代女忍者角色，真实成年亚洲女性长相，五官精致立体，脸部线条柔和流畅，鹅蛋脸略带英气，眼睛修长明亮，眼尾自然上扬，眼神坚定中带着一丝挑衅与自信，神情沉着冷静，嘴角微微扬起形成若有若无的轻笑，散发成熟而危险的魅力。真实东方成年女性比例，不幼态，不网红脸，不动漫感，不欧美混血感。

皮肤呈自然冷白肤色，真实皮肤纹理，带轻微健康光泽，肩膀、锁骨、手臂和腿部肌肤紧致富有弹性，保留自然皮肤细节，不磨皮，不塑料感，不AI皮肤。

妆容采用现代轻运动写真妆。野生眉略带英气，眼妆以浅棕和深棕渐层轻微晕染，内眼线自然延伸，睫毛根根分明；瞳孔清亮，眼神锐利；鼻梁高挺自然；嘴唇为柔和豆沙红或自然玫瑰色，整体妆容干净克制，不浓艳。

发型采用高束长马尾设计，乌黑长发高高扎起，马尾自然垂落至腰部附近，发量丰盈，发尾略带自然弧度；使用一条白色丝带固定发束，丝带随动作轻轻飘扬；额前保留自然空气碎发和细碎鬓发，增加真实运动感，不佩戴复杂发饰。

服饰采用原创东方忍者运动风设计。上身为深朱红色交叠式无袖运动短上衣，采用柔软弹力功能布料，衣襟以象牙白滚边勾勒轮廓，肩部与背部线条利落流畅；腰部使用宽版白色束腰护带，强调力量感与腰线比例。下身搭配深朱红色高腰运动短裤，两侧采用弧形高开衩剪裁，边缘以白色滚边收口，运动感强烈但不过度暴露；手部佩戴黑色露指训练护手，整体风格介于传统忍者与现代运动时尚之间。服装无任何品牌Logo，无官方角色标志，无版权元素。

人物站立于现代日式木质建筑长廊与庭院之间，背景为暖色木结构、石板地面、竹影与柔和庭院绿植，整体环境极简高级，没有游戏场景，没有擂台，没有火焰特效，没有任何官方元素。

人物采用原创姿态：身体微微前倾形成蓄势待发的动态，一侧肩膀轻轻向前，重心自然落于前腿，另一条腿轻微后撤；左手自然垂放于身体侧前方，右手轻轻扶住束腰边缘，目光直接注视镜头，呈现压迫感与电影张力，不参考任何官方站姿或招牌动作。

摄影采用35mm电影广角镜头，轻微低机位拍摄，镜头距离人物较近，加入约5°轻微Dutch Angle（荷兰角）构图，使人物产生更强的力量感与视觉冲击。人物约占画面80%，广角带来轻微透视效果，腿部比例修长但保持真实，不夸张拉伸。

光线采用电影级侧逆光结合暖色环境光。夕阳从人物后侧45°照射，形成柔和轮廓光，将高马尾发丝一根根点亮，白色丝带与发梢产生自然透光效果；人物正面由暖色漫反射补光，面部层次丰富，肩膀、腰部及腿部形成自然高光，背景保持柔和虚化，具有真实空气透视。

title: 电影感女性
prompt:
Create a photorealistic 2:3 vertical, full-body fashion portrait with a high-key white aesthetic and a subtle playful-comedy undertone. A clearly adult young woman, approximately 23 to 30 years old, stands inside a nearly pure-white seamless studio, white light-box environment, or in front of a floor-to-ceiling window completely washed out by strong backlight. Place her slightly low in the frame with extensive white negative space above her head, and include her entire body, shoes, handbag, and faint contact shadows on the floor.

She has a naturally soft facial structure, full straight bangs, and slim black rectangular glasses. Her very dark brown, nearly black hair is pulled back into a low ponytail, low bun, or loosely gathered style, with several small flyaways around the ears. Preserve her natural facial proportions, soft jawline, subtle asymmetry, and realistic eye size. Do not transform her into a celebrity or generic influencer. Use restrained urban office makeup: lightweight semi-matte foundation, softly straight brows, muted beige-brown eyeshadow, fine black eyeliner, natural lashes, an extremely subtle peach blush, and soft nude-pink lips. Retain mild under-eye shading, color variation beside the nose, and small areas of highlight bloom.

Her upper body leans clearly forward and bends toward image-left. Her head lowers, while her hips shift slightly toward image-right. The arm on image-left rises toward her forehead, with the wrist near the brow and the palm turned outward, as though she is tired after work or momentarily shielding herself from the strong light. The arm on image-right hangs downward, holding both a small black object and the two long straps of a cat-face handbag. The leg on image-left bends slightly near the bag, while the leg on image-right stretches widely toward the lower-right corner with a straighter knee. Let the shoulders, waist, and legs form a continuous S-curve and strong diagonal lines. The pose should feel intentionally styled but preserve casual imperfections such as a bent wrist, nonparallel bag straps, and different foot angles.

Her eyes are slightly narrowed behind the glasses, with the gaze directed downward or just below the lens. Her lips remain naturally parted, with a faint glimpse of the teeth, as though she had just sighed or murmured a tired complaint. The expression should feel exhausted, mildly dizzy, self-aware, and endearing rather than dramatically distressed.

Dress her in a fitted soft-white short-sleeve collared blouse with a broad collar, visible button placket, one chest patch pocket, and a tucked hem. Keep the chest fully covered with natural fabric tension and only restrained contour. The forward bend and side compression should create realistic diagonal pull lines, small folds, and light gathering around the waist. Pair the blouse with a high-waisted fitted black mini skirt ending on the upper thighs. The skirt should follow the waist and hips while retaining fabric thickness, slight tension, and minor creasing rather than looking like latex or seamless shapewear.

Place a black ID lanyard around her neck, ending in a rectangular black card holder that hangs over the white blouse. Add a small silver chain-style wristwatch on the wrist at image-right. In the lowered hand, include a large beige cat-face handbag with a horizontally rounded silhouette, dark-brown piping, small cat ears, circular eyes, a triangular nose, whiskers, and blush-like dot details. Two long thin handles descend from her hand, and the bag hangs in the lower-left part of the frame with its base nearly touching the floor.

Her legs are bare from the mini-skirt hem to the tops of the feet, and she wears nude-pink or beige pointed low-cut pumps. Visible skin includes the face, ears, neck, a small collar area, both arms, hands, and both complete legs. The chest, abdomen, waist, hips, and buttocks remain covered. Use a light neutral-to-warm ivory skin tone lifted by the high-key white illumination, while preserving a faint rosy undertone on the arms and legs. The skin should look as though it would feel soft, clean, finely textured, and slightly cool to the touch. Keep the arms and legs smooth but preserve realistic knees, ankles, finger joints, subtle pores, and minor tonal differences. Avoid plastic or waxy skin.

Illuminate the background with a very large white source pushed close to highlight clipping. Strong backlight should wrap around the hair, shoulders, arms, and outer edges of the legs, producing soft white bloom. Allow some thin hairs and portions of the white blouse edges to dissolve slightly into the background. Use weaker frontal fill from a reflector, large softbox, or computational-photography lift so that the face, clothing, and legs remain readable. Preserve only pale warm-gray shadows beneath the chin, along the inner arms, under the skirt hem, and between the separated legs. The floor should show little more than faint gray contact shadows and soft reflections. Do not use hard shadows, colorful neon, dark cinematic light, or an obvious professional rim-light setup.

Photograph the scene with the visual character of a smartphone main camera, lightweight mirrorless camera, or moderate portrait lens. Position the camera between waist and chest height, mostly level or with a very slight upward angle. Keep medium-to-deep focus so the glasses, blouse, ID lanyard, handbag design, wristwatch, and shoes remain recognizable. Add gentle digital diffusion, mild social-media compression, low contrast, highlight bloom, and slight loss of detail in the white blouse. Do not make the subject edges resemble a hard digital cutout. Preserve moderate background clipping and overexposure, since the white haze is part of the image identity.

She had just emerged from a long commute or an exhausting workday, and the cat-shaped bag was still hanging from her hand. A moment ago she had been rushing; now she pauses in the bright space and raises a hand to her forehead, wanting only one brief breath before continuing. The final feeling is tired, cute, lightly theatrical, and self-deprecating: a social-media fashion portrait combining office-uniform styling, glasses, a black mini skirt, a playful cat handbag, and an exaggerated but believable exhausted gesture.

Avoid: underage or school-aged appearance, mirror selfie, celebrity replacement, missing glasses, missing lanyard, missing cat handbag, trousers, long skirts, exaggerated breasts, extreme waist-to-hip proportions, unnaturally long legs, increased nudity, plastic skin, waxy skin, excessive smoothing, deformed fingers, broken wrists, twisted ankles, malformed heels, disconnected straps, hard cutout edges, detailed office interiors, colorful neon, hard shadows, dark cinematic grading, CGI, text, watermarks, and logos.

A clearly adult woman, approximately 23 to 29 years old, is standing in front of a white countertop in a compact modern home kitchen. Frame her from the head to roughly the middle of the thighs. She has a soft oval face, a narrow jaw and chin, a delicate straight nose bridge, naturally straight brows, and almond-shaped eyes. Her head tilts slightly toward image-right while she looks steadily into the camera. Her eyes feel alert but relaxed, and her lips rest slightly apart as though she had almost spoken before pausing. Her hair is long, side-parted, and deep chocolate brown, with soft chestnut highlights under the warm household light. The roots have mild volume, and most of the hair falls over the shoulder on image-left in broad, loose, slightly irregular curls. Leave several delicate face-framing strands near the ear and cheek. The hand on image-left lightly holds the ends of one section of hair, allowing the strands to separate casually between her fingers. Her body leans subtly toward image-right while her hips shift slightly in the opposite direction. The shoulders are not perfectly level, and the torso and hips have a small, natural twist that creates a restrained S-shaped line. Keep the pose loose and believable rather than making her forcefully lift her chest, contract her stomach, or arch her hips.

She wears a muted peach-nude or pale salmon fitted camisole with thin straps and a low rounded-square neckline. The material should resemble soft cotton jersey or stretch knit. It follows the body while retaining believable thickness and gravity: the chest area remains smooth, the side waist shows slight tension, and several horizontal folds gather naturally around the waist and lower torso. Pair it with high-rise fitted jeans in washed charcoal black or deep graphite gray, featuring prominent white or pale-gray contrast stitching, clearly outlined front pockets, a structured waistband, metal button, zipper fly, faint washed tonal variation, and real denim creases. Add a very fine warm-gold short necklace with a tiny pendant and a pale nude-pink or milky-white manicure.

Visible skin includes the face, ears, neck, collarbones, shoulders, upper edge of the chest, both arms, wrists, hands, and fingers. The rest of the chest, abdomen, waist, hips, and legs remain covered. Use a light warm ivory skin tone with subtle peach and beige undertones. The skin should look as though it would feel soft, warm, smooth, and finely textured to the touch. Keep it mostly softly matte, with low natural sheen on the forehead, nose bridge, collarbones, shoulders, and forearms. Preserve extremely subtle pores around the cheeks and nose and avoid a plastic or porcelain surface.

The background is a tidy but lived-in modern kitchen with glossy warm-white cabinetry, a pale gray-beige recessed cooking area, a wide black range hood or horizontal black strip behind the subject's head, a white countertop, a black gas cooktop, a wok or pan with a pale gray-green lid, and a transparent cooking-oil bottle with a yellow cap near the wall on image-right. A built-in appliance panel is partially visible beneath the counter. Keep these background details recognizable rather than heavily blurred.

Shoot with the visual character of a smartphone rear main camera or a phone on a fixed support, using approximately a 26 to 30mm full-frame-equivalent perspective from 1.3 to 1.8 meters away. The camera height sits between her chest and eyes and tilts only very slightly downward. Keep the framing mostly centered but not geometrically perfect, with limited space above her head and her arms and hips approaching the side edges.

Light the scene with a mixture of warm residential ceiling light, reflections from the pale cabinets, and broad frontal room ambience. Do not use professional rim lighting or a polished three-point setup. Let the shoulder and arm on image-right appear slightly brighter, while shallow warm shadows remain beneath the chin, around the neck, along the inner arms, and beside the waist. Use relatively deep smartphone-camera focus so the kitchen remains legible. Add mild mobile denoising, subtle JPEG and social-media compression, a warm white balance, and a small amount of low-light texture instead of cinematic color grading.

She had just paused at the kitchen counter and casually gathered the hair resting over her shoulder. She is looking into the lens now, and in the next moment she seems about to release the ends and turn back toward what she had been doing. The atmosphere is warm, quiet, restrained, and intimate, like a familiar person casually taking a photograph before dinner.

title: 创作一张 3:4 竖幅、真实城市街拍质感的女性时尚人像。一位…
prompt:
创作一张 3:4 竖幅、真实城市街拍质感的女性时尚人像。一位约22至28岁的成年女性站在城市商业街或建筑入口附近，身体位于画面中央偏右，以三分之二侧面对向镜头。她穿着一件贴身的深铁锈红色无袖高领罗纹针织背心，纵向细罗纹清楚可见，面料自然贴合躯干，并在腰腹处留下真实的拉伸、堆皱与轻微卷边。下身是褪色黑色低腰牛仔裤，带暖棕色对比车线、金属纽扣、铆钉和清晰的前袋结构。上衣与裤腰之间露出约2至4厘米的下腹和腰线，但不要增加原图没有的身体裸露。

人物佩戴黑色窄框椭圆太阳镜，深色镜片完全遮住双眼。她的头向画面左下方低垂，像是在观察左手中夹着的一个白色耳塞。嘴唇自然微张，下唇松弛，没有笑容，神态安静、克制而略显疏离。不要让她正面直视镜头，也不要塑造成正式摆拍。她的左侧手臂抬起并向外伸展，手指松散地夹住耳塞；另一只手停留在腰腹与上衣下摆附近。白色有线耳机从手中垂落，在胸腹前自然交叉、缠绕并延伸到牛仔裤区域，包含两个圆形耳塞和线控模块，不要把耳机线整理得过分规整。

保留偏窄的脸部轮廓、柔和下颌线与低头角度形成的真实透视，不替换成任何具体名人的面孔，也不强行定义人种或国籍。妆容参考90年代末至Y2K都市时尚杂志中的清洁轮廓妆：轻薄半哑光底妆、暖米杏肤色、低饱和砖杏或暖裸棕唇色，鼻梁、脸颊和唇面保留真实日光高光。太阳镜遮住眼妆，不需要夸张睫毛或浓重眼线。

她有接近黑色的深棕黑长发，头发自然披散，略偏侧分。风把额前、太阳穴与肩侧的碎发吹起，形成不规则飞丝和分束。发型不要广告级顺滑整齐；阳光照到的发丝边缘可以呈柔和棕色透光，阴影中的头发保持浓黑和真实重量。可见耳朵上佩戴一枚中等尺寸的细银色圆环耳饰，手腕戴细小黑色珠串手链。

清楚表现可见皮肤区域：双侧肩部、腋窝边缘、上臂、前臂、手腕、双手、颈部侧面、下颌附近，以及上衣和裤腰之间的一小段下腹与腰部。胸部被针织上衣完整覆盖，背部、臀部和腿部不直接裸露。皮肤为暖米杏至浅暖小麦色，直射阳光中的区域呈蜂蜜金色，阴影中转为较深的暖棕色。保留细小毛孔、指关节纹路、轻微色差和自然触感，使肩臂皮肤像被太阳晒暖后干爽柔滑，下腹皮肤略柔软；不要使用蜡质磨皮或塑料皮肤。

使用硬质的下午偏晚日光，从画面左上方斜射，色温约5200K至5800K。日光在鼻梁、脸颊、肩峰、手臂外侧和手指上形成明确的暖色高光，太阳镜在面颊上投下清楚的阴影，鼻下与下颌形成锐利暗部。建筑阴影切过举起的前臂，在皮肤上留下几何形深影。不要使用正面补光、均匀柔光、明显轮廓灯或HDR提亮，让人物停留在阳光与建筑阴影的真实交界处。

相机位于人物胸口至肩部高度，接近平视但略低于面部，使用全画幅等效约70至85毫米的中长焦视觉效果，光圈感觉约f/2至f/2.8。画面取腰部以上中近景，人物头顶接近上边缘，身体偏右，左侧伸出的手和耳塞占据留白。右侧手臂与髋部被画面边缘自然裁切，不追求绝对水平或标准中心构图。背景为明显虚化的城市建筑：左侧是被太阳照亮的暖米黄色店铺或建筑立面，中间与右侧是深灰墙面、门窗、横梁、遮阳棚或栏杆，并可出现极其模糊的路人痕迹。背景应保持可辨认的城市结构，但不能抢焦点。

整体质感结合真实街拍、轻时尚编辑感与暖色胶片扫描效果。加入细微胶片颗粒、暗部噪点、轻微高光泛光和柔和的色彩压缩，不要过度锐化。保留风吹乱发、耳机线打结、肩线倾斜、局部过曝边缘和深重阴影。这一刻像是她刚从口袋里取出耳机，上一秒仍在阳光下行走，现在低头停顿，下一秒就会戴上耳机离开。画面情绪冷静、独立、略带反叛，拥有旧日夏日下午残留下来的温度。

负面提示词： 正面证件照，直视镜头，镜面自拍，左右翻转，低领上衣，额外裸露，无线耳机，耳机线消失，错误线缆，多余手指，畸形手掌，夸张身材，僵硬姿势，棚拍柔光，均匀补光，塑料皮肤，过度磨皮，背景清晰，过度HDR，霓虹赛博朋克，平台水印，文字，Logo。

title: 优化后文本：
