prompt:
请根据用户输入的【品牌名 / 项目名】【副标题 / 产品名】【类型 / 行业】【地域风味】【品牌定位】【核心关键词】【核心图形】【核心食物 / 品类元素】【情绪气质】【主色调】【辅助色】【画幅比例】，设计一个高完成度的「国潮复古餐饮徽章 Logo / Chinese Retro Food Emblem Logo」。

【用户输入】
品牌名 / 项目名：[品牌名 / 项目名]
副标题 / 产品名：[副标题 / 产品名]
类型 / 行业：[类型 / 行业]
地域风味：[港式 / 粤式 / 湘味 / 川味 / 炭火 / 夜宵 / 茶餐厅 / 烧味 / 海鲜 / 小酒馆等]
品牌定位：[品牌定位]
核心关键词：[复古、国潮、招牌感、老字号感、烟火气、江湖感、新消费感等]
核心图形：[龙 / 凤 / 鹤 / 虎 / 牛 / 蛙 / 鹅 / 鱼 / 龙虾 / 器具 / 图腾 / 吉祥纹样等]
核心食物 / 品类元素：[烧鹅 / 烧烤 / 茶饮 / 龙虾 / 面食 / 牛肉 / 冰室 / 酒馆等]
情绪气质：[热闹、霸气、复古、经典、地方感、烟火气、江湖感、年轻化等]
主色调：[主色调]
辅助色：[辅助色]
画幅比例：[画幅比例]

【核心目标】
这次要设计的是一个真正可用于餐饮品牌的「国潮复古餐饮徽章 Logo」。它不是普通海报，也不是简单卡通插画，更不是只写几个字。请以中文主字标为核心，融合强识别图形、餐饮品类符号、复古中英文排版和完整徽章式结构，打造一个具有门头感、包装感、品牌系统感和传播感的餐饮 Logo。

最终结果应让人一眼感受到：
1. 这是一个餐饮品牌；
2. 它有明确品类和个性；
3. 它像一个成熟的品牌主标，而不是一张装饰性图案。

【设计本质】
这类 Logo 的核心不是单一图形或单一字体，而是以下五层整合：
1. 中文主字标：负责品牌识别；
2. 图形符号：负责记忆点与品类联想；
3. 徽章结构：负责整体完整性；
4. 中英文排版：负责层次感与复古品牌氛围；
5. 颜色系统：负责强化餐饮调性和品类情绪。

【最重要的原则】
1. 中文品牌名必须醒目、清楚、具有招牌感；
2. Logo 必须是一个完整标识，而不是零散元素拼贴；
3. 图形必须与品牌名或品类相关，不能为了装饰而装饰；
4. 英文为辅助，中文为主，英文不能喧宾夺主；
5. 整体必须有餐饮品牌属性，适合门头、菜单、包装和社媒头像；
6. 画面必须有复古感，但不能老气、脏乱或失去现代品牌完成度；
7. 必须有“国潮复古餐饮徽章”的味道，而不是美式卡通或日式商铺字标。

【中文主字标要求】
1. 中文品牌名为绝对主角；
2. 字体要有复古餐饮招牌感、老包装感或国潮标题感；
3. 可以厚重、粗壮、有黑体 / 宋黑 / 商业手写感；
4. 可以做适度变体，但必须清晰可读；
5. 不要极简细字体，不要弱，不要像普通系统字；
6. 需具备门头感和品牌标识感。

【图形系统要求】
请根据【核心图形】与【品类元素】设计一个与品牌高度相关的主图形。
可选方向包括：
- 动物 / 神兽：龙、凤、虎、牛、鹅、鱼、蛙、鹤等；
- 食材 / 菜品：龙虾、烧鹅、牛肉、面碗、火焰、茶杯等；
- 传统图腾：章印、纹样、牌匾、吉祥图案；
- 器具 / 场景符号：烤架、火焰、碗筷、冰室元素等。

图形要求：
1. 要有记忆点；
2. 要与品类和名字有明确关系；
3. 不要做得太复杂写实；
4. 要适合与字标整合为徽章；
5. 可以偏复古插画、版画感、老商标感、国潮线描感。

【徽章结构要求】
请把整体设计成一个完整的“餐饮品牌徽章 Logo”，而不是简单横排。
结构可参考以下方式：
1. 上方英文拱形 + 中央图形 + 下方中文主字标；
2. 中央大图形 + 左右小标签 + 下方副标题；
3. 圆章 / 椭圆章 / 牌匾式构图；
4. 中心主图 + 上下分层文字；
5. 对称排版 + 小图章 + 小圆标系统；
6. 老招牌 / 老商标 / 包装主标式版式。

【中英文排版要求】
1. 中文为主，英文为辅；
2. 英文可用于拱形主标题、品类名、店型说明、口号、年份、ESTD 等；
3. 英文参与构图，增强复古商标感；
4. 英文不需要过多，但要精致、清晰、服务整体结构；
5. 可以使用如：
   - HOUSE
   - TAVERN
   - BARBECUE
   - ROAST GOOSE
   - TEA RESTAURANT
   - LOBSTER HOUSE
   - ESTD / SINCE / CLASSIC / SPECIALTY
6. 不要让英文压过中文，也不要变成纯英文品牌。

【辅助元素要求】
可以加入少量增强品牌系统感的小元素，例如：
- ESTD 年份
- 小圆章
- 小图标
- 小标签
- 小印章
- 地域说明
- 品类说明
- 横线 / 点阵 / 小边框
- slogan 小字

但必须克制，不能把画面做成复杂海报。

【色彩要求】
请根据品牌品类选择更合适的国潮复古餐饮色彩系统，例如：
1. 黑 + 红：烧烤、卤味、烧味、小酒馆；
2. 黑 + 金 / 棕金：老字号、熟食、烧鹅、粤式餐饮；
3. 绿 + 红 + 米白：港式冰室、茶餐厅；
4. 蓝 + 红 + 白：海鲜、龙虾、年轻夜宵餐饮；
5. 黑 + 蓝：更年轻、更理性一点的夜宵或酒馆；
6. 红 + 米白：老长沙粉面、传统小吃等。

要求：
- 色彩有餐饮招牌感；
- 颜色不宜过多，2~4 个主色最稳；
- 高饱和点缀可以增强吸睛度，但必须控制统一性。

【画面呈现要求】
1. 这是独立 Logo 展示图，不是菜单海报；
2. 背景简洁，建议浅灰白、米白、纸白或纯净浅底；
3. Logo 主体完整、清晰、居中；
4. 结构完整、信息有层次；
5. 整体看起来像一个成熟餐饮品牌的主 Logo 提案。

【风格关键词】
国潮复古餐饮徽章 Logo、Chinese Retro Food Emblem Logo、餐饮品牌、复古商标、老招牌、品牌徽章、中英混排、国潮字标、餐饮主标、门头感、包装感、老字号感、新消费餐饮。

【验收标准】
请确保最终结果满足：
1. 一眼看出是餐饮品牌；
2. 中文主字标醒目好认；
3. 图形与品牌名 / 品类有明确关系；
4. 徽章结构完整；
5. 中英文排版有层次；
6. 配色有餐饮品牌气质；
7. 适合门头、菜单、包装、贴纸、外卖头像和社媒主图使用；
8. 整体有“国潮复古餐饮徽章”的成熟商业感。

【输出要求】
请最终输出一个高完成度的「国潮复古餐饮徽章 Logo」。它必须以中文品牌名为核心，结合复古图形、中英文辅助系统、徽章式构图和明确的品类属性，形成一个真正可品牌化、可传播、可落地的餐饮品牌标识。

title: 生成一张高完成度的「角色世界观档案卡」。
prompt:
生成一张高完成度的「角色世界观档案卡」。

【基础设定】
主题角色：【角色名称】  
所属作品：【作品名称】  
角色定位：【主角 / 反派 / 导师 / 战士 / 法师 / 忍者 / 调查兵团兵长 / 咒术师 / 精灵魔法使等】  
主标题文字：【必须准确显示角色中文全名，例如：漩涡鸣人】  
副标题文字：【可填写角色称号 / 短标语 / 角色定位】  
画幅比例：【3:4 竖版】  
主色调：【如黑橙、黑蓝、黑红、银蓝、黑白灰等】  
点缀色：【如火焰橙、电光蓝、猩红、金色、冷白光等】  
核心能力：【如螺旋丸、九尾之力、无量空处、立体机动装置、古代魔法等】  
标志元素：【如狐狸虚影、火焰、机械装置、星辉法阵、蓝色能量、废墟高塔等】  

【整体风格】
这不是普通人物插画，也不是简单角色卡，而是一张“高信息密度 + 强视觉冲击 + 角色设定感 + 海报级完成度”的动漫角色档案海报。  
整体风格融合：角色立像海报、视觉档案设计、中文排版海报、设定集封面、动漫周边收藏卡、高级杂志编排感。  
要求画面精致、清晰、酷、有冲击力，同时具备完整的信息结构与系列感。

【构图要求】
采用强烈的“斜对角分割构图”：
- 左上区域为浅色留白区 / 纸张质感区 / 档案信息区
- 右下区域为深色氛围区 / 能量区 / 世界观场景区
- 中间由一条明显的斜切边界分开，形成强烈的视觉张力
- 角色完整全身站在画面中央，略偏中间，正面向前走来或坚定站立
- 人物必须完整，不要裁掉头部、脚部，不要被文字遮挡
- 角色要有明确主角感、压迫感、登场感

【人物表现】
角色面部清晰，五官准确，符合该角色的典型气质与核心特征。  
服装、发型、武器、护具、装置、饰品等要具有高辨识度。  
姿态建议为：向前行走、坚定站立、正面出场、带有轻微动态。  
角色周围可加入与其能力相关的能量特效、烟雾、火焰、粒子、法阵、查克拉、电流、星辉等元素，增强画面冲击力。

【背景与世界观】
背景要与角色设定强关联：
- 浅色区：可带有旧纸、磨损纸张、档案纹理、墨痕、留白、印章感、细线框
- 深色区：可带有废墟、夜空、火焰、能量漩涡、机械装置、古城遗迹、战场、法阵、烟尘、远景建筑等
- 背景要有氛围，但不能喧宾夺主
- 角色后方可以加入半透明的巨大汉字底纹，增强设计感

【文字与排版系统】
所有主要信息统一改为中文排版，强调“中文角色档案海报”的视觉气质。  
主标题必须准确显示：【角色中文全名】。  
主标题建议用超大中文书法字 / 毛笔感字形 / 有冲击力的大字排版，放置在左上浅色区，允许竖排、断行、错位排版。  
可以加入一个较小的副标题标签，例如：
- 最强咒术师
- 忍者档案
- 调查兵团兵长
- 千年精灵魔法使
- 火焰之柱

【信息模块建议】
画面中加入完整但简洁的档案信息模块，建议包含以下内容中的 5–8 项：
- 身份
- 阵营
- 目标
- 武器 / 装置
- 核心术式 / 核心技能
- 评级
- 代号
- 信念
- 羁绊
- 作战风格
- 能力评估
- 档案记录
- 角色语录

例如可做成左侧横条信息栏、右侧小模块说明框、下方短段落档案备注等。

【图形与装饰系统】
加入现代中文视觉设计元素：
- 斜切信息条
- 细线边框
- 几何辅助线
- 小型数据标签
- 编号
- 坐标
- 评级条
- 小型说明框
- 红色印章 / 黑色印章
- 墨迹飞溅
- 断裂纹理
- 半透明大字底纹

注意图形元素是辅助，不要过多堆满，不要做成杂乱的PPT。

【画面气质】
整体要：
- 高级
- 清晰
- 有收藏感
- 有视觉冲击力
- 有动漫角色设定集气质
- 有中文海报的力量感
- 有强烈主视觉
- 有较高信息完成度

【特别要求】
1. 主标题必须准确显示：【角色中文全名】，不能缺字，不能错字。  
2. 角色必须全身完整呈现。  
3. 画面必须采用“斜对角切割”的版式，而不是普通左右平分。  
4. 所有文字以中文为主，可少量搭配英文编号，但不能喧宾夺主。  
5. 最终成品要像“动漫角色档案海报”，而不是普通宣传图。

title: 电影感女性
prompt:
[BRAND NAME] | [HEADLINE = user text or AUTO] | [SUBHEADLINE = user text or AUTO] | [BUTTON TEXT = user text or AUTO] | [COLOR = your color or AUTO]

Act as a Senior Web Art Director and CGI Artist creating a photorealistic hero section of a premium brand website — a single wide-format image showing the full above-the-fold view of a hero webpage. The composition combines a dramatic 3D sculptural logo object with editorial typography and minimal UI elements. References: Stökt agency website, Apple product launch pages, high-end creative agency hero sections, Awwwards-winning website design.

---

PHASE 0: BRAND INTELLIGENCE — AUTONOMOUS EXTRACTION

Perform a complete brand decode of [BRAND NAME] from training data before generating anything. Every visual decision in the image is derived from this phase.

COLOR SYSTEM — PRIMARY COLOR DETERMINATION: if [COLOR] is provided by the user — use that exact color as the primary driver for the entire image color system. Do not override it with brand colors. If [COLOR] is AUTO — identify the exact primary brand color of [BRAND NAME] from their official guidelines — the single most iconic, most documented color associated with the brand. In both cases: this one color drives the entire image's color system — background gradient, 3D object material, atmospheric lighting, all derived from this single color.

BACKGROUND GRADIENT DERIVATION: from the determined primary color derive exactly two gradient stops. Inner stop: the most saturated vivid version of the primary color at full intensity — this is the atmospheric glow behind the object. Outer stop: the darkest possible version of the same hue — near black but with a visible trace of the color's hue remaining (#0A to #12 lightness range). Both stops are derived exclusively from the primary color. No neutral black. No grey. The darkness has color in it — it is a very dark tinted black, not a neutral one. Examples: red primary → inner #CC0000, outer #1A0000. Green primary → inner #1DB954, outer #001A0A. Blue primary → inner #0057FF, outer #00060F. Orange primary → inner #FF6600, outer #1A0500.

3D OBJECT MATERIAL DERIVATION: from the primary color derive the metal material — base/shadow color: the darkest near-black version of the color hue (same as gradient outer stop). Highlight color: the most vivid saturated version of the color (same as gradient inner stop), appearing on edges and high points facing the light source. Mid-tone: a medium value of the color on surfaces at 45° to the light. The entire metal object is one color family — dark in shadow, vivid and bright in highlight, all derived from the same hue. No neutral grey metal. No silver. The metal has the brand or user color in its DNA.

TYPOGRAPHY: identify [BRAND NAME]'s official typeface character — the visual weight, width, and style used in their brand communications. Apply consistently to all text elements.

BRAND SYMBOL: identify the single most iconic reduced form of [BRAND NAME]'s logo — the symbol, monogram, or letterform most recognizable as the brand. This becomes the 3D sculptural object. If [BRAND NAME] has no standalone symbol — use the first letter of the wordmark as the 3D form.

BRAND LANGUAGE: if [HEADLINE] is AUTO — extract the most powerful real brand statement or campaign headline associated with [BRAND NAME]. If [SUBHEADLINE] is AUTO — extract a real brand descriptor sentence describing what [BRAND NAME] does or stands for. If [BUTTON TEXT] is AUTO — identify the primary CTA phrase [BRAND NAME] uses in their marketing. If any variable has user-provided text — use that exact text, do not override it.

FOUNDING INFORMATION: extract [BRAND NAME]'s founding year for the bottom corner attribution.

---

PHASE 1: BACKGROUND

Full-bleed background filling the entire image. A radial gradient emanating from the center-right zone where the 3D object sits — not a flat color, not a linear gradient, a circular atmospheric glow. Inner zone: the saturated vivid color derived in PHASE 0 — deep, rich, atmospheric, occupying approximately 40 to 50% of the total background area. Outer zone: the very dark tinted black derived in PHASE 0 — envelops the composition at all edges. The transition is soft and organic — a gradual atmospheric fade, not a hard edge. The gradient creates the sensation of a warm spotlight behind and to the right of the 3D object — as if the object itself is the source of this atmospheric light.

---

PHASE 2: 3D LOGO SCULPTURE — HERO ELEMENT

The brand symbol from PHASE 0 rendered as a massive three-dimensional sculptural object. Occupies the right 55 to 65% of total image width — monumental, partially cropped by the right and bottom frame edges. The cropping is deliberate — we see most but not all of the object, implying it extends beyond the frame. Rotated approximately 20 to 35° on the vertical axis and 10 to 20° on the horizontal axis — a dynamic three-quarter view revealing multiple faces simultaneously. Camera angle: 5 to 10° below center — adds imposing low-angle presence.

MATERIAL SYSTEM — DERIVED FROM PRIMARY COLOR: the object is premium dark brushed metal. All material colors derived exclusively from the primary color as determined in PHASE 0. Base/shadow color: very dark near-black color-tinted metal on faces away from the light. Brushed texture: fine parallel directional micro-scratches on each face following the face geometry — industrial brushed metal quality. Highlight zones: faces angled toward the primary light source catch the vivid saturated color as warm bright highlights — ranging from mid-tone color to near-white at absolute specular peaks. Edge highlights: every sharp edge of the object catches a thin continuous bright specular line tracing the full logo geometry — this edge glow defines the form against the background. The contrast between near-black shadowed faces and bright vivid-colored highlighted edges is the defining visual characteristic. Scale feel: monumental — as if 3 to 5 meters tall in physical space.

---

PHASE 3: NAVIGATION BAR

Minimal navbar at the very top — height approximately 4 to 5% of total image height. Background: very dark semi-transparent — the tinted dark color from PHASE 0 at 85 to 90% opacity. Left: [BRAND NAME] wordmark or logomark in correct official form, small white type. Center: 4 to 6 navigation categories in small all-caps tracked white type — autonomously determine relevant categories based on [BRAND NAME]'s business. Right: language switcher pill and primary CTA button — dark background, light border, small caps "[BUTTON TEXT]" with right arrow →. All navbar elements small, precise, minimal — do not compete with hero elements.

---

PHASE 4: TEXT BLOCK — LEFT SIDE

Positioned in the left 35 to 40% of the image, vertically centered, left-aligned with appropriate margin. The left side is in the darker zone of the background gradient — white text is fully legible without additional treatment.

Label line: small bracketed label above the headline — "{ WE ARE [BRAND NAME] } →" or brand-appropriate equivalent. Very small type, white, tracked out, thin weight.

Headline: [HEADLINE] — set in [BRAND NAME]'s typographic character, bold, uppercase or sentence case per brand convention. Large — approximately 8 to 10% of total image height per line. White. Two to three lines maximum. Left-aligned.

Body copy: [SUBHEADLINE] — one to two sentences, small regular weight, white at 70 to 80% opacity. Below headline with appropriate spacing. Maximum 35 to 40 characters per line.

CTA buttons: two side-by-side buttons. Primary: dark fill, white border, white text "[BUTTON TEXT]" with right arrow →. Secondary: outline only, white border, white text with secondary action autonomously determined from [BRAND NAME]'s context. Both buttons small and minimal — slightly rounded rectangle, small caps type.

---

PHASE 5: BOTTOM ELEMENTS

Bottom left: "Scroll for more ↓" in very small white type — 2 to 3% of image height, subtle.

Bottom right: "Est. in [FOUNDING YEAR]" in very small white type — founding year from PHASE 0, same scale.

---

PHASE 6: LIGHTING

Single primary light source: warm dramatic light positioned behind and to the upper right of the 3D object. Light color: the vivid saturated primary color from PHASE 0 — it is the color expressed as atmospheric light, consistent with the gradient inner stop. This light creates both the background radial glow and the warm highlights on the metal object — they are the same light, the same color, the same source. Secondary ambient: very subtle cool ambient from directly above — 5% intensity, barely lifts the absolute darkest shadow zones. No fill lights. No rim lights. The dramatic contrast between lit and unlit faces is intentional and must be preserved.

---

PHASE 7: COMPOSITION

Aspect ratio: 16:9 landscape — website hero section proportions. Left 35 to 40%: text zone (darker background, UI elements). Right 60 to 65%: 3D sculpture zone (object dominates). Text block and object do not overlap — clear spatial separation. Reading direction: text left → sculpture right.

---

PHASE 8: TECH SPECS

Render: Octane Render or Redshift — physically accurate brushed metal with correct anisotropic highlight behavior. All material colors derived from the primary color as determined in PHASE 0 — no neutral greys, no off-color elements anywhere in the image. If [COLOR] was user-provided — that color overrides any brand color in all material and lighting calculations. Ray tracing: on — for accurate edge highlights and metal inter-reflections. Background gradient: physically accurate radial atmospheric light — real volumetric light contribution, not a composited gradient overlay. Typography: crisp, anti-aliased, flat white — zero shadows, zero blur, zero effects. UI elements: clean flat design, no drop shadows, no gradients on UI elements. Color palette: exclusively the color system derived in PHASE 0 plus white for text — no additional colors introduced anywhere. Sampling: minimum 2048 samples. Anti-aliasing: maximum. Output feel: the actual above-the-fold screenshot of [BRAND NAME]'s relaunched premium website — Awwwards front page quality.

prompt:
REFERENCE IMAGE INSTRUCTION: Use the uploaded product photo as the exact source of truth for the product's appearance, color, finish, branding, and form factor. Do not invent or alter any product detail. Reproduce it with photorealistic precision.
---
Create a photorealistic premium [PRODUCT CATEGORY] campaign poster in a 4:5 vertical aspect ratio. Design it as a clean global OOH, digital, and social campaign layout with strict grid alignment, premium white space, and precise typography. The campaign idea is "[CAMPAIGN TAGLINE]," but do not render that phrase as visible text.

Use a strict 12-column poster grid with 6% outer margins. Keep all text aligned to this grid. The image has four layers: background shape, giant background typography, subject/product photography, and clean graphic text overlays.

BACKGROUND: Pure matte white canvas. Place one large rounded-rectangle block behind the subject, occupying roughly 70% of the poster height and 76% of the width, centered slightly above the middle. The block uses a controlled [PRIMARY BRAND COLOR] gradient, glowing gently from top-left to bottom-right. Behind the subject and product, place giant cropped typography reading "[BACKGROUND HERO WORD]" in ultra-bold geometric sans-serif letters. The word is a background layer only: huge, partially cropped by the frame edges, wide letter spacing, darker [PRIMARY BRAND COLOR] than the rectangle, subtle embossed depth, soft shadow, and low enough contrast that it does not fight the product.

SUBJECT AND PRODUCT: [DESCRIBE MODEL OR SUBJECT — e.g., "a female model with a clean editorial look, neutral confident expression, natural slightly wind-touched hair, muted off-white outfit, and [ACCENT COLOR] jacket"]. Shoot from a slightly low hero angle. Body angled for depth, face turned toward the viewer with direct eye contact. One hand extends toward the camera holding the product from the uploaded reference image. The product is the dominant foreground object, slightly tilted to reveal [KEY PRODUCT DETAIL — e.g., "the triple camera system, brushed titanium edges, and centered brand logo"]. Keep the product sharp with realistic surface reflections, material texture, faint micro-details, and soft bloom around premium features. Keep the model's face readable behind it.

LIGHTING: Soft studio key light from front-left, warm rim light from the right, and subtle [PRIMARY BRAND COLOR] bounce from the background block. Skin remains natural and non-airbrushed with realistic catchlights. Product edges have clean [MATERIAL FINISH — e.g., "metallic / matte / glossy"] highlights. Shadows are soft and controlled.

TYPOGRAPHY OVERLAY: All text must be flat, crisp, perfectly aligned graphic typography — not painted onto the scene. Render exactly these text elements once, with no extra text:

Top left, small black logo: [BRAND LOGO NAME/MARK]

Top right, thin sans-serif: "[BRAND SUB-TAGLINE — e.g., 'Built for Apple Intelligence.']"

Mid left, glassmorphism pill: "[PRODUCT NAME — e.g., 'iPhone 17 Pro']"

Large background type: "[BACKGROUND HERO WORD]"

Bottom right body copy, small clean sans-serif:
"[PRODUCT NAME]. [POWER STATEMENT — one sentence.]
[FEATURE 1]. [FEATURE 2].
[CLOSING LINE — e.g., 'Designed for what's next.']"

BOTTOM FEATURE STRIP: Place four equal-width glass-white rounded cards along the bottom, aligned to the grid, same height, same spacing, same baseline alignment. Each card has one minimal line icon above the heading. Render exactly:
Card 1: "[FEATURE HEADING 1]" / "[FEATURE SUBLINE 1]"
Card 2: "[FEATURE HEADING 2]" / "[FEATURE SUBLINE 2]"
Card 3: "[FEATURE HEADING 3]" / "[FEATURE SUBLINE 3]"
Card 4: "[FEATURE HEADING 4]" / "[FEATURE SUBLINE 4]"

GRAPHIC DETAILS: Two or three small sparkle icons only, subtle grain, soft glassmorphism, controlled [PRIMARY BRAND COLOR]-white-[ACCENT COLOR] palette, no neon, no oversaturation.

title: 赛博朋克建筑
prompt:
A Japanese voxel asset sheet showing the type of objects, structures, props, vegetation, terrain pieces, and decorative elements that should exist in the game.

Your goal is to create a playable browser game prototype inspired by these two images.

Important rule:
You must first create the full game asset pack yourself, based on the visual style and content of the two reference images.
Do not import external visual assets.
Do not use stock images.
Do not use asset packs from elsewhere.
Do not use placeholder icons or random UI packs.
Everything visible in the game must come from assets you generate specifically for this project.

Asset creation phase:
Before building the game, generate a complete coherent 2D isometric asset pack inspired by the provided references.

Create an `/assets` folder and generate all required visual assets as separate transparent PNG files.

The created assets must match the style of the references:
- Japanese voxel / cubic / blocky style
- isometric view
- clean readable silhouettes
- soft pastel colors
- polished premium prototype feel
- cute but structured temple-builder aesthetic

Required assets to create:
Terrain:
- grass tile
- path tile
- dirt tile
- water tile
- stone tile
- stairs tile
- canal edge tile

Borders / structure helpers:
- straight fence
- corner fence
- gate fence
- stone post

Nature:
- bamboo cluster
- sakura tree
- small tree / shrub
- grass tuft
- flower bush

Lighting / shrine props:
- stone lantern
- hanging lantern
- torii gate
- shrine box / small altar
- signpost
- banner flag

Water features / farming / utilities:
- small bridge
- well
- rice paddy
- crop patch
- vegetable garden
- water bucket

Decorative props:
- wooden crate
- wooden bench
- hay bale
- rock cluster
- large rock
- mossy rock
- flat stone
- pebbles
- stone pile
- boulder
- wood pile
- storage box
- stone basin

Buildings:
- small hut
- main house
- pagoda
- watchtower
- main temple

UI assets:
- button backgrounds
- panel backgrounds
- category tabs
- toolbar buttons
- hover highlight tile
- placement preview highlight
- simple custom icons if needed, created in the same style

All generated assets must be visually consistent with each other and suitable for an isometric builder game.

Game concept:
Create a small Japanese voxel temple builder game called:

Japanese Temple Voxels

The player can build a tiny voxel temple village on an isometric grid.

Core gameplay:
- The game starts with an empty isometric terrain grid.
- The player can select assets from a bottom asset palette.
- The player can place selected assets on the grid.
- The player can erase placed assets.
- The player can switch between terrain, nature, props, water, and buildings.
- The player can pan and zoom the view.
- The player can save the current layout in localStorage.
- The player can reset the world.
- The player can toggle the grid visibility.
- The goal is creative building, not combat.

Visual direction:
The final game must feel like the provided Japanese voxel builder screenshot:
- soft isometric camera
- clean pastel UI
- Japanese temple village mood
- cream / light background
- floating square terrain platform
- subtle shadows
- polished browser-game prototype feeling
- calm Japanese garden atmosphere

Do not recreate the screenshot as a static image.
Build an actual interactive prototype.

Technical constraints:
- Use HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
- The game must run directly in the browser by opening `index.html`.
- Organize the code like a senior developer.
- Do not put everything into one giant file.
- Separate asset generation, asset loading, game logic, rendering, input, UI, and storage into clear modules.

Suggested structure:

/index.html
/src/main.js
/src/config.js
/src/assets/generateAssets.js
/src/assets/assetManifest.js
/src/assets/assetLoader.js
/src/core/Game.js
/src/core/Camera.js
/src/core/InputManager.js
/src/core/Renderer.js
/src/grid/IsoGrid.js
/src/grid/TileMap.js
/src/building/PlacementSystem.js
/src/building/PlacedObject.js
/src/ui/UIManager.js
/src/ui/Toolbar.js
/src/ui/AssetPalette.js
/src/ui/HUD.js
/src/storage/SaveSystem.js
/assets/

Important implementation detail:
The project must include a step or script that creates the visual assets first, saves them into `/assets/`, then uses those generated assets in the game.
All final in-game visuals must come from that generated asset pack.

Gameplay details:
- Use an isometric 2D rendering approach.
- Render the world using the created PNG assets.
- Use proper isometric depth sorting.
- The grid should be at least 10x10.
- Terrain tiles cover the base grid.
- Buildings and props sit on top of tiles.
- Larger structures like pagoda, temple, and watchtower occupy multiple cells.
- Small props like lanterns, rocks, bamboo, crops, and signs occupy one cell.
- Water and canal pieces should visually connect nicely.
- Show a preview before placement.
- Highlight the hovered grid cell.
- Prevent large buildings from overlapping placed objects.
- Allow replacing terrain without deleting props above it.
- Allow erasing props/buildings separately from terrain.

UI requirements:
- Title: Japanese Temple Voxels
- Left toolbar:
  - Place
  - Erase
  - Pan
  - Grid toggle
  - Save
  - Reset
- Bottom asset palette:
  - Terrain
  - Nature
  - Props
  - Water
  - Buildings
- The palette must use the created asset images as icons.
- Show the selected asset clearly.
- Add a small instruction panel:
  - Click to place
  - Right click or Erase mode to remove
  - Drag to pan
  - Mouse wheel to zoom
- Keep all visible UI text in English.

Interactions:
- Left click places the selected asset.
- Right click erases the object on the selected cell.
- Mouse drag pans the camera.
- Mouse wheel zooms in/out.
- Keyboard shortcuts:
  - 1 Terrain
  - 2 Nature
  - 3 Props
  - 4 Water
  - 5 Buildings
  - E Erase mode
  - G Toggle grid
  - S Save
  - R Reset

Rendering:
- Use canvas-based rendering or a clean DOM/canvas hybrid.
- Keep performance smooth.
- Add subtle drop shadows under objects.
- Add a soft background grid or foggy editor-style backdrop.
- The final result should feel like a polished playable prototype.

Important:
Do not use external assets.
Do not use emoji icons.
Do not use external icon libraries.
Do not use placeholder art.
Create the assets first, then build the game with them.
Every visible object in the final game must come from the generated project asset pack.

Deliverable:
Create the complete working project.
Generate the full asset pack into `/assets/`.
Then build the playable browser prototype using only those generated assets.
The final prototype must open with `index.html` and let the player build a small Japanese temple voxel village.

婚礼主题：________

【任务定位】
这不是普通婚纱照，也不是单纯礼服海报，而是一张完整的婚礼造型提案板。画面需要同时包含：造型主视觉、3套场景化 Look、色彩系统、材质分析、廓形说明、妆发/发型、珠宝/鞋履/花束/配饰建议，以及场景适配说明。

重要说明：
同一个婚礼主题需要分别生成两张图：

顶部：标题区

英文副标题写「AI Wedding Styling Board」  
并写明主题名称、人物模式和一句风格说明。

左侧：主视觉造型区  
展示最核心的婚礼造型效果。人物应为成年中国新娘或新郎，气质高级、自然、优雅，造型完整，姿态端正，有婚礼仪式感。不要低俗，不要影楼感，不要脸部僵硬。

中部：3套场景化 Look  
请输出三套完整造型：

Look 01：主仪式 Look / Ceremony Hero Look

prompt:
Design a 4:5 sports art poster for 'ATHELETE_NAME' using realistic, soft, thick painted motion fields, player’s leap translated into directional brush energy, a vertical ascension composition, and an emotional goal of disciplined transcendence and cold precision. 

CONCEPT: player is not just depicted—he is constructed out of force. His iconic jump is visualized as a surge of realistic paint strokes based on PLAYER’s team jersey colors, rising like a controlled explosion, turning athletic elevation into a visual language of upward pressure, discipline, and momentum. The poster captures the instant where physical power becomes abstract motion. 

SUBJECT: player rendered as a dominant semi-abstract figure emerging from layered, soft, freshly painted strokes rather than a fully literal photograph. His body is partially defined—recognizable facial structure and torso clarity—but limbs dissolve into sweeping, thick paint gestures, especially around the legs and arms, emphasizing lift and motion. The figure is angled upward, as if still climbing, occupying the central vertical axis but never fully contained. 

COMPOSITION: A vertical ascension layout where the bottom third is dense with heavy, soft, realistic brush strokes, gradually opening into lighter, more fluid white space toward the top. The eye path starts at thick, grounded painted textures and travels upward through flowing lines and fragmented form into player’s mid-air presence. Negative space at the top acts as a zone of calm highlight contrast against the dense painted energy below. The background behaves like a freshly painted atmosphere, not a flat field, with directional strokes reinforcing upward motion.

TYPOGRAPHY: Headline: 'RISE WITHOUT LIMIT' set in a condensed athletic sans-serif brushed text, vertically stretched on the left side, and partially masked by soft paint strokes, as if emerging through layers. The baseline subtly curves upward, following the motion of the brushwork. 
Subhead: 'Discipline becomes flight.' in a restrained grotesk, placed lower in the composition where the paint is densest, anchoring the concept. Accent microtext appears as thin, almost hand-marked annotations integrated into the brushwork, echoing motion paths rather than sitting as static text. 

LIGHTING: Painterly lighting logic rather than photographic realism—high-contrast highlights use the lightest jersey color or white painted strokes to simulate directional light, while darker jersey tones create shadow depth. The figure’s defined areas receive subtle, controlled highlights to maintain legibility within abstraction. 

COLORS: Dominant palette based on PLAYER’s current or most iconic team jersey colors. Use the primary jersey color as the anchor, the secondary jersey color as the main motion accent, and white or the lightest jersey tone for highlights and negative-space contrast. Shadows should lean into the darkest available jersey color or a deepened version of the primary team color. Supporting tones may include softened, desaturated transitions derived from the jersey palette only. The overall palette must feel customized to the player’s team identity while preserving clarity, control, and intensity. 

STYLE: Abstract expressionist sports art fused with disciplined athletic branding; realistic painterly motion meets precision performance. The style feels like a gallery-worthy sports portrait, balancing soft, thick brush energy with controlled composition. 

FINISH: Visible realistic brush textures with layered paint depth, soft thick impasto effect in dense areas, and smoother, freshly diluted strokes in upper regions. No digital gloss—finish leans tactile and artistic, with gentle edge feathering where paint dissolves into negative space. No unnecessary overlays or artificial effects. 

FOOTER: A minimal, integrated footer carved into the lower paint mass, using small uppercase sans-serif text

---

PHASE 0: BRAND INTELLIGENCE — AUTONOMOUS RESEARCH

Perform a complete brand decode of [BRAND NAME] before generating anything.

COLOR SYSTEM: identify the exact two dominant colors [BRAND NAME] uses in hero campaign materials. Color 1: primary dark or neutral — the color used for portrait/product panels (black, deep navy, charcoal, or brand dark tone). Color 2: primary accent — the saturated vivid brand color used as the hero background for the central panel (hot pink for Adidas Argentina, signal orange for Nike, royal blue for Pepsi, etc). These two colors define the entire triptych — panels alternate or contrast between them. A brand designer must confirm these colors are correct.

TYPOGRAPHY CHARACTER: identify the typographic style [BRAND NAME] uses for campaign hero text. Describe its visual character precisely — script italic for fashion campaigns, bold condensed grotesque for sportswear, extended serif for luxury. The central panel typography must feel native to [BRAND NAME]'s visual language.

CAMPAIGN CONTENT: identify the most current or most iconic real campaign, product line, collaboration, or cultural moment associated with [BRAND NAME]. Extract: the campaign name, the hero product or collection name, a short product descriptor sentence (one real sentence used in [BRAND NAME] marketing), a CTA phrase consistent with [BRAND NAME]'s tone.

CULTURAL FIGURE: identify one real public figure — athlete, artist, musician, or cultural icon — who has a documented genuine relationship with [BRAND NAME] through sponsorship, collaboration, ambassadorship, or cultural association. This person appears in the left panel portrait.

---

PHASE 1: TRIPTYCH STRUCTURE

Single horizontal image — aspect ratio 3:1 or 16:5 ultrawide. Three equal-width vertical panels placed side by side with no gap between them — the panels bleed into each other creating a seamless wide composition. Each panel is a tall vertical rectangle, approximately 3:4 aspect ratio individually.

Panel 1 left: dark background (Color 1 from PHASE 0).
Panel 2 center: vivid accent background (Color 2 from PHASE 0).
Panel 3 right: same vivid accent background as center (Color 2) — or a slight variation.

The three panels read as one unified image — photography bleeds to frame edges on all sides, typography spans across panel boundaries where relevant.

---

PHASE 2: LEFT PANEL — PORTRAIT

The left panel is a dramatic close-up portrait of the cultural figure identified in PHASE 0. Shot tight — head and upper shoulders only, approximately 60 to 70% of the frame is the face and neck. The figure is in profile or 3/4 view — looking toward the center panel, not at camera. This directional gaze pulls the viewer's eye toward the center. The figure is wearing [BRAND NAME] product visibly. Lighting: dramatic, single source — strong side lighting creating deep shadows on the non-lit side of the face. The dark background (Color 1) envelopes the figure — no environmental context, pure portrait against dark. Upper left corner: the figure's name in small caps, light color, generous tracking — "LIONEL MESSI" style attribution. Lower left corner: a white or light-colored rectangular content block containing: campaign or product title in bold medium type, one sentence product descriptor in small regular type, a CTA button with arrow — "SHOP NOW →" style.

---

PHASE 3: CENTER PANEL — TYPOGRAPHIC HERO

The center panel is the most visually explosive element of the triptych. Background: Color 2 (vivid brand accent) at full saturation — pure flat color, no gradient. Two figures or one figure in a dynamic physical pose — movement, energy, action consistent with [BRAND NAME]'s brand world. The figures are wearing [BRAND NAME] products. The figures are positioned slightly off-center, overlapping with each other.

REPEATING TYPOGRAPHY SYSTEM: a single key word from the campaign — a country name, collection name, product name, or brand word — is typeset in a large italic or script display typeface and repeated three times vertically across the full height of the panel. The three repetitions vary in size: top instance — medium, partially cropped by the top edge. Middle instance — largest, approximately 40 to 50% of panel height, sitting behind or over the figures. Bottom instance — medium-large, partially cropped by the bottom edge. All three instances are the same word. The typography color: a vivid contrasting color — white, hot pink, or a third brand accent — with high visibility against Color 2. The figures exist on a layer between the background color and the typography — they are behind some type instances and in front of others, creating depth.

Above the figures: a small campaign identifier in all-caps tracked text — campaign name and trademark symbol. Below the figures: same campaign identifier repeated.

---

PHASE 4: RIGHT PANEL — PRODUCT CLOSE-UP

The right panel is a tight editorial crop of [BRAND NAME]'s hero product from the campaign — apparel, footwear, or accessory. The crop is intimate and detailed — showing the product at close range, revealing material texture, construction details, branding elements. Background: Color 2 (same as center panel) creating visual continuity. The product is worn or held by a partial figure — only a torso, hands, or legs visible, no face. A large graphic number or letter — a jersey number, collection code, or brand identifier — is positioned in the frame as a typographic accent, consistent with the treatment in the center panel.

---

PHASE 5: TYPOGRAPHY SYSTEM

All typography across the triptych uses the character identified in PHASE 0 — consistent visual language across all three panels. The repeating word in the center panel: italic, script, or bold display consistent with [BRAND NAME]'s campaign aesthetic. Attribution text, campaign identifiers, and CTA: clean sans-serif, all-caps, tracked — consistent with [BRAND NAME]'s informational typography. No decorative fonts outside the brand's documented visual language.

---

PHASE 6: LIGHTING & PHOTOGRAPHY

Left panel: dramatic portrait lighting — single strong side light, dark background, high contrast. Center panel: even bright studio lighting consistent with the flat vivid background — figures are cleanly lit, no heavy shadows. Right panel: product photography lighting — soft, revealing material texture and construction detail. All three panels feel like they were shot in the same campaign session — unified photographic language despite different lighting needs.

---

PHASE 7: COMPOSITION UNITY

The three panels must read as one image, not three separate images placed next to each other. Unity mechanisms: the typography from the center panel may bleed slightly into the edges of the left and right panels. The saturated Color 2 background of the center and right panels creates a visual block that anchors the right two-thirds of the composition. The dark Color 1 of the left panel creates contrast that makes the portrait pop. The figure's gaze in the left panel points toward the center. The overall reading direction: portrait left → typographic explosion center → product detail right.

---

PHASE 8: TECH SPECS

Aspect ratio: 3:1 or 16:5, single flat image — no separate panels, no borders between panels. Color palette: exactly Color 1 and Color 2 from PHASE 0, plus white or light neutral for typography. No additional colors. No gradients. No textures. Photography: editorial campaign quality — not stock photography. Typography: character consistent with [BRAND NAME]'s documented visual identity as described in PHASE 0. All campaign text, product names, and cultural figure attribution are real [BRAND NAME] data. Output feel: this image appears as the hero banner on [BRAND NAME]'s official website homepage or as a campaign outdoor billboard.

title: 电影感人物
prompt:
[PROMPTSREF]

Act as a Senior Brand Art Director and Editorial Poster Designer creating a horizontal editorial campaign poster where bold typography and photography are unified across a split-layout composition. The poster is deeply rooted in [BRAND NAME]'s real brand identity — colors, typography character, campaign language, and visual codes drawn from actual brand materials and campaigns.

IMPORTANT LIMITATION: Do not attempt to generate real identifiable people by name. Instead use a realistic figure whose appearance, clothing, and context are entirely consistent with [BRAND NAME]'s campaign aesthetic — wearing [BRAND NAME] products visibly, in an environment associated with the brand.

---

PHASE 0: BRAND INTELLIGENCE — STRICT BRANDBOOK ACCURACY

Perform a complete brand decode of [PROMPTSREF] from training data. Apply all of the following with maximum fidelity:

COLOR SYSTEM — ZERO APPROXIMATION: retrieve the exact official brand colors of [PROMPTSREF] as documented in their public brand guidelines and campaign materials. Identify: primary background color — the color [PROMPTSREFE] most commonly uses as the dominant background in campaign posters and editorial materials. Primary headline color — the color used for large display type. Secondary information color — the color used for small body text, labels, and informational copy. Apply these exactly. Do not substitute or approximate. Examples: Gucci uses cream/off-white background (#F5F0E8) with deep red (#8B0000 to #CC0000) for headlines. Nike uses white background with black headlines and red accents. Adidas uses black background with white headlines. Supreme uses white or red background with the opposing color for type. A brand designer must confirm these colors are correct for [PROMPTSREF].

TYPOGRAPHY CHARACTER — PRECISE VISUAL DESCRIPTION: identify whether [PROMPTSREF] uses serif or sans-serif type and describe its precise visual character — do not name a font, describe how it looks and feels. Gucci: classic high-contrast serif with strong thin-thick stroke variation, elegant and editorial, similar in character to Bodoni or Didot. Nike: geometric sans-serif, bold, uniform stroke weight, condensed, no contrast between strokes. Adidas: clean grotesque sans-serif, slightly condensed, utilitarian and athletic. Supreme: perfectly geometric sans-serif, circular O, uniform stroke weight, Futura-like. Balenciaga: ultra-extended grotesque, extremely wide letterforms, uniform stroke weight. Louis Vuitton: refined serif with moderate contrast, luxury editorial character. Apply this visual character description to generate type that feels authentically correct for [BRAND NAME]'s brand category — luxury serif for heritage fashion houses, athletic grotesque for sportswear brands, geometric for streetwear.

CAMPAIGN LANGUAGE — REAL SLOGANS ONLY: extract the single most famous, most documented real campaign slogan of [BRAND NAME]. Not an invented phrase. Not a generic motivational line. The actual trademarked or documented slogan used in real campaigns. Examples: Gucci — "We Will Always Be Yours". Nike — "Just Do It". Adidas — "Impossible Is Nothing". Puma — "Forever Faster". Use this real slogan as the headline text broken across 2 to 3 lines.

BRAND FACTS: extract real founding year, key event names, real campaign names, product line names, geographic origin city, and documented campaign dates. Use this real data as all informational micro-copy. No invented data.

---

PHASE 1: LAYOUT ARCHITECTURE

Single horizontal rectangle — aspect ratio 16:9. Two zones split at approximately 55 to 60% from the left edge.

Left zone: pure flat background in [PROMPTSREF]'s exact primary campaign background color from PHASE 0. NOT automatically white — the color is whatever [PROMPTSREF] actually uses in their campaign materials. No photography, no texture, pure graphic design.

Right zone: full-bleed editorial photograph bleeding to right, top, and bottom edges.

TYPOGRAPHIC BRIDGE — CRITICAL: the headline type starts in the left zone and physically crosses the split line continuing over the photograph. Type appears simultaneously on the brand background AND over the photo. The largest headline line crosses the split most dramatically — it spans the full width of the poster. This bridge unifies the two zones into one composition.

---

PHASE 2: HEADLINE TYPOGRAPHY

Real [PROMPTSREF] campaign slogan from PHASE 0 broken into 2 to 3 lines. Typography character matches the visual description from PHASE 0 — serif for luxury heritage brands, grotesque for sportswear, geometric for streetwear.

Line 1: medium-large, starts in left zone, crosses into right zone over the photo. Uppercase. Primary headline color.

Line 2: maximum size — 35 to 45% of total poster height. The single most dominant visual element of the entire poster. May bleed slightly off the left edge — leftmost letter partially cropped. Crosses the split line fully, spanning both zones. Primary headline color.

Line 3: large, ends with asterisk or registered trademark symbol as graphic accent. Primary headline color.

All lines left-aligned. Flat color, full opacity. No shadows, no outlines, no gradients, no effects. Type sits directly over the photograph at full opacity where it crosses into the right zone.

---

PHASE 3: INFORMATIONAL MICRO-TYPOGRAPHY

Small-scale type set in the same typographic character as the headline but regular weight. Small size, generous tracking. Secondary information color from PHASE 0.

Cluster 1 — brand event details: three label-value pairs stacked with real [BRAND NAME] data. Format: "EVENT" left-aligned, real event name right-aligned. "DATE" left-aligned, real campaign date right-aligned. "LOCATION" left-aligned, real city and country right-aligned.

Cluster 2 — CTA: a short directional phrase in small caps with tracking — "DISCOVER THE EXHIBITION →" or "SHOP THE COLLECTION →" or similar. Positioned below Cluster 1 with clear spacing.

Both clusters positioned in the breathing space between headline lines in the left zone — they occupy the open area between Line 1 and Line 3.

---

PHASE 4: CORNER ELEMENTS

Bottom left corner: three-line brand attribution block — founding year, brand name in the brand's logotype style, geographic origin city (e.g. "1921 / GUCCI / FIRENZE, ITALIA"). Small type, left-aligned. If [BRAND NAME] has a recognizable wordmark — render the wordmark in its correct typographic style at this position.

Top right corner over photo: small cluster of event name, date range, and location. Small type, right-aligned, secondary information color.

Bottom right corner over photo: same event/date/location information repeated. Right-aligned, slightly larger than top right cluster.

Large numeral accent: a typographically significant number positioned upper right in the photo zone — founding year last two digits, collection edition number, or campaign year. Size: 15 to 20% of poster height. Primary headline color at 85% opacity. Below the numeral: the word "SINCE" followed by the full founding year — small caps, tracked out, secondary information color.

---

PHASE 5: PHOTOGRAPHY

A realistic figure — not a named real person — whose appearance and context are entirely consistent with [BRAND NAME]'s visual world. The figure is wearing [BRAND NAME] products visibly and recognizably. The environment is authentic to the brand's cultural positioning: Gucci — Italian Renaissance architecture, Florence rooftops, luxury interiors. Nike — athletic venues, courts, tracks, urban environments. Adidas — urban streets, sports arenas, creative studios. Supreme — New York streets, skate spots, urban environments.

Photographic style: editorial, naturalistic. Slight warm or cool grade depending on brand aesthetic — Gucci uses warm film-like grades, Nike uses clean neutral grades, Adidas uses high contrast neutral grades. Not stock photography. The figure is positioned slightly left of center within the photo zone, facing slightly away from camera or in profile — creating the characteristic editorial non-confrontational pose. The headline type from PHASE 2 overlaps the figure's body where it crosses into the right zone.

---

PHASE 6: COMPOSITION PRINCIPLES

Hard vertical split line — precise, no feathering, no blend, no gradient transition. Left zone is pure graphic. Right zone is photography. They meet at an exact vertical cut.

Typography hierarchy: Line 2 maximum > Line 3 > Line 1 > Large numeral > Corner elements > Micro clusters.

Visual flow: large type enters from left → crosses into photo → numeral accent upper right → corner information → figure.

Left zone negative space: generous — micro-typography clusters are small relative to the zone. The white or colored space breathes around the type.

---

PHASE 7: TECH SPECS

Aspect ratio: 16:9, single flat image. Typography: crisp, anti-aliased, flat color — zero shadows, zero outlines, zero gradients on type. Typography character strictly matches the visual description from PHASE 0 — serif for luxury brands, grotesque for sport, geometric for street. Color palette: exactly the three colors identified in PHASE 0 — zero additions, zero gradients, zero textures. Photography: editorial quality, color grade consistent with [BRAND NAME]'s visual world. Output feel: this poster is published as a campaign hero visual on [BRAND NAME]'s official website, as an outdoor billboard, or as a full-page spread in Vogue, GQ, Hypebeast, or Highsnobiety.

title: 电影感女性
prompt:
Create a bold Y2K pop-street editorial collage featuring a young person as the central subject, combining playful graffiti typography, orange poster background, sticker-like graphic elements, and fashion magazine layout energy.

MAIN SUBJECT AND FRAMING:
Place the young person on the right side of the composition in a close-up to upper-body portrait. The face should be large and dominant, cropped from the chest upward, with the subject slightly leaning forward into the frame. The composition should feel asymmetrical, with graphic typography filling the left side and the subject anchoring the right side.

Do not control or describe the hairstyle.

OUTFIT DETAIL:
Style the subject in a minimal black streetwear outfit. They wear a black turtleneck or high-neck top with a soft fitted silhouette, creating a clean dark shape against the bright orange background. Add a black beret or rounded cap with a small embroidered logo detail on the front, giving the look a stylish retro street-fashion feeling.

Add a small colorful cheek sticker or decorative bandage on one cheek, with cute tiny graphic details, making the styling feel playful and idol-like. Keep the outfit mostly black so the blue graffiti typography and orange background stand out strongly.

BEHAVIOUR AND BODY LANGUAGE:
The subject’s body language should feel calm, closed-off, and slightly moody. The shoulders are relaxed but slightly rounded forward, creating a soft guarded posture. The head tilts subtly downward and to the side, giving the portrait a cool detached attitude.

The subject does not need a big hand gesture in the main portrait; instead, the behaviour comes from the face angle, lowered posture, and intense sideways eye movement. The pose should feel like someone caught in a quiet bratty moment, not fully engaging with the viewer.

FACIAL EXPRESSION:
The expression is pouty, serious, and mildly irritated in a fashionable way. The lips are softly pushed forward into a small pout, brows slightly tense, and the eyes look sideways with a suspicious or unimpressed gaze. The mood should feel bratty, stylish, aloof, and quietly rebellious.

GRAPHIC BACKGROUND:
Use a saturated orange background with a large white starburst shape behind the subject’s head and shoulders. The starburst should create strong comic-book energy and make the face pop.

Add hand-drawn black scribble text across the orange background, like messy diary writing or lyric notes. Include phrases such as:
“EENIE MEENY MINEY MO”
“4:03”
“LOVE DAY”
“HIDE YOUR LOVE”
“BOYZ”
The handwriting should look playful, imperfect, thin, and chaotic, but still visually controlled.

MAIN TYPOGRAPHY:
Place a large blue graffiti-style word “Your Name” across the left-center area. The letters should be chunky, rounded, irregular, and outlined in thick black, like a playful bubble graffiti tag. The typography should overlap slightly with the subject’s face area without blocking the eyes.

Add pink star sparkle stickers around the face and cap area, giving a cute pop-idol accent.

BOTTOM FILMSTRIP:
At the bottom of the composition, add a horizontal filmstrip with four rectangular photo panels. These panels show smaller full-body and close-up poses of the same young person wearing the same black outfit.

Panel pose ideas:
1. Side close-up portrait with head tilted back slightly, cheek sticker visible, eyes looking away.

2. Full-body stance with legs apart, hands near pockets or belt area, posture confident and relaxed.

3. Repeated close-up side portrait for rhythmic collage effect.

4. Repeated full-body stance, slightly different angle or crop.

The filmstrip should feel like a fashion contact sheet or idol editorial preview.

MOOD AND STYLE:
The overall mood should be playful, bratty, nostalgic, and street-fashion inspired. It should feel like a Y2K teen magazine layout mixed with graffiti poster design, idol concept styling, and scrapbook-like pop graphics.

背景保持干净克制，可使用暖白、奶油白、浅灰、浅米色、雾粉灰等高级底色，不要过度花哨。
整体设计感应偏向高端美甲品牌视觉、时尚杂志内页、设计提案板，而不是电商详情页或低质海报。

--------------------------------------------------
【各板块详细要求】

① 标题区 / Title Area
在画面上方清晰呈现：
- 主标题：AI美甲灵感方案
- 英文副标题：AI Nail Inspiration Board
- 主题名称：根据用户输入自动生成
- 一句简洁的风格描述，例如：
“从主题中提取色彩、符号与情绪，转译为一整套可上手的美甲方案。”

标题区要简洁有力，体现高级感和设计感。

--------------------------------------------------
② 灵感来源区 / Inspiration Source
如果用户上传了参考图，请在左上或上方区域展示参考图缩略图，并标注：
- 灵感来源 / Inspiration Source
- 主题名称
- 简短说明：这次设计从参考图中提取了哪些气质与方向

如果用户只输入文字主题，则在此区域以文字方式呈现：
- 主题名称
- 主题简介
- 核心氛围描述

此区不是大篇文字，而是简洁专业、像设计说明一样。

--------------------------------------------------
③ 视觉元素提取区 / Visual Extraction
请将灵感拆解成几个清晰的小模块，排版精致、信息明确：

A. 色彩系统 / Color Palette
请推荐：
- 主色 3 个
- 辅助色 2 个
- 点缀色 1 个

用小色卡形式展示，并标注色彩名称。
色彩命名可偏审美化，例如：
奶杏裸粉、冷调银灰、酒红莓果、墨绿、雾霾紫、香槟金、深海蓝、珍珠白等。

B. 关键词 / Style Keywords
提炼 4—6 个关键词，例如：
温柔、神秘、复古、冷艳、梦幻、浪漫、华丽、克制、轻甜、未来感、松弛、清冷、戏剧感等。

C. 图案与符号 / Motifs
提取 4—6 个可被转译进甲面的视觉元素，例如：
月亮、星轨、花瓣、水波、羽毛、火焰、丝带、蝴蝶、格纹、书页、音符、金线、藤蔓、金属边框、玻璃碎片感等。

D. 材质与工艺 / Texture & Finish
提炼适合本次主题的工艺方向，例如：
猫眼、珠光、金箔、渐变晕染、镜面、果冻透感、法式边、贝壳碎片、磨砂、立体水滴、微浮雕、细闪、丝绒感等。

这一整区要非常像“设计逻辑提取板”，清晰、专业、简洁。

--------------------------------------------------
④ 10指甲设计区 / 10-Nail Design Plan
这是整张图的绝对核心，请占据最大视觉权重。

请明确展示：
- 左手 5 枚
- 右手 5 枚

每一个指甲都要单独清晰呈现，并附简洁说明。
建议每枚指甲包含：
- 指位（Thumb / Index / Middle / Ring / Pinky）
- 设计名称
- 简短说明（1句话）
- 主要元素 / 工艺

整套 10 指甲必须形成统一风格，同时又有节奏变化，不可十个都一样，也不可毫无联系地乱做。
既要有完整系列感，又要有细节差异和层次感。

--------------------------------------------------
⑤ 风格总结区 / Concept Summary
请在右侧或中右区域做一个小型总结模块，包含：

- 风格主题 / Style Theme
例如：
暗夜玫瑰 / Midnight Rose
海风日落 / Sunset Coast
旧梦电影感 / Retro Cinema Mood
春日书页 / Spring Pages
深海星轨 / Ocean Starline

- 整体气质说明
用 1 段简洁说明总结整套方案的方向，例如：
“这套设计通过低饱和主色、细节金属线条与局部珠光工艺，将灵感中的浪漫与克制感转译为更适合日常佩戴的高级美甲方案。”

--------------------------------------------------
⑥ 甲型 / 工艺 / 适用场景区
请做成小而精致的模块，包含：

A. 推荐甲型 / Nail Shape
根据主题与风格自动推荐 1—2 种合适甲型，例如：
- 短圆甲
- 方圆甲
- 椭圆甲
- 杏仁甲
- 中长椭圆甲

并简短说明理由，如：
“更显精致”“更适合日常佩戴”“更能承载图案层次”“更显手部修长感”。

B. 推荐工艺 / Recommended Finishes
总结这套设计最重要的工艺重点，例如：
渐变晕染、微珠光、金线细节、猫眼流光、局部镜面等。

C. 场景建议 / Best For
说明适合的场景，例如：
通勤、约会、婚礼、度假、节日、演唱会、春夏、秋冬等。

这一块要像“实用落地建议”，增强方案可执行性。

--------------------------------------------------
⑦ 实际上手效果区 / On-Hand Preview
这一部分非常重要，必须精致、真实、有说服力。

请生成一组高完成度的双手上手效果图，展示这整套美甲真正做在手上的样子。
要求：
- 双手自然、真实、比例正常
- 手部姿态优雅，不夸张、不僵硬
- 指甲细节清晰可见
- 光线柔和高级，具有棚拍质感
- 可采用自然摆拍方式

如果用户提供了手部照片，请尽量匹配其手部肤色与基础手型特征；
如果没有手部照片，请生成一组大众审美友好、气质自然、适合展示美甲的女性双手效果。

重点：
这不是简单的小缩略图，而是整张图中非常关键的落地展示模块。
要让用户第一眼就觉得：“这套设计真的能做，而且做出来会很好看。”

--------------------------------------------------
⑧ 底部总结区 / Final Note
请在底部或右下角写一句清晰有力的总结语，例如：

“这套方案并非简单复制灵感来源，而是提取其色彩、情绪与符号语言，转译为更适合甲面表达、同时兼顾美感与佩戴性的完整美甲设计。”

这句总结要起到“收尾 + 提升专业感”的作用。

--------------------------------------------------

最终请输出一张横向 4:3 的高完成度「AI美甲灵感方案」专业提案图。
用户第一眼应被这套美甲方案吸引，第二眼能看懂整套设计逻辑，第三眼会觉得这套方案真实可做、而且做出来会很好看。

不可食用蜡质保护层 / защищает пока ты не созрел морально

Shape Style: Irregular, hand-painted aesthetic – think Photoshop brush strokes or torn paper texture (NOT perfect geometric shapes) - Color Selection (Autonomous): Choose 1 hero color from [BRAND NAME] palette: - Texture: Visible brush strokes, grain, or subtle noise (15-25% opacity) – avoid flat digital fills - Placement: Blob positioned to frame model without obscuring key product details PHASE 4: GRAPHIC ELEMENTS LAYER Add 3-5 abstract graphic elements scattered across composition: - Element Types: - Color Palette: Use 2-3 accent colors total (main blob color + 1-2 contrasting tones from brand palette) - Placement: Asymmetric scatter – top-left and bottom-right zones primarily (avoid center crowding) - Scale: Mix small (5% of canvas) and medium (15% of canvas) elements – nothing overpowering - Aesthetic: Analog/handmade feel – imperfect circles, rough edges, visible texture PHASE 5: TYPOGRAPHY INTEGRATION - Brand Logo: Clean [BRAND NAME] logo placed in upper-left or upper-right quadrant (10-15% of width) - Slogan/Tagline: If [BRAND NAME] has an iconic slogan, integrate it using: - Supporting Copy: Optional 1-line descriptor (e.g., "A MOMENT OF YOUR STYLE") in smaller uppercase sans-serif - Type Treatment: Mix of aligned and slightly rotated text (2-5° angles) for dynamic energy - Hierarchy: Logo largest → Slogan medium → Copy smallest PHASE 6: TEXTURE & BACKGROUND - Base Layer: Off-white or light gray textured background (NOT pure white) - Texture Options (Autonomous selection): - Color: RGB 245-250 (near-white with warmth) – maintains brightness while adding depth - Treatment: Texture should be felt, not seen – enhances tactility without competing with foreground PHASE 7: COMPOSITION RULES - Layout: Asymmetric balance – model off-center, graphic elements counter-balance - Breathing Room: 15-20% negative space (textured background visible) to prevent claustrophobia - Layering Order: Background texture → Color blob → Graphic elements → Model (cutout) → Typography top layer - Focal Point: Model + hero product = primary focus (60% visual weight), graphics support (40%) - Movement: Diagonal lines and angled elements create directional flow (top-left to bottom-right or vice versa) PHASE 8: BRAND INTELLIGENCE (AUTONOMOUS) Autonomously adapt composition based on [BRAND NAME] personality: - Bottom Strip: Clean white or light gray bar at bottom 8-10% of frame - Content: Social media handles (Instagram, Facebook, Twitter) in small sans-serif - Layout: Three-column grid with platform icons or text handles - Aesthetic: Minimal and professional – contrast with chaotic collage above TECHNICAL SPECS: - Aspect Ratio: 4:5 (Instagram feed) or 1:1 (square social post) - Resolution: 2400x3000px minimum (high-quality for zoom and detail) - This prompt combines all requirements from the two input images to guide the AI to generate a photo with stylized, handwritten annotations.

Observe the elements in the provided photograph and add meaningful, handwritten-style annotations and illustrations to enhance the composition.

Mom and baby (named "Ten-chan").

A baby standing up.

A Nemophila (Baby Blue Eyes) flower field.

A beautiful sky.

The general warm and cheerful atmosphere of spring.

3. Drawing & Aesthetic Rules (How it should look)
Medium: Use thin, messy, handwritten-style lines that resemble writing with a white gel pen.

Technique: The lines should be rough, appear to be drawn in a single stroke (one-line art style), and be intentionally uneven and natural (not machine-perfect).

Visual Guidance:

Add outlines that loosely trace the perimeter of key subjects.

Use handwritten arrows and dotted lines to create visual leading and guide the viewer's eye between elements.

Finish: The overall aesthetic must look like an Instagram Story (IG Story style) or a rough editorial memo in a casual fashion magazine. The vibe should be stylish yet effortlessly relaxed and casual ("nuke-kan" feeling).

Composition: Do not clutter the image. Add decorations discreetly and ensure enough "negative space" (margin) remains to keep the photo clear.

4. Annotation Content & Tone (What the text should say)
Format: The text must be Japanese handwritten script (use approximately 70% Hiragana and 30% simple Kanji for readability).

Content: Write very short, personal comments that sound like emotional monologues or casual diary entries (e.g., "So cute!", "Lovely day.").

Specific Context Rules (If applicable in the image):

If commenting on Drinks: Focus on taste, temperature, and mood (e.g., "Refreshing," "Gentle sweetness").

If commenting on Food: Focus on texture and deliciousness (e.g., "Moist," "The absolute best!").

If commenting on Space/Location: Focus on the vibe and atmosphere (e.g., "So relaxing," "A wonderful time").

If a general summary: Keep it very brief and emotional (e.g., "Too much happiness~").

5. Small Decorations

Hearts (♥)

title: 生成一张 9:16 竖版高级科幻机甲电影角色海报，真人电影质…
prompt:
生成一张 9:16 竖版高级科幻机甲电影角色海报，真人电影质感，院线 IMAX 主视觉风格。

角色是一位银白色凌乱短发的年轻男性机甲驾驶员，皮肤苍白细腻，五官清冷俊美，眼神孤独、温柔、坚定，微微仰头望向远方。右上方占据画面大面积的是他的巨大侧脸特写，皮肤有真实湿润高光和轻微战斗痕迹，发丝被冷色侧逆光勾亮。

画面中下部是同一角色的全身主视觉，他穿着黑白银色高光反射的未来感驾驶服，白色陶瓷装甲、黑色橡胶连接结构、暗银金属机械细节、红色胸口发光核心，胸前有细小编号“06”。他站在废墟中，手持未来感头盔，姿态冷静、英雄式、孤独而神圣。

背景是末世机甲战场：破碎城市、倾倒钢铁结构、残破塔楼、湿润反光地面、风暴云和大片连续体积雾。左后方有一台巨大的黑色生物机械人形机甲半隐藏在烟雾中，只露出红色发光眼睛和锋利轮廓。远处地平线上有一道克制的红色十字形光柱，带有宗教感与灾难感。底部有一个很小的人类剪影站在废墟中仰望远方，形成巨大尺度对比。

整体色调为冷银、深蓝灰、黑色、少量深红点缀；色彩比普通末世海报更鲜明、更高级，但保持低饱和电影感。高对比，强边缘光，湿润皮肤高光，装甲反射，大片柔和体积雾，复杂但干净的层次。

加入高级电影海报排版：大标题“KAWORU NAGISA”，日文副标题“渚カヲル”，左侧英文短句，底部上映日期和电影海报式小字。文字作为精致视觉排版元素，复古衬线体，白银色与红色搭配，克制高级。

不要卡通感，不要低幼，不要普通动漫立绘，不要干净棚拍背景，不要社交媒体水印，不要二维码。不要粒子特效，不要火星，不要飞散灰尘，不要红色小光点，不要白色芝麻点，不要漂浮碎屑，不要重胶片颗粒。空气保持干净，只使用大片连续烟雾和柔和体积雾。

a defeated kneeling figure in the lower-left foreground

Main standing figure

The figure wears a long black trench coat with elegant flowing tails, subtle leather-like sheen, and dark fitted clothing underneath.

Lighting

strong top/back lighting
a bright white glow behind the standing figure
subtle rim lighting around the coat
soft reflections in the floor
overall high contrast, but keep the background bright and clean

large headline in two contrasting type styles:

“SAME RESULT.”

include a large small numeral “6”
include several tiny stacked microtext lines underneath for editorial texture
Graphic details

tiny crosses
thin divider lines
small interface-like glyphs
small registration or alignment marks
tiny side labels
a few minimalist symbols around the margins
Style and mood

The final image should feel like:

luxury editorial poster
fashion campaign meets sci-fi
cold, dominant, elite
minimal yet dramatic
clean, bright, premium, intimidating
Color palette

white
pale grey
black
charcoal
subtle silver highlights

No bright colors.

Keep it refined and mostly black-on-white.

Authentic 2000s–early 2010s Japanese sports-entertainment obstacle-course live TV broadcast. Contestant: Young adult woman (Image1), clearly mid-to-late 20s, curly hair, medium build, average height, purple-and-grey athletic outfit (consistent throughout). Mature adult proportions, confident competitor. Hair/clothes become wet only after falling.

Continuity: Entire course moves screen left→right. Never mirror/reverse/reset. Maintain obstacle layout, lighting, water pool, stands, and continuous motion across cuts.

Course: Starting platform → narrow elevated alternating angled stepping platforms above open water → large free-moving rolling cylinder → fixed landing platform on screen right, slightly higher than cylinder. All obstacles elevated with visible gaps and drop.

Rolling cylinder: Large free-moving log, not axle-mounted. It rotates and translates left→right above open water. Contestant stays near top center, running against its rotating surface to drive it forward. Never show a stationary/fixed roller, runway, bridge, or floor beneath. If balance is lost, she falls directly into water.

0–2s

ENG knee-up shot on starting platform. She smiles, waves, receives applause. Course visible behind. Subtle push-in. Before buzzer she lowers hand and becomes focused.

2–5s

Buzzer. High crane reveals full course, then low tracking shot follows her crossing narrow angled stepping platforms with fast, precise rhythmic footwork. Audience cheers.

5–8s

Long-lens side angle. She jumps onto rolling cylinder. Cylinder immediately rotates and travels forward. Show full body, full cylinder, open water, landing platform. Arms extended for balance. Brief foot slip causes wobble; audience gasps.

8–11s

Side tracking follows contestant and moving cylinder. She runs in place to keep it rolling; cylinder accelerates slightly. Right foot slips backward, body sways, arms recover. Show face, full body, both feet, cylinder, water, landing platform.

11–13s

Low front 3/4 angle. Cylinder nears higher landing platform. She attempts upward jump, supporting foot slips backward, loses momentum, reaches toward platform but misses and falls from moving cylinder into open water. Cylinder never becomes stationary.

13–15s

Wide shot captures full elevated fall and one large splash. Then water-level medium shot: she resurfaces smiling with mild frustration, soaked but recognizable. Audience applauds as commentator concludes.

Style: Authentic live Japanese obstacle-show broadcast, realistic physics, anatomy, balance, friction, gravity, rolling-cylinder motion, water impact, continuous action.

title: お風呂上がり、鏡の前で少しだけ寄り道
prompt:
人物・表情：
自然で現実感のある女性。明るくなめらかな肌に、入浴後の細かな水滴と自然な血色を残す。ダークブラウンの髪を無造作な高めのお団子にまとめ、薄いシースルーバングと頬に沿う濡れた後れ毛を数本垂らす。淡いピンクベージュのアイメイク、細いまつ毛、柔らかな眉、透明感のあるローズリップ。頭をわずかに傾け、スマートフォンの画面へ静かに視線を向け、唇を軽くすぼめた落ち着いた表情。

服装・ポーズ：
白い厚手のパイル地のバスタオルを胸元から身体へしっかり巻きつけたデザイン。胸元と前合わせ、短い裾に淡いピンクの細かなフリルを付け、小さな花刺繍とリボンを控えめに配置する。丈は太ももの上部までで、前身頃が斜めに重なる自然な巻き方。画面左側に上げた手で濃紺のスマートフォンを縦に持ち、指を端末の側面へ自然に沿わせる。反対側の腕は胸下を横切り、上げた腕の肘を下から支える。腰をわずかに片側へ寄せ、両脚を近づけた自然な立ち姿。タオルの重なり、受力、折れ目が身体の動きに沿う。

背景・光：
上質なホテルを思わせるモダンなバスルーム。背面に金色の細いフレームを持つ大きな鏡、ダークブラウンの大理石壁、白い洗面台、折り畳まれたタオル、画面左に透明なガラスシャワーブースと丸い拡大鏡。天井前方から暖色の柔らかな照明が入り、額、頬、肩、鎖骨、腕へ滑らかなハイライトを作る。画面左から弱い寒色の反射光を加え、人物の輪郭を背景から自然に分離する。影は下方と画面右へ淡く落とし、大理石と鏡に控えめな反射を残す。

構図・カメラ：
縦位置3:4、目線よりわずかに低い高さからの鏡越し撮影。人物の顔は画面上部中央、スマートフォンは画面左上寄り。頭上には狭い余白、左右はバスルーム設備が見える程度、下端は太もも途中で自然に裁切する。標準レンズに近い自然な遠近感。顔と上半身に正確にピントを合わせ、背景は輪郭が分かる程度に穏やかにぼかす。

質感・スタイル：
リアルな写真表現。湿った髪の束感、肌に残る細かな水滴、パイル地の柔らかな毛足、フリルの薄さ、刺繍糸の立体感を精密に描写する。過度な美肌補正を避け、自然な肌理と控えめな光沢を残す。暖色を基調に、ダークブラウン、白、淡いピンク、金色を調和させた上品なホテル写真の仕上がり。

ネガティブ：
未成年に見える人物、不自然な顔、不自然な視線、余分な指、欠けた指、指の融合、関節の破綻、スマートフォンの変形、鏡像の矛盾、タオルの浮遊、不自然な重力、誤った遠近法、光源と矛盾する影、過度な美肌補正、プラスチックのような肌、文字化け、ロゴ、透かし。

title: AI 生成图片
prompt:
① 소스 바인딩
- <image1> : 여자 주인공. 모든 구간에서 얼굴 특징(눈매·코·입매·윤곽)과 헤어 컬러를 완전히 일치시킬 것. 컷마다 각도가 바뀌어도 동일 인물로 인식되게. 의상은 <image1>에 고정하지 않는다 — 착장은 각 구간의 텍스트 지시를 따른다. <image1>의 배경·포즈·하단 텍스트는 무시한다.

② 피사체 + 공간
한여름 리조트 여름 휴가 솔로 브이로그. 리조트 객실 → 발코니 → 풀사이드 → 수영장 순으로 이동. 전부 같은 리조트 안이며, 발코니에서 아래층 야외 수영장이 내려다보인다.

계절은 여름. 착장은 두 단계 — 전반(0–4초)은 가벼운 여름 캐주얼, 후반(4–15초)은 심플한 검은색 비키니. 각 구간 지시에 적힌 착장만 입고, 같은 구간 안에서 착장이 변하지 않는다.

③ 타임라인 (0–15초, 7구간, 각 구간 핵심 동작 1개, 임의로 컷 통합·생략 금지)
0–2초 【도착 / 객실】
화이트 리넨 톤의 밝은 리조트 객실, 오후 햇살. 가벼운 린넨 셔츠와 쇼츠 차림으로 캐리어를 끌고 들어온다. POV 셀카 풀샷에서 카메라로 빠르게 줌인, 환하게 말한다: "드디어 여름 휴가~"
2–4초 【뷰 공개 / 발코니】
같은 여름 캐주얼 차림. 커튼을 걷는 손 특写 → 발코니 통유리 너머 아래층 수영장으로 초점이 넘어가고 → 뒤돌아보며 입이 살짝 벌어지는 얼굴 리액션 컷으로 빠르게 전환.
4–6초 【풀 입장 / 풀사이드】
심플한 검은색 비키니 + 머리에 올린 선글라스. 청록빛 수영장 옆을 걷는 핸드헬드 팔로우 — 걸음마다 화면이 자연스럽게 출렁이고, 뒤로 파라솔과 반짝이는 수면이 흐른다.
6–8초 【여유 컷 / 선베드】
검은색 비키니 유지. 결로 맺힌 얼음 음료 특写 → 잔을 든 얼굴로 틸트업, 선베드에 비스듬히 기대 한 모금 마시고 작게 숨을 내쉰다. 숏폼의 '예쁜 한 컷'처럼 릴랙스.
8–10초 【발 담그기 / 풀 가장자리】
검은색 비키니 유지, 머리는 아직 마른 상태. 풀 가장자리에 앉아 발을 담그고 천천히 발장구 — 물방울이 햇빛에 반짝이는 발 특写 → 웃는 얼굴 리액션으로 틸트업.
10–13초 【캐논볼 / 풀 가장자리】
검은색 비키니, 맨발. 풀 가장자리에 선 정면 풀샷 — 카메라를 보고 또렷하게 말한다: "저는, 들어갈게요!" 말이 끝나자마자 두세 걸음 달려가 무릎을 감싸 안은 캐논볼 자세로 풍덩 — 물보라가 크게 솟아 물방울 몇 개가 렌즈에 맺힌다.
13–15초 【마무리 / 수영장 안】
물속에서 나와 젖은 머리를 두 손으로 쓸어 올린다. 정면·측면 2컷 빠르게 전환, 물방울이 얼굴을 타고 흘러내리고, 카메라를 향해 웃는 순간 마지막 프레임 정지. 렌즈에 맺힌 물방울은 그대로 남는다.

④ 카메라 + 오디오
카메라: 0.5~1초 빠른 컷 리듬, 핸드헬드 아이폰 질감, 16:9 가로. 줌인·줌아웃·틸트업 혼용, 자연스러운 흔들림, 자동 초점 헌팅, 야외 직사광 노출 출렁임.
오디오: BGM 없음. 주변 환경음(캐리어 바퀴 소리·풀장 물소리·매미 소리·얼음이 잔에 부딪히는 소리·발장구 물소리·캐논볼 풍덩·물 밖으로 터지는 웃음)을 레이어로. 대사는 한국어 원문 그대로.

⑤ 스타일 + 제약
한여름의 밝고 생기있는 자연광 톤, 필름 룩 약하게, 인스타그램 브이로그 감성. 실제 피부 질감(모공·잔머리·자연스러운 유분광) 유지, 뷰티 필터·CG 질감 금지.
임의로 컷을 통합하거나 장면을 생략하지 않는다. 갈아입는 장면은 없다. 텍스트 삽입 없음(Text no).

title: 障子の向こうに夜の青、部屋の奥にはやわらかな灯り
prompt:

縦長4:5のリアル写真風ポートレート。夜の和モダンな寝室で、窓辺に立つ自然で現実感のある成人女性を背中側から大きく捉える。人物は画面中央に配置し、頭から太もも上までが収まる近距離構図。左側に夜景の見える開いた窓、右側に日本家屋らしい室内の灯りと寝具を入れ、人物が画面の主役として大きく存在する構成。

人物・表情：
柔らかな顔立ちの女性。ダークブラウンのロングヘアは軽いシースルーバングを残し、後ろでゆるく低めにまとめる。毛先には少しだけ動きがあり、室内灯と月明かりを受けて繊細なハイライトが入る。顔は肩越しに振り返り、視線はカメラへまっすぐ近い角度で向ける。表情は静かで穏やか、少しだけ余韻を残すような落ち着いたまなざし。頬と唇には自然な血色感を入れ、肌はなめらかだが質感を残す。

服装・ポーズ：
上半身はアイボリーの薄手ロングスリーブのルームウェア。やわらかな生地感で、背中側の裾が少し上がり、腰のラインが自然に見える。ボトムは淡いピンクのサテン調ショーツで、縁に細いレース、小さなリボンをひとつだけ添える。身体は窓の方へ向け、腰をわずかにひねりながら上半身だけ振り返る。片手は身体の横に自然に下ろし、もう片腕は前側に沿わせる。背中、腰、脚の重心が片側に寄り、立ち姿にしなやかな曲線が出るようにする。

背景・光：
場面は夜の寝室。障子、木枠、和の意匠を感じる壁面、低めのベッドまたは敷き寝具、整えられた白い布団、木の棚、小さなテーブルランプ、花を挿した一輪のグリーンを配置する。左の窓の外には青い夜空、月、遠くの街明かりのぼけた光。主光源は室内右側の暖かなランプ光で、人物の背中、腰、髪の輪郭、頬にやさしい橙色の光を落とす。窓からは冷たい青い月明かりが入り、暖色の室内光と寒色の夜光が共存する。影は柔らかく、部屋の奥に静かな深さを作る。

構図・カメラ：
縦構図、85mm相当の中望遠、浅い被写界深度。カメラ位置は腰よりやや高めで、背中から振り返る瞬間をなめらかに捉える。人物の顔は画面上部中央寄り、腰のラインは中〜下部に置き、窓の縦線と障子の枠で和の空間を整える。左奥の夜景は大きくぼかし、右側のランプと室内の木部で温度感を作る。頭上の余白は少なめ、左右の空間は狭すぎず、人物の存在感と部屋の雰囲気が両立する画面。

質感・スタイル：
高品質なリアル写真調。日系ポートレートらしい繊細な肌、軽いフィルム感、柔らかな階調、自然な陰影。髪の細い束感、コットン生地のやわらかさ、サテン生地のほのかな光沢、白い寝具のふくらみ、木枠と障子の静かな質感を丁寧に描写する。全体の色調は、夜の深いネイビーブルーと室内灯のアンバー、アイボリー、淡いピンクを中心に、落ち着いた和モダンの空気感にまとめる。

ネガティブ：
不自然な顔、不自然な視線、余分な指、欠けた指、手足の融合、関節の破綻、不自然な腰や脚のねじれ、衣服の破綻、布のめり込み、誤った遠近法、光源と矛盾する影、文字化け、ロゴ、透かし、過度な美肌補正、プラスチックのような肌。

title: 周黑鸭品牌概念视觉海报生成提示词
prompt: 你是一个品牌视觉识别系统、商业广告创意总监、KV海报设计师和高传播品牌视觉生成系统。 请根据用户输入的【现有品牌名称】，自动识别该品牌最具代表性的品牌Logo形象、品牌名称文字识别特征、主推产品、产品包装、品牌色彩、视觉调性、目标人群和广告传播风格，并生成一张符合该品牌气质的概念 KV 海报。 这不是虚拟品牌设计， 不是普通产品图， 不是廉价宣传单， 也不是山寨海报， 而是一张： 基于真实品牌认知进行二次创作的品牌概念 KV 海报 Brand-inspired Concept Key Visual 本次创作主要用于个人学习、视觉练习与社交平台展示， 因此不需要绝对严苛的一比一官方复刻， 但必须做到： 品牌识别度高； 品牌Logo风格明显； 品牌代表产品明显； 品牌调性准确； 整体像该品牌会出现的视觉广告。 ──────────────── 一、用户输入 ──────────────── 品牌名称：{品牌名称} 主推产品：{可选，不填则自动识别该品牌最具代表性的产品} 广告语：{可选，不填则根据品牌调性自动生成原创广告语} 目标人群：{可选，不填则自动判断} 画幅比例：{9:16 / 16:9 / 4:5 / 1:1 / 2.35:1} KV类型：{产品英雄KV / 品牌情绪KV / 强口号传播KV / 人物场景KV / 超现实概念KV / 自动选择} 平台用途：{小红书 / X / 公众号封面 / 视觉练习 / 概念提案} ──────────────── 二、自动识别逻辑 ──────────────── 请根据品牌名称自动完成以下识别，不需要在画面中展示分析过程： 1. 自动识别该品牌所属行业 例如： 科技、运动、美妆、奢侈品、汽车、饮品、咖啡、服饰、潮流、护肤、珠宝、生活方式、数码、家居等。 2. 自动识别该品牌最具代表性的视觉资产 包括： 品牌Logo形象 品牌名称文字风格 主色调与辅助色 最具代表性的产品 包装外观特征 品牌常见广告风格 品牌场景气质 品牌材质感与光影方式 3. 自动识别该品牌的目标人群 例如： 年轻潮流人群、都市白领、精致女性、运动人群、科技用户、高端消费人群、Z世代、商务人群等。 4. 自动识别该品牌的广告语气质 例如： 极简高级、年轻活力、热血冲击、奢华克制、温柔浪漫、科技理性、时尚先锋、生活方式化等。 ──────────────── 三、Logo与产品识别规则 ──────────────── 本次任务允许 AI 根据品牌名称自动识别品牌视觉资产， 不需要用户必须上传 Logo 或产品图。 请遵守以下原则： 1. 品牌Logo - 画面中需要有明显的品牌标识 - Logo 或品牌名称文字要具有较高识别度 - 不必追求百分之百精确复刻，但必须让人一眼联想到该品牌 - 不要生成完全陌生、无关、错误感很强的标识 - 不要让品牌名称出现明显错字、乱码或胡乱变形 2. 品牌产品 - 自动选择该品牌最具代表性的主推产品或经典产品作为主视觉 - 产品外观、包装、色彩和气质应接近大众对该品牌的常见认知 - 不需要绝对严格到工业级复刻 - 但要保证“像这个品牌的真实代表产品”，而不是完全陌生的产品 3. 品牌包装与材质 - 广告语不能太长 - 要有品牌感和传播感 - 不使用官方原广告语 - 不需要像正式企业公告 - 更像概念广告的主标语 中文广告语建议： 4到12个字 英文广告语建议： 2到6个单词 广告语风格要与品牌匹配，例如： 科技品牌： 更少干扰，更近未来 运动品牌： 把极限踩在脚下 美妆品牌： 光泽，自成主张 奢侈品牌： 优雅，从不喧哗 饮品品牌： 这一口，刚好上头 咖啡品牌： 唤醒城市的温度 汽车品牌： 驶向更远的秩序 ──────────────── 六、人物出镜逻辑 ──────────────── 品牌KV中的“目标人群”不一定必须通过真人直接出现来表达， 也可以通过场景、色彩、气质、构图、道具和生活方式氛围进行隐性表达。 但如果某类品牌更依赖人物来建立代入感、身份感、使用场景和情绪传播力， 则应自动加入符合品牌调性的出镜人物。 请根据品牌类型、KV类型和目标人群，自动判断人物是否需要出现，以及以何种方式出现。 1、适合加入人物的品牌类型 - 设计方向：
不要创建标准的角色参考图。
创建一个电影级的身份项目，使其看起来像是高端动画工作室的角色研究与艺术画册排版的结合体。

排版应是不对称的、优雅且令人印象深刻的。
利用大面积留白、多变的图像比例和刻意的不平衡感。
避免使用网格、蓝图设计、目录式排版以及重复的转向展示。

重要排版规则：
不要让任何角色图像重叠。
每个视图都必须有清晰的间距和呼吸感。
保持所有全身像、肖像、剪影和细节研究在视觉上相互独立。
禁止面部裁剪、肢体遮挡、堆叠人物或姿势重叠。

主要构图：
放置一个略微偏离中心的大型全身英雄视图作为视觉锚点。

在其周围，以整洁的间距排列较小的辅助研究图：
中性全身视图、背面视图、侧面视图、坐姿、倚靠姿势、蹲姿、俯视角度、仰视角度以及表情研究。

每个视图都应感觉像是独立的、清晰的角色研究，而不是同一场景中的帧。

在所有视图中保持严格的身份一致性：

[差异化说明]
在此输入

[绘画基调]
流畅的线条、平涂动漫风格、极简赛璐珞阴影、单层阴影、无渐变、无厚涂、无写实纹理表现、无强烈的明暗对比，采用适合动画制作的扁平化视觉效果。

[动漫化转换说明]
在保持原始设计的结构、主题、配色、角色和文化含义的同时，简化绘画以适应动画制作。使用平涂动漫风格，并将阴影保持在单层。将半透明材料或薄织物处理为赛璐珞风格的简化平面，而非写实纹理。

基于上述输入，为原创动漫创作一张“世界观设定资料 + 角色设定资料”风格的图像。

目的：
不仅是展示角色，还要直观地传达角色所处的世界本身。创建一套设定资料，使世界的环境、文化、生活工具、建筑、交通和服装起源呈现为一个统一的整体。

最重要的一点：
首先，从输入内容中提取该世界独有的“视觉规则”。将该视觉规则反映在所有元素中：背景、建筑、工具、服装、配色方案、材料、纹章以及整体页面布局。

期望效果：
- 服装、工具和居住环境应看起来像是生活在这个世界的人们实际使用的物品。
- 角色、背景、工具、文字和材料样本应看起来属于同一个文化圈。
- 传达由世界观种子衍生出的独特环境、资源和生活习惯。
- 形状应源于日常生活中的必要性，而非现有的类型化套路。
- 具备一眼即可识别的独特形状语言、调色板和材质感。

思考过程：
1. 根据输入确定世界的“环境”（气候、地形、光照、季节、危险、资源分布）。
2. 根据环境确定“生活方式”（居住、饮食、工作、交通、存储、交换、记录、庆典）。
3. 根据生活方式确定“服装和工具”（固定方式、层叠、携带、防护、展示身份/角色）。
4. 根据服装/工具确定“角色外观”（重点在于服装、装备、材料、颜色和轮廓，而非仅仅是面部/发型）。
5. 根据视觉规则确定“页面设计”（反映该世界的记录媒介、图案、留白和图表风格）。

多样性增强：
为每个输入发明一个新的文化圈。如果要求多个方案，确保每个方案都有独特的生活原则、材料逻辑和审美。

针对每个方案，显著改变：
- 地形和气候外观
- 建筑和城市景观形状
- 主要材料
- 颜色的含义
- 服装轮廓
- 工具的握持、存储和携带方式
- 符号、文字、图案和纹章的创作
- 页面布局格式

构思候选（非固定主题，仅供灵感参考）：
环境：干旱地带、寒冷地区、高地、湿地、火山灰区、镜面湖、雾谷、强风区、极夜、低重力、浮动地层、发光矿洞等。
材料：纸、骨、陶瓷、皮革、树脂、玻璃、贝壳、竹子、稻草、晶体、再生织物、漆、灰、羽毛、琥珀等。
文化：口头传统、面具文化、气味识别、结绳记事、皮影记录、季节性迁徙、静默仪式、舞蹈契约等。
结构：折叠、包裹、编织、悬挂、插入、捆绑、层叠、密封、雕刻、成捆、充气等。

强制要素：
1. 世界观项目（象征性景观、城市景观、生活工具、纹章、颜色规则、形状语言）。
2. 角色设定资料（全身站姿、传达角色的服装、装备/背面/随身物品的细节图）。
3. 世界-角色连接（确保服装/装备的逻辑源于该世界的科技/信仰/环境）。
4. 页面设计（布局随世界观而变，使用适当的图表方法和极简的标签/符号）。

质量标准：
- 非通用的奇幻风格；必须能看出世界的起源。
- 角色与背景之间具有统一的文化感。
- 装饰必须具有生活、信仰或功能意义。
- 多个世界方案之间应有明显的视觉差异。

视觉呈现：
- 高分辨率、动漫风格、精致的线条、干净的赛璐珞上色。
- 世界项目 + 全身角色 + 工具细节的混合布局。
- 文字极简，优先展示视觉概念设计图。

最终目标：
确保设计能让人直观感受到世界的建立、居民的生活、材料的限制、文化含义和社区规则。创造一种统一感，使背景和角色能被一眼识别为属于同一个独特的世界。

主视觉卡片：左上角放置一个带有叶子图标的小胶囊标签，文字为“中国十大名茶之一”。添加一个非常大的深绿色中文标题“{argument name="tea name" default="龙井茶"}”和一个较小的英文副标题“{argument name="English tea name" default="Longjing Tea"}”。下方添加简短描述“中国十大名茶之一，以扁平挺秀、清香鲜爽著称。” 在该卡片右侧添加逼真的产品静物：一杯淡绿色的玻璃茶杯，杯中漂浮着茶叶，后方是一个浅色白碟，堆放着扁平的龙井茶叶。背景应包含模糊的绿色植物阴影和柔和的日光。在主视觉卡片底部，展示 3 个由细垂直线分隔的图标功能块：叶子图标标注“历史悠久 / 千年传承”，山峰图标标注“匠心工艺 / 传统炒制”，冒热气的茶杯图标标注“清雅之味 / 自然本真”。在该卡片右下角，添加一个带有地图定位图标的地点胶囊，文字为“浙江·杭州·西湖”。

最右上方卡片：创建一个标题为“特点”的功能列表卡片，带有深绿色圆形叶子图标。包含 4 行由虚线分隔的水平列表行，每行配有一个小图标和中文文字：1) 叶子图标“外形扁平挺直”，2) 水滴图标“色泽嫩绿光润”，3) 香气/蒸汽图标“香气清高鲜爽”，4) 茶碗图标“滋味鲜醇甘润”。右上角添加两个淡淡的装饰性叶子轮廓。

左下角采摘卡片：创建一个标题为“等级与采摘”的卡片，带有小叶子图标。添加正文“以春茶为佳，芽叶细嫩，明前茶尤受欢迎。” 在该卡片右侧，放置一张带有浅景深效果的、田间新鲜嫩绿茶芽的小型圆角照片。

title: 可爱的美人鱼小狗水下游戏画面
prompt:
创建一个 16:9 的艺术化角色身份项目（CHARACTER IDENTITY BOARD）。

以图像 A 作为主体和视觉媒介。名称：{argument name="name" default="Clara"}。{argument name="correction" default="Fix headphones"}。（根据你的需求修改此行。）

柔和的米白色背景。无环境背景，无 Logo，无水印。

设计方向：
不要创建标准的角色参考图。
创建一个电影级的身份项目，使其看起来像是高端动画工作室的角色研究与艺术画册排版的结合体。

排版应是不对称的、优雅且令人印象深刻的。
利用大面积留白、多变的图像比例和刻意的不平衡感。
避免使用网格、蓝图设计、目录式排版以及重复的转向展示。

重要排版规则：
不要让任何角色图像重叠。
每个视图都必须有清晰的间距和呼吸感。
保持所有全身像、肖像、剪影和细节研究在视觉上相互独立。
禁止面部裁剪、肢体遮挡、堆叠人物或姿势重叠。

主要构图：
放置一个略微偏离中心的大型全身英雄视图作为视觉锚点。

在其周围，以整洁的间距排列较小的辅助研究图：
中性全身视图、背面视图、侧面视图、坐姿、倚靠姿势、蹲姿、俯视角度、仰视角度以及表情研究。

每个视图都应感觉像是独立的、清晰的角色研究，而不是同一场景中的帧。

身份锁定：
在所有视图中保持严格的身份一致性：
相同的面部、相同的面部比例、相同的发型、相同的服装、相同的身体比例、相同的姿态语言、相同的视觉个性。

实用的参考细节：
使角色易于识别，以便进行后续的图像和视频生成：
清晰的脸型、清晰的发型轮廓、清晰的服装轮廓、清晰的体型、清晰的手部、清晰的姿态、清晰的表情范围。

艺术板块：
包含一个小型剪影研究区，展示 2-3 个简化的黑色角色剪影。
包含一个小型表情研究区，展示细微的情绪变化。
包含一个小型细节研究区，展示面部、头发和服装的关键视觉特征。

文字设计：
添加一个时尚的角色 ID 模块。
保持极简、醒目且具有艺术指导感。
仅使用：
姓名 (NAME)
角色 (ROLE)
核心情绪 (CORE MOOD)
视觉特征 (VISUAL SIGNATURE)

仅在必要时使用小型的书写体标签。
允许使用细微的编辑箭头和注释标记，但要保持极简和优雅。

风格：
极简、电影感、高级、画册感、整洁、表现力强、适用于生产流程。

最终图像应呈现出一种艺术化的角色身份项目设计感。

prompt:
创建一个 16:9 的艺术化角色身份项目（CHARACTER IDENTITY BOARD）。

以图像 A 作为主体和视觉媒介。名称：{argument name="name" default="Clara"}。{argument name="correction" default="Fix headphones"}。（根据你的需求修改此行。）

柔和的米白色背景。无环境背景，无 Logo，无水印。

设计方向：
不要创建标准的角色参考图。
创建一个电影级的身份项目，使其看起来像是高端动画工作室的角色研究与艺术画册排版的结合体。

排版应是不对称的、优雅且令人印象深刻的。
利用大面积留白、多变的图像比例和刻意的不平衡感。
避免使用网格、蓝图设计、目录式排版以及重复的转向展示。

重要排版规则：
不要让任何角色图像重叠。
每个视图都必须有清晰的间距和呼吸感。
保持所有全身像、肖像、剪影和细节研究在视觉上相互独立。
禁止面部裁剪、肢体遮挡、堆叠人物或姿势重叠。

主要构图：
放置一个略微偏离中心的大型全身英雄视图作为视觉锚点。

在其周围，以整洁的间距排列较小的辅助研究图：
中性全身视图、背面视图、侧面视图、坐姿、倚靠姿势、蹲姿、俯视角度、仰视角度以及表情研究。

每个视图都应感觉像是独立的、清晰的角色研究，而不是同一场景中的帧。

身份锁定：
在所有视图中保持严格的身份一致性：
相同的面部、相同的面部比例、相同的发型、相同的服装、相同的身体比例、相同的姿态语言、相同的视觉个性。

实用的参考细节：
使角色易于识别，以便进行后续的图像和视频生成：
清晰的脸型、清晰的发型轮廓、清晰的服装轮廓、清晰的体型、清晰的手部、清晰的姿态、清晰的表情范围。

艺术板块：
包含一个小型剪影研究区，展示 2-3 个简化的黑色角色剪影。
包含一个小型表情研究区，展示细微的情绪变化。
包含一个小型细节研究区，展示面部、头发和服装的关键视觉特征。

文字设计：
添加一个时尚的角色 ID 模块。
保持极简、醒目且具有艺术指导感。
仅使用：
姓名 (NAME)
角色 (ROLE)
核心情绪 (CORE MOOD)
视觉特征 (VISUAL SIGNATURE)

仅在必要时使用小型的书写体标签。
允许使用细微的编辑箭头和注释标记，但要保持极简和优雅。

风格：
极简、电影感、高级、画册感、整洁、表现力强、适用于生产流程。

最终图像应呈现出一种艺术化的角色身份项目设计感。

title: 第一人称热带岛屿战区
prompt:
创建一个 16:9 的艺术化角色身份项目（CHARACTER IDENTITY BOARD）。

以图像 A 作为主体和视觉媒介。名称：{argument name="name" default="Clara"}。{argument name="correction" default="Fix headphones"}。（根据你的需求修改此行。）

柔和的米白色背景。无环境背景，无 Logo，无水印。

设计方向：
不要创建标准的角色参考图。
创建一个电影级的身份项目，使其看起来像是高端动画工作室的角色研究与艺术画册排版的结合体。

排版应是不对称的、优雅且令人印象深刻的。
利用大面积留白、多变的图像比例和刻意的不平衡感。
避免使用网格、蓝图设计、目录式排版以及重复的转向展示。

重要排版规则：
不要让任何角色图像重叠。
每个视图都必须有清晰的间距和呼吸感。
保持所有全身像、肖像、剪影和细节研究在视觉上相互独立。
禁止面部裁剪、肢体遮挡、堆叠人物或姿势重叠。

主要构图：
放置一个略微偏离中心的大型全身英雄视图作为视觉锚点。

在其周围，以整洁的间距排列较小的辅助研究图：
中性全身视图、背面视图、侧面视图、坐姿、倚靠姿势、蹲姿、俯视角度、仰视角度以及表情研究。

每个视图都应感觉像是独立的、清晰的角色研究，而不是同一场景中的帧。

身份锁定：
在所有视图中保持严格的身份一致性：
相同的面部、相同的面部比例、相同的发型、相同的服装、相同的身体比例、相同的姿态语言、相同的视觉个性。

实用的参考细节：
使角色易于识别，以便进行后续的图像和视频生成：
清晰的脸型、清晰的发型轮廓、清晰的服装轮廓、清晰的体型、清晰的手部、清晰的姿态、清晰的表情范围。

艺术板块：
包含一个小型剪影研究区，展示 2-3 个简化的黑色角色剪影。
包含一个小型表情研究区，展示细微的情绪变化。
包含一个小型细节研究区，展示面部、头发和服装的关键视觉特征。

文字设计：
添加一个时尚的角色 ID 模块。
保持极简、醒目且具有艺术指导感。
仅使用：
姓名 (NAME)
角色 (ROLE)
核心情绪 (CORE MOOD)
视觉特征 (VISUAL SIGNATURE)

仅在必要时使用小型的书写体标签。
允许使用细微的编辑箭头和注释标记，但要保持极简和优雅。

风格：
极简、电影感、高级、画册感、整洁、表现力强、适用于生产流程。

最终图像应呈现出一种艺术化的角色身份项目设计感。

创建一个 16:9 的艺术化角色身份项目（CHARACTER IDENTITY BOARD）。

以图像 A 作为主体和视觉媒介。名称：{argument name="name" default="Clara"}。{argument name="correction" default="Fix headphones"}。（根据你的需求修改此行。）

柔和的米白色背景。无环境背景，无 Logo，无水印。

设计方向：
不要创建标准的角色参考图。
创建一个电影级的身份项目，使其看起来像是高端动画工作室的角色研究与艺术画册排版的结合体。

排版应是不对称的、优雅且令人印象深刻的。
利用大面积留白、多变的图像比例和刻意的不平衡感。
避免使用网格、蓝图设计、目录式排版以及重复的转向展示。

重要排版规则：
不要让任何角色图像重叠。
每个视图都必须有清晰的间距和呼吸感。
保持所有全身像、肖像、剪影和细节研究在视觉上相互独立。
禁止面部裁剪、肢体遮挡、堆叠人物或姿势重叠。

主要构图：
放置一个略微偏离中心的大型全身英雄视图作为视觉锚点。

在其周围，以整洁的间距排列较小的辅助研究图：
中性全身视图、背面视图、侧面视图、坐姿、倚靠姿势、蹲姿、俯视角度、仰视角度以及表情研究。

每个视图都应感觉像是独立的、清晰的角色研究，而不是同一场景中的帧。

身份锁定：
在所有视图中保持严格的身份一致性：
相同的面部、相同的面部比例、相同的发型、相同的服装、相同的身体比例、相同的姿态语言、相同的视觉个性。

实用的参考细节：
使角色易于识别，以便进行后续的图像和视频生成：
清晰的脸型、清晰的发型轮廓、清晰的服装轮廓、清晰的体型、清晰的手部、清晰的姿态、清晰的表情范围。

艺术板块：
包含一个小型剪影研究区，展示 2-3 个简化的黑色角色剪影。
包含一个小型表情研究区，展示细微的情绪变化。
包含一个小型细节研究区，展示面部、头发和服装的关键视觉特征。

文字设计：
添加一个时尚的角色 ID 模块。
保持极简、醒目且具有艺术指导感。
仅使用：
姓名 (NAME)
角色 (ROLE)
核心情绪 (CORE MOOD)
视觉特征 (VISUAL SIGNATURE)

仅在必要时使用小型的书写体标签。
允许使用细微的编辑箭头和注释标记，但要保持极简和优雅。

风格：
极简、电影感、高级、画册感、整洁、表现力强、适用于生产流程。

最终图像应呈现出一种艺术化的角色身份项目设计感。

清晰的脸型、清晰的发型轮廓、清晰的服装轮廓、清晰的体型、清晰的手部、清晰的姿态、清晰的表情范围。

添加一个时尚的角色 ID 模块。
保持极简、醒目且具有艺术指导感。

布局：构建 7 个圆角矩形内容面板和 1 个底部长条标语栏。排列如下：左侧一个大型主视觉卡片，占据约一半宽度和上部三分之二空间；中右列堆叠两个小卡片；最右列堆叠两个小卡片；左下角一个小型采摘卡片；底部中心/右侧横跨一个长条标语栏。

主视觉卡片：左上角放置一个带有叶子图标的小胶囊标签，文字为“中国十大名茶之一”。添加一个非常大的深绿色中文标题“{argument name="tea name" default="龙井茶"}”和一个较小的英文副标题“{argument name="English tea name" default="Longjing Tea"}”。下方添加简短描述“中国十大名茶之一，以扁平挺秀、清香鲜爽著称。” 在该卡片右侧添加逼真的产品静物：一杯淡绿色的玻璃茶杯，杯中漂浮着茶叶，后方是一个浅色白碟，堆放着扁平的龙井茶叶。背景应包含模糊的绿色植物阴影和柔和的日光。在主视觉卡片底部，展示 3 个由细垂直线分隔的图标功能块：叶子图标标注“历史悠久 / 千年传承”，山峰图标标注“匠心工艺 / 传统炒制”，冒热气的茶杯图标标注“清雅之味 / 自然本真”。在该卡片右下角，添加一个带有地图定位图标的地点胶囊，文字为“浙江·杭州·西湖”。

中右上方卡片：创建一个产地卡片，带有水上传统中式凉亭的细线圆形图标，标题为“产地”，文字为“主要产于浙江杭州西湖一带，西湖龙井最为知名。” 底部添加淡淡的灰绿色景观剪影。

中右下方卡片：创建一个风味卡片，带有淡绿色圆形茶杯图标，标题为“风味”，文字为“豆香、栗香与清新的嫩香并存，口感柔和，回甘细腻。” 右下角添加微妙的茶叶线条画。

左下角采摘卡片：创建一个标题为“等级与采摘”的卡片，带有小叶子图标。添加正文“以春茶为佳，芽叶细嫩，明前茶尤受欢迎。” 在该卡片右侧，放置一张带有浅景深效果的、田间新鲜嫩绿茶芽的小型圆角照片。

创建一个 16:9 的艺术化角色身份项目（CHARACTER IDENTITY BOARD）。

设计方向：
不要创建标准的角色参考图。
创建一个电影级的身份项目，使其看起来像是高端动画工作室的角色研究与艺术画册排版的结合体。

排版应是不对称的、优雅且令人印象深刻的。
利用大面积留白、多变的图像比例和刻意的不平衡感。
避免使用网格、蓝图设计、目录式排版以及重复的转向展示。

重要排版规则：
不要让任何角色图像重叠。
每个视图都必须有清晰的间距和呼吸感。
保持所有全身像、肖像、剪影和细节研究在视觉上相互独立。
禁止面部裁剪、肢体遮挡、堆叠人物或姿势重叠。

主要构图：
放置一个略微偏离中心的大型全身英雄视图作为视觉锚点。

在其周围，以整洁的间距排列较小的辅助研究图：
中性全身视图、背面视图、侧面视图、坐姿、倚靠姿势、蹲姿、俯视角度、仰视角度以及表情研究。

每个视图都应感觉像是独立的、清晰的角色研究，而不是同一场景中的帧。

身份锁定：
在所有视图中保持严格的身份一致性：
相同的面部、相同的面部比例、相同的发型、相同的服装、相同的身体比例、相同的姿态语言、相同的视觉个性。

实用的参考细节：
使角色易于识别，以便进行后续的图像和视频生成：
清晰的脸型、清晰的发型轮廓、清晰的服装轮廓、清晰的体型、清晰的手部、清晰的姿态、清晰的表情范围。

艺术板块：
包含一个小型剪影研究区，展示 2-3 个简化的黑色角色剪影。
包含一个小型表情研究区，展示细微的情绪变化。
包含一个小型细节研究区，展示面部、头发和服装的关键视觉特征。

文字设计：
添加一个时尚的角色 ID 模块。
保持极简、醒目且具有艺术指导感。
仅使用：
姓名 (NAME)
角色 (ROLE)
核心情绪 (CORE MOOD)
视觉特征 (VISUAL SIGNATURE)

仅在必要时使用小型的书写体标签。
允许使用细微的编辑箭头和注释标记，但要保持极简和优雅。

风格：
极简、电影感、高级、画册感、整洁、表现力强、适用于生产流程。

最终图像应呈现出一种艺术化的角色身份项目设计感。

1. 种子结构 — 一个大型种子剖面图，标有内部零件，并附带一个较小的细胞横截面插图。
2. 发芽机制 — 左侧序列，包含 5 个阶段，展示种子膨胀、裂开、发芽、胚根出现及幼苗早期形态。
3. 根系与基质智能 — 左下方展示大型裸露根系，配有 2 个圆形放大根部细节插图，显示分支结构及根毛/网络纹理。
4. 茎、叶与维管系统 — 右中部区域，包含 2 个解剖学圆形横截面和 1 个独立的叶片插图，标注木质部、韧皮部、表皮及相关组织。
5. 光合作用与能量转换 — 右下方生物学面板，包含 3 个绿色微观结构图，包括叶片组织/类细胞切片，以及简单的化学流动线，指示 CO2 + H2O 转化为糖分和 O2。
6. 花蕾形成与开花 — 右上方开花部分，包含 2 个大型花朵解剖图（侧视图和纵剖面），标注雄蕊、花瓣、子房和花粉结构。
7. 授粉与结果路径 — 右侧发育条，包含 5 个从花蕾到成熟石榴的果实发育阶段，并附带一个展示蜜蜂接近花朵的授粉插图。
8. 果实成熟与种子循环 — 右下方生命周期部分，包含 3 个果实插图，展示完整果实、裂开果实及露出种子的开裂果实，外加 3 幅幼苗生长过程图。

在最底边缘，包含一条长长的生长纪实带，内含 19 个小型步骤插图，每个均按 1 到 19 编号，展示从休眠种子到发芽、根系生长、幼苗破土、树苗发育、开花、坐果、成熟、种子散播及循环更新的植物生命周期。左下方添加一个小型的环境因素面板，配有光照、温度、水分、养分和空气的图标式指示器。全程使用双语标注，中文标题更为突出，英文翻译采用较小的衬线字体。整体美学应呈现出学术、优雅、博物馆级品质及信息密集感，并辅以精致的古风排版、柔和的米色背景、写实的红绿色调以及平衡整洁的图谱布局。
